https://www.inquirer.net/495284/afp-to-v.summary: Roy Vincent Trinidad (Reserve), the Armed Forces of the Philippines’ spokesperson on matters relating to the West Philippine Sea, said he agreed with the Vice President that the Philippines should not antagonize other countries but stressed that asserting its maritime rights was a separate matter. “We are not picking a fight with any country over the West Philippine Sea,” Trinidad said in a press briefing at Camp Aguinaldo.
https://www.inquirer.net/495284/afp-to-v.summary_zh: 菲律宾武装部队负责西菲律宾海相关事务的发言人罗伊·文森特·特立尼迪（预备役）表示，他认同副总统的看法，即菲律宾不应与其他国家交恶，但强调，维护自身海洋权利是另一回事。特立尼迪在阿吉纳尔多营的新闻发布会上说：“我们并未因西菲律宾海问题与任何国家挑起冲突。”
https://www.inquirer.net/495284/afp-to-v.body: Rear Adm. Roy Vincent Trinidad (Reserve), the Armed Forces of the Philippines’ spokesperson on matters relating to the West Philippine Sea, said he agreed with the Vice President that the Philippines should not antagonize other countries but stressed that asserting its maritime rights was a separate matter. “We are not picking a fight with any country over the West Philippine Sea,” Trinidad said in a press briefing at Camp Aguinaldo. “By merely standing up for what is rightfully and legally ours, we are not fighting any other country.” Trinidad was responding to Duterte’s remarks during a gathering with overseas Filipino workers in Hong Kong on Sunday, where she urged the government to maintain good relations with China despite the maritime dispute. The Vice President warned that deteriorating bilateral ties could threaten the jobs and businesses of Filipinos working in China. She also called for a team of diplomats and negotiators to handle the dispute rather than resorting to confrontations at sea or exchanges on social media. READ: Marcos wants South China Sea code of conduct finalized during Asean She further cited the disparity between the two countries’ military capabilities, arguing that the government should consider the consequences of confronting a more powerful neighbor. Asked about Duterte’s comparison of the Philippines’ military strength with China’s, Trinidad said the AFP would continue performing its mandate regardless of its capabilities. “It is not about military strength. We have what we have. We are improving our capabilities,” he said. “Given what we have, we are good. Given more, we could perform even better. But it will not stop the AFP from fighting, from standing up, from supporting all our government officials who stand up for our rights in the West Philippine Sea.” Trinidad also stressed that every Filipino, including elected officials, has a responsibility to defend the country’s national interests. “The Arbitral Tribunal of 2016 is a legal landmark that upheld the maritime entitlements of the Philippines. Every Filipino should champion this,” he said. The 2016 arbitral ruling invalidated China’s sweeping maritime claims in the South China Sea, although Beijing has refused to recognize the decision. Trinidad also said the AFP would not scale back its activities in the West Philippine Sea despite calls to preserve diplomatic space for talks with Beijing. Asked whether the military should tone down its assertion of Philippine maritime rights to give diplomacy a chance, Trinidad said the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) and the defense establishment had distinct responsibilities. “We leave the statement of the [DFA] at that inasmuch as they are the primary vehicle of government for diplomacy,” he said. “On the side of the [Department of National Defense] and the AFP, we have a mandate to perform to secure the integrity of the national territory, protect our sovereignty, and look after the welfare of the Filipino people,” he added. The DFA earlier reminded officials, particularly members of the defense and security sector, to align their statements and actions with President Marcos’ foreign policy direction, particularly with regard to China. https://www.inquirer.net/495284/afp-to-v.body_zh: 菲律宾海军中将罗伊·文森特·特立尼达（预备役）是菲律宾武装部队负责西菲律宾海事务的发言人。他表示认同副总统的观点，即菲律宾不应与其他国家交恶，但强调，维护自身海洋权利是另一回事。特立尼达在阿吉纳尔多营的一次新闻发布会上说：“我们没有因西菲律宾海问题与任何国家挑起争端。仅是为维护理应属于我们且符合法律的权利，并不意味着我们是在与任何其他国家交战。”特立尼达是在回应杜特尔特周日与香港菲律宾海外劳工集会时发表的言论。她在集会上敦促政府，尽管存在海洋争端，仍应与中国保持良好关系。副总统警告，双边关系恶化可能危及在华菲律宾人的就业和生意。她还呼吁由外交官和谈判人员组成的团队处理争端，而不是诉诸海上对抗或社交媒体上的交锋。阅读：马科斯希望Asean期间完成《南海行为准则》。她还指出两国军事实力存在差距，主张政府应考虑与实力更强的邻国对峙可能带来的后果。当被问及杜特尔特将菲律宾军事实力与中国作比较时，特立尼达表示，无论实力如何，菲律宾武装部队都会继续履行职责。他说：“关键不在于军事实力。我们有什么就用什么。我们正在提升自己的能力。就现有条件而言，我们已经足够出色。若拥有更多资源，我们就能表现得更好。但这不会阻止菲律宾武装部队战斗、挺身而出，也不会阻止我们支持所有在西菲律宾海维护我们权利的政府官员。”特立尼达还强调，每一名菲律宾人，包括民选官员，都有责任捍卫国家利益。他说：“2016年仲裁庭裁决是一项法律里程碑，确认了菲律宾的海洋权益。每一名菲律宾人都应为此发声。”2016年的仲裁裁决否定了中国在南海提出的广泛海洋主张，但北京一直拒绝承认该裁决。尽管有人呼吁为与北京对话保留外交空间，特立尼达仍表示，菲律宾武装部队不会缩减其在西菲律宾海的活动。当被问及军方是否应缓和其对菲律宾海洋权利的主张，为外交谈判创造机会时，特立尼达表示，外交部（DFA）与国防体系承担着不同的职责。他说：“对于外交部，我们对其声明不作进一步评论，因为外交部是政府开展外交的主要渠道。就国防部和菲律宾武装部队而言，我们的使命是维护国家领土完整、保护我们的主权，并照顾菲律宾人民的福祉。”外交部早些时候提醒官员，尤其是国防和安全部门人员，应使自身言行与马科斯总统的外交政策方向保持一致，特别是在涉及中国的问题上。无法保存您的订阅，请重试。您的订阅已成功。外交部说：“无论公职人员持有什么个人信念，其公开立场都承载着机构责任。他们不能不顾后果，针对中国或任何其他国际伙伴推行自己偏好的做法，因为这会影响政府的整体政策。”/cb 如需全面报道和深入分析，请访问我们的西菲律宾海专题最新消息页面。通过文章、视频和专家观点了解最新动态

https://www.inquirer.net/495278/navy-rai.body: NavComWest said it had been coordinating with concerned government agencies, coastal communities, and fisherfolk ahead of the launch to ensure the timely reporting of suspected rocket debris, falling objects, and other related maritime and aerial incidents. The Navy said the launch, conducted from the Hainan International Commercial Launch Center in Wenchang, Hainan, at 4:24 a.m., produced an unusual phenomenon over this city and several Philippine-held island stations in the West Philippine Sea, raising concerns over the potential security implications of similar activities. The Long March 12 rocket is known to produce light and smoke trails as it enters the final stage of its launch, followed by loud sounds attributed to sonic booms. These effects were observed in this city about nine minutes after the launch, when bright lights illuminated the sky before loud explosions were heard. Navy personnel deployed at various stations in the West Philippine Sea also reported similar observations, particularly in Lawak, Patag, and Likas Islands, as well as Rizal (Commodore) Reef. Personnel assigned to the Tubbataha Reef Natural Park reported seeing a bright luminous object approximately 35 kilometers (19 nautical miles) from their station. The area had earlier been identified by the Philippine Space Agency as a possible drop zone for debris from the rocket. Based on its initial assessment, NavComWest said the phenomenon, known as a “space jellyfish,” was likely caused by the expansion of rocket exhaust gases at high altitudes. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title: NNPC Audit Report: Former GMD tells lawmakers ₦210 trillion isn’t missing
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary: Former Group Chief Executive Officer of the Nigerian National Petroleum Company ( NNPC ) Limited, Mele Kyari, said the alleged ₦210 trillion discrepancy flagged in the Auditor-General’s report covering 2017 to 2023 misrepresents the facts. He said this on Tuesday, when he appeared before the Senate Committee on Public Accounts to respond to allegations in the audit report.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）有限公司前集团首席执行官梅莱·基亚里表示，审计长报告中针对2017年至2023年提出的所谓210万亿奈拉差额歪曲了事实。他周二出席参议院公共账目委员会，就审计报告中的指控作出回应时表示了这一点。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: Former Group Chief Executive Officer of the Nigerian National Petroleum Company ( NNPC ) Limited, Mele Kyari, said the alleged ₦210 trillion discrepancy flagged in the Auditor-General’s report covering 2017 to 2023 misrepresents the facts. Mr Kyari maintained that the money was neither missing nor stolen under his watch, denying reports suggesting that the amount had been lost. He said this on Tuesday, when he appeared before the Senate Committee on Public Accounts to respond to allegations in the audit report. “The issue of ₦210 trillion that is misconstrued in the reports to have been lost, I have confirmed at this moment that nothing is lost. It’s simply not possible under my care and under my leadership for that to happen, but it did not happen,” he said. Mr Kyari argued that the controversy originated from accounting and bookkeeping failures rather than any financial losses. He said he had provided detailed explanations in a report submitted to the committee. “There are actually three issues, which I know have been clarified. They are bookkeeping issues and have nothing to do with any losses. And I really, really confirm that nothing is lost. Those are just accounting entry issues, and I’m sure that description is correct. It’s also in my report how that description works,” he added. The controversy surrounding the alleged ₦210 trillion discrepancy began in June 2025 after details of NNPC Ltd’s audited financial records attracted public attention. At the time, the Senate committee gave the company a seven-day ultimatum to explain the discrepancies. However, NNPC Ltd, now led by Bayo Ojulari, failed to meet the deadline, citing its officials’ attendance at a retreat. The company’s failure to respond to the Senate’s queries fuelled public concerns about transparency and accountability within the national oil company. In November 2025, NNPC Ltd submitted a written explanation to the committee, stating that ₦103 trillion represented accrued expenses, while ₦107 trillion was recorded as receivables. The committee, then chaired by Aliyu Wadada, the senator representing Nasarawa West, rejected the explanation and insisted that the company’s leadership appear in person to provide further clarification. The matter remained unresolved until Ibrahim Dankwambo, the senator for Gombe Central, replaced Mr Wadada as committee chairman and resumed the investigation. The committee later invited Mr Kyari to appear before the lawmakers and account for the discrepancies. In June, the committee threatened to issue an arrest warrant against him to compel his appearance after he failed to honour several invitations. President Bola Tinubu removed Mr Kyari from office in April 2025 amid several corruption-related petitions against him. Mr Kyari also addressed questions surrounding the payment of about ₦2.99 billion for the incorporation and registration of NNPC Limited, explaining that the expenditure covered payments to government institutions responsible for the relevant statutory processes. The former NNPC chief executive said the payment was not for naming the company, contrary to some public interpretations of the financial records. He explained that the Petroleum Industry Act (PIA), enacted by the National Assembly, provided for the incorporation of NNPC Limited as part of the national company’s restructuring. According to the PA, the payment was made to the relevant government institutions and subsequently charged to the Federation’s revenue account. “It’s actually paid to the former FIRS and the Corporate Affairs Commission as a matter of payment for registration. It’s just an entry about who should pay for it. The PIA, which is the National Assembly, states that company owners should incorporate the company. “In this case, the owner of the company at that moment was not necessarily NNPC. The federation must pay for that role in the incorporation. NNPC, which was not owned by the federation at that moment, paid on behalf of the federation and then charged it to the federation’s revenue base.” Mr Kyari also dismissed reports suggesting that NNPC Ltd paid about ₦5 billion merely to register or name the company, insisting that the name was already provided for in the PIA. “I have some comments that, for naming the company, we paid ₦5 billion. Actually, this company was named by the National Assembly, so you don’t need to pay any kobo to register that company. “The company was named by the National Assembly in appropriate sections of the PIA. So there is no such thing. I think it’s a description issue, and we apologise if that wasn’t properly captured by the auditors,” he said. While defending his stewardship, Mr Kyari said he assumed responsibility for the state oil company in 2019 and immediately introduced a transparency and accountability framework to strengthen public confidence in its operations. He said the decision to publish the company’s financial statements exposed its operations to sustained public scrutiny but ultimately improved institutional accountability and operational performance. “When I took responsibility in 2019, the first thing I did was to institute a transparency and accountability framework. I said that public institutions and public leaders must account for what they are responsible for, and institutions must be accountable to their stakeholders, particularly their shareholders. “In the case of NNPC, all Nigerians are shareholders of this company. And I understood this. We took the bold decision to publish the financial records of this company, which has never been done in its 43 years of existence.” After his presentation, Mr Kyari submitted his report to the committee. The committee chairman said the lawmakers would study the document and review his explanations before deciding on further action
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: NNPC审计报告：前总经理告诉议员，210万亿奈拉并未失踪
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC） Limited前首席执行官梅莱·凯亚里表示，审计长报告所指出、涵盖2017年至2023年的所谓₦210万亿差额歪曲了事实。凯亚里先生坚称，在他任职期间，这笔钱既没有失踪，也没有被盗，并否认了有关这笔资金已经损失的说法。他于星期二出席参议院公共账户委员会，回应审计报告中的指控时表示了上述观点。凯亚里先生说：“报告中将₦210万亿误认为已经损失，但眼下我确认，没有任何资金遭到损失。在我的管理和领导之下，这种事根本不可能发生，而事实上也没有发生。”凯亚里先生认为，这场争议源于会计和簿记失误，而非任何资金损失。他说，他已在提交给委员会的报告中提供了详细说明。凯亚里先生补充道：“实际上存在三个问题，而且我知道这些问题已经得到澄清。这些都是簿记问题，与任何损失毫无关系。我确实、确实确认没有任何资金损失。这些只是会计分录问题，我确信这样的描述是正确的。我的报告也说明了这种描述具体如何适用。”围绕所谓₦210万亿差额的争议始于2025年6月，当时尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC） Limited经审计的财务记录详情引起公众关注。当时，参议院委员会给该公司下了最后通牒，要求其在7天内解释这些差额。然而，由巴约·奥朱拉里领导的尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC） Limited未能履行期限，理由是公司官员正在参加务虚会。该公司未能回应参议院的质询，进一步加剧了公众对这家国家石油公司透明度和问责制的担忧。2025年11月，尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC） Limited向委员会提交书面说明，称₦103万亿属于应计费用，另有₦107万亿记为应收款项。当时由代表纳萨拉瓦西区的参议员阿里尤·瓦达达担任委员会主席。他拒绝接受这份解释，并坚持要求公司领导层亲自出席，提供进一步说明。此事一直悬而未决，直到戈姆贝中区的参议员易卜拉欣·丹克万博取代瓦达达先生，出任委员会主席并重启调查。委员会随后邀请凯亚里先生出席议员会议，就这些差额作出解释。6月，在凯亚里先生数次无视邀请后，委员会威胁要向他发出逮捕令，迫使其出庭。2025年4月，在针对凯亚里先生的多项贪腐请愿引发争议之际，博拉·蒂努布总统解除了他的职务。凯亚里先生还回应了围绕尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC） Limited设立和注册支付约₦2.99 billion的相关问题，解释称，这笔支出涵盖向负责相关法定程序的政府机构支付的款项。这名前尼日利亚国家石油公司首席执行官表示，这笔款项并非用于公司命名，与公众对财务记录的部分解读不符。他解释道，全国议会颁布的《石油工业法》（PIA）规定将尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC） Limited的设立纳入国家石油公司的重组计划。根据《石油工业法》，这笔款项支付给了相关政府机构，随后计入联邦收入账户。凯亚里先生说：“这笔钱实际上支付给了原尼日利亚税务局（FIRS）和公司事务委员会，用于办理注册手续。这不过是确定由谁付款的记账问题。全国议会颁布的《石油工业法》规定，公司所有者应负责公司设立。‘当时的公司所有者未必是尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）。联邦政府必须承担公司设立环节的付款责任。当时并不由联邦政府持有的尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）代联邦政府付款，之后再从联邦政府的收入基础中列支。”凯亚里先生还否认了有关尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC） Limited支付约₦5 billion仅为公司注册或命名的报道，坚称公司名称已在《石油工业法》中确定。他说：“我看到一些评论称，我们为公司命名支付了₦5 billion。实际上，这家公司是由全国议会命名的，因此注册该公司不需要支付任何科博。‘全国议会已在《石油工业法》的适当条款中为公司命名。所以根本不存在所说的那种情况。我认为这是一个描述问题，如果审计人员未能准确记录，我们对此表示歉意。’”凯亚里先生在为自己任职期间的治理工作辩护时表示，他于2019年接手这家国家石油公司，并立即建立透明度和问责制框架，以加强公众对其运营的信心。他说，公布公司财务报表的决定使公司运营长期受到公众审视，但最终提升了机构问责和运营绩效。凯亚里先生说：“2019年我接手工作时，做的第一件事就是建立透明度和问责制框架。我明确表示，公共机构和公共领导人必须就自身职责作出说明，机构必须对利益相关者负责，尤其是对股东负责。‘对尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）而言，所有尼日利亚人都是这家公司的股东。我充分认识到了这一点。我们作出了大胆决定，公布这家公司的财务记录，而这家公司成立43年来从未这样做过。’陈述结束后，凯亚里先生向委员会提交了报告。委员会主席表示，议员们将研究该文件并审查他的解释，再决定采取何种后续行动

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Korea's top economic policymaker said Wednesday the government will release annual economic growth forecasts three times a year starting in 2027, up from the current two, to respond more proactively to changing economic conditions. Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il made the announcement as he discussed details of the government's economic growth strategy for next year with relevant ministers, indicating the plan will seek sustainable growth by addressing disparities. "In order to promptly respond to the changing environment at home and abroad, the government will increase the number of economic outlooks issued from two to three, which would mark the first change in 32 years," Lee said. Lee said the government will no longer release a separate economic growth strategy for the second half of the year under the revised system, but will instead draw up supplementary measures to address economic conditions when it announces its growth forecasts. The finance minister said details will be announced in December following discussions with relevant ministries. During the meeting, Lee added that the government will continue efforts to maintain the current growth momentum through flagship initiatives, including the three megaprojects

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: In September, it was also confirmed that South Korea had formally notified the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) of its intention to begin consultations on an arrangement under Article 14 of its Comprehensive Safeguards Agreement. It is time to put specific negotiating objectives in writing. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 9月还确认，韩国已正式通知国际原子能机构（IAEA），打算就依据其《全面保障协定》第14条达成安排开始磋商。现在是时候将具体谈判目标书面确定了。随着该协定即将迎来首个周年纪念日，首尔和华盛顿需要制定一份实施计划，将燃料采购和建设准备工作纳入同一个协调推进的时间表。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: As the first anniversary of the ROK–U.S. Joint Fact Sheet singed in November 2025 approaches, Seoul and Washington should demonstrate concrete progress in implementing their commitments. The United States approved South Korea’s construction of nuclear-powered submarines and pledged close cooperation on the requirements for the program, including avenues to source fuel. Those political commitments must now be translated into clear timelines and clearly assigned responsibilities. Securing a shipyard alone will not deliver a nuclear-powered submarine. Fuel specifications and supply arrangements must be established to align reactor design and testing, submarine construction and entry into service. Delays in fuel cooperation could lead to design changes, higher costs and uncertainty for companies considering investment. Diplomatic negotiations and domestic development must not become trapped in a cycle in which each waits for decisions from the other. There has been some progress. In December 2025, the two countries’ foreign affairs officials agreed on the need to move promptly toward follow-up consultations on nuclear cooperation, shipbuilding and nuclear-powered submarines. At a congressional hearing in March, a senior State Department official explained that an interagency review was underway, with the Pentagon addressing infrastructure issues and the State Department handling matters related to potential nuclear fuel provision. In June, delegations from both countries met in Seoul for follow-up consultations on nuclear-powered submarines and civil nuclear cooperation. They agreed to pursue tangible results promptly and establish a mechanism to review progress. In September, it was also confirmed that South Korea had formally notified the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) of its intention to begin consultations on an arrangement under Article 14 of its Comprehensive Safeguards Agreement. This is an important step toward developing naval nuclear propulsion while upholding nonproliferation obligations. However, according to an Oct. 30 news report, a senior South Korean presidential official said that follow-up security negotiations remained on hold and that a second round had yet to be scheduled. Beginning consultations does not, by itself, guarantee sustained progress. Procedural progress must also be distinguished from securing fuel. The Joint Fact Sheet did not guarantee direct U.S. fuel supply or delivery by a specified date. Nor do consultations with the IAEA determine the supplier or delivery schedule. The government nevertheless has a responsibility to explain what has been agreed and which decisions remain outstanding. The most immediate reason South Korea needs nuclear-powered submarines is the threat posed by North Korea’s submarine-launched ballistic missiles. Because the movements of North Korean submarines and the timing of a potential launch cannot be predicted with certainty, the ability to maintain prolonged underwater surveillance and tracking is essential. Nuclear-powered submarines offer advantages in submerged endurance and sustained high-speed operations. Their effectiveness increases when they operate alongside surface ships, maritime patrol aircraft and underwater surveillance systems. South Korea must also prepare for neighboring countries’ expanding submarine forces and maritime influence. Protecting sea lines of communication and maritime interests, while strengthening the persistence of combined ROK–U.S. anti-submarine warfare operations, serves both allies. A greater South Korean contribution to surveillance and anti-submarine warfare in surrounding waters would also give the U.S. Navy greater operational flexibility. The missions of South Korean nuclear-powered submarines should, however, be grounded in the defense of the Korean Peninsula and South Korea’s sovereign authority over decisions concerning their employment. For more than seven decades, the ROK–U.S. alliance has remained one of the world’s strongest. South Korea’s submarine construction expertise and naval maintenance capabilities are valuable assets for the United States as well. Nuclear fuel cooperation and shipbuilding cooperation should not be treated as a simple exchange of concessions. The case should instead be made clearly that both can strengthen the alliance’s maritime security and industrial base. It is time to put specific negotiating objectives in writing. A framework should identify the supplier, uranium enrichment level and fuel form, the timing of initial delivery, ownership arrangements and principles for managing spent nuclear fuel. Both governments should also identify the U.S. laws and congressional review procedures applicable to the particular materials or technology to be transferred. Civil nuclear enrichment and reprocessing cooperation and fuel cooperation for naval propulsion serve different purposes and follow different legal pathways. Each therefore requires a clearly defined negotiating agenda. Regardless of the outcome of the U.S. midterm elections, engagement between South Korea’s National Assembly and the U.S. Congress must deepen. Reliable implementation of executive-level agreements requires understanding and support across party lines. Lawmakers from South Korea’s governing and opposition parties should jointly engage the relevant House and Senate committees and key members of Congress. They should explain the military requirement, the benefits to the alliance, the proposed use of low-enriched uranium and the measures intended to uphold nonproliferation commitments. Parliamentary diplomacy must go beyond goodwill visits. South Korean representatives should provide evidence-based answers to congressional questions about fuel management, technology protection, financial responsibilities and the industrial benefits for members’ states and districts. The National Assembly should support the government’s negotiations while scrutinizing budgets, schedules and safety arrangements. Bipartisan support should be accompanied by responsible oversight that helps sustain the program. South Korea must also strengthen its domestic arrangements for implementing the program. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs should lead diplomatic negotiations with Washington, while the Ministry of National Defense and the Defense Acquisition Program Administration define operational requirements and acquisition schedules. Nuclear research institutions and industry should specify the scope of development and technical requirements, and safety regulators should participate from the outset. A governmentwide coordination mechanism must make clear who is responsible for each decision and when it must be made, so that negotiated outcomes can be translated promptly into program execution. Preparations that can proceed should advance while fuel decisions remain pending. Defining operational performance requirements, securing design personnel and preparing testing and maintenance infrastructure should move forward in parallel, with careful management of the risk that fuel decisions may require changes. The government should work backward from the design and construction schedule to set negotiating milestones and prepare contingencies for delays. It should report regularly to the National Assembly on progress and major risks, using closed briefings for sensitive matters. Alliance credibility is demonstrated through implementation. South Korea must prepare for responsible development and effective nonproliferation arrangements, while the United States should clarify the practical pathways for fulfilling its commitments. Legislators in both countries should support this work across election cycles and changes of government. As the agreement’s first anniversary approaches, Seoul and Washington need an implementation plan that places fuel procurement and construction preparations on a single, coordinated timeline. Ret. Navy Capt. Moon Keun-sik is distinguished professor of Graduate School of Public Policy at Hanyang University in Seoul
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 是时候将韩国与美国协议付诸行动了
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 随着2025年11月签署的韩美联合情况说明首个周年即将到来，首尔和华盛顿应以具体进展证明双方正在履行承诺。美国已批准韩国建造核动力潜艇，并承诺就该项目的相关要求密切合作，包括核燃料来源渠道。这些政治承诺如今必须转化为明确时间表和清晰的责任分工。仅找到一家造船厂并不能造出核动力潜艇。双方必须确定燃料规格和供应安排，使反应堆设计与测试、潜艇建造及服役相互衔接。燃料合作若延误，可能导致设计变更、成本上升，并给考虑投资的企业带来不确定性。外交谈判与国内研发不能陷入彼此等待对方决定的循环。目前已取得一些进展。2025年12月，两国外交事务官员同意，应迅速推进关于核合作、造船和核动力潜艇的后续磋商。3月举行的一次国会听证会上，美国国务院一名高级官员表示，跨部门审查正在推进，五角大楼负责处理基础设施问题，国务院负责处理与可能提供核燃料有关的事务。6月，两国代表团在首尔举行后续磋商，讨论核动力潜艇和民用核合作。双方同意迅速取得实质性成果，并建立审查进展的机制。9月，韩国还确认已正式通知国际原子能机构（IAEA），拟就其《全面保障监督协定》第14条所设安排开始磋商。这是朝着发展海军核动力推进技术迈出的重要一步，同时也能履行不扩散义务。然而，据10月30日的一篇新闻报道，韩国总统府一名高级官员称，后续安保谈判仍处于搁置状态，第二轮会谈尚未安排。启动磋商本身并不能保证持续进展。还必须将程序性进展与落实燃料供应区分开来。《联合情况说明》并未保证美国直接供应燃料或规定具体交付日期。与IAEA磋商也无法确定供应方或交付时间表。尽管如此，政府仍有责任说明双方已经商定什么，以及哪些决定仍未作出。韩国急需核动力潜艇的直接原因，是朝鲜弹道导弹潜艇带来的威胁。由于朝鲜潜艇的动向及潜在发射时间无法准确预测，长期保持水下监视和追踪能力至关重要。核动力潜艇在水下续航和持续高速运行方面具有优势。与水面舰艇、海上巡逻机和水下监视系统协同行动时，其效能会进一步提高。韩国还必须为邻国不断扩大的潜艇力量和海上影响做好准备。保护海上交通线和海洋利益，同时加强韩美联合反潜行动的持续能力，对两个盟友都有益。韩国为周边水域监视和反潜作战作出更大贡献，也会让美国海军获得更大的行动灵活性。不过，韩国核动力潜艇的任务必须以朝鲜半岛防务为根基，且其使用决定必须由韩国依据主权作出。七十多年来，韩美同盟一直是世界上最强大的同盟之一。韩国的潜艇建造专长和海军维护能力对美国同样宝贵。核燃料合作与造船合作不应被视为简单的利益交换，而应明确说明双方合作都能增强同盟的海上安全和产业基础。是时候把具体谈判目标写入文件了。框架应明确供应方、铀浓缩丰度和燃料形态、首次交付时间、所有权安排以及乏核燃料管理原则。双方政府还应查明适用于拟转让特定材料或技术的美国法律及国会审查程序。民用核浓缩与后处理合作，以及舰船核动力推进所需的燃料合作，服务于不同目标，遵循不同法律路径，因此各自都需要边界清晰的谈判议程。无论美国中期选举结果如何，韩国国会与美国国会之间的交流都必须深化。可靠落实行政层级协议，需要跨党派理解和支持。韩国执政党和反对党议员应共同接触众议院和参议院的相关委员会及国会重要成员，说明军事需求、对同盟的益处、拟使用低浓缩铀的情况，以及旨在维护不扩散承诺的措施。议会外交不能止于礼节性访问。韩国代表应基于证据回答国会议员关于燃料管理、技术保护、财政责任以及相关成员国和选区工业收益的问题。韩国国会应支持政府谈判，同时严格审查预算、进度和安全安排。两党支持应伴随负责任的监督，以帮助项目持续推进。韩国还必须加强落实项目的国内机制。外交部应牵头与华盛顿开展外交谈判，国防部和国防事业厅则界定作战需求及采购时间表。核研究机构和产业界应明确研发范围和技术要求，安全监管机构应从一开始便参与。面向全政府的协调机制必须明确每项决定由谁负责以及应在何时作出，从而把谈判成果迅速转化为项目执行。燃料决定尚未作出期间，可以推进能够开展的准备工作。界定作战性能要求、落实设计人员以及准备测试和维护基础设施应同步推进，同时谨慎管理燃料决定可能引发变更的风险。政府应从设计和建造进度倒推，设定谈判里程碑，并为延误准备应急方案。政府应定期向国会报告进展和重大风险，敏感事项则采用闭门简报。同盟的可信度通过执行来体现。韩国必须为负责任的研发和有效的不扩散安排做好准备，美国则应明确履行承诺的实际路径。两国议员应跨越选举周期和政府更迭，支持这项工作。随着协议首个周年临近，首尔和华盛顿需要一份实施计划，把燃料采购和建造准备纳入同一条协调时间表。退役海军上校文根植是首尔汉阳大学公共政策研究生院杰出教授。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Korea added 139,000 jobs in October from a year earlier, government data showed Wednesday, with job growth exceeding the 100,000 mark for the fourth consecutive month. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国政府数据周三显示，10月新增就业岗位139,000个，较上年同期有所增加；就业增幅连续第四个月超过100,000个。数据与统计部数据显示，10月就业人数达到29.17 million人，而上年同期为29.04 million人。10月失业人数总计602,000人，较2025年同期减少56,000人。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea added 139,000 jobs in October from a year earlier, government data showed Wednesday, with job growth exceeding the 100,000 mark for the fourth consecutive month. The number of employed people came to 29.17 million in October, compared with 29.04 million a year earlier, according to data from the Ministry of Data and Statistics. Job growth turned positive in June after declining by 40,000 in May, the first drop in 17 months. The country's jobless rate came to 2 percent last month, down 0.2 percentage point from a year earlier. The number of unemployed people totaled 602,000 in October, down 56,000 from the same month in 2025. The employment rate for people aged 15 to 64 came to 70.4 percent, up 0.3 percentage point from a year earlier. The figure for those aged 15 to 29, on the other hand, fell 1.7 percentage points to 42.9 percent

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Korea jumped eight places to rank 10th out of 70 nations in the 2026 World Digital and AI Competitiveness Ranking (WDAIR), published Wednesday by the International Institute for Management Development (IMD) — the prestigious Swiss business school known for its benchmark global competitiveness evaluations. Notably, Korea jumped 10 places to rank third globally in Efficiency and climbed four spots to third in Technological Infrastructure.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国在周三发布的《2026年世界数字与人工智能竞争力排名》（WDAIR）中上升8位，在70个国家中排名第10。该排名由国际管理发展研究院（IMD）发布；这所享有盛名的瑞士商学院以对全球竞争力进行基准评估而闻名。值得注意的是，韩国在效率方面上升10位，位居全球第三；在技术基础设施方面也上升4位，升至第三。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea jumped eight places to rank 10th out of 70 nations in the 2026 World Digital and AI Competitiveness Ranking (WDAIR), published Wednesday by the International Institute for Management Development (IMD) — the prestigious Swiss business school known for its benchmark global competitiveness evaluations. Among nations with populations exceeding 20 million, Korea secured fourth place, trailing only the United States, Canada and China. The Ministry of Science and ICT announced that Korea achieved comprehensive improvements across all five evaluated categories: Governance, Technological Infrastructure, Efficiency, Human Resources Development and Societal Attitudes & Values. Notably, Korea jumped 10 places to rank third globally in Efficiency and climbed four spots to third in Technological Infrastructure. Korea demonstrated unmatched leadership in government execution and technological foundation, claiming the top spot worldwide in both the Government Core Systems Index and total research and development (R&D) expenditure as a percentage of gross domestic product. The nation also maintained third place in R&D infrastructure and IT/media market capitalization. In the newly introduced AI-focused indicators, Korea posted strong performances across the board. The country ranked eighth in the AI Adoption Index, AI Papers and in AI Readiness, while it placed 10th in Citizens' Trust in AI. Additionally, Korea moved up to 20th in corporate agility — rising from 46th last year — and saw notable gains in venture capital availability and high-skilled foreign talent recruitment. The IMD updated its evaluation framework this year from the former World Digital Competitiveness Ranking to the WDAIR, incorporating AI adoption, governance and ethics metrics, with historical rankings retroactively adjusted back to 2022. Regionally, Singapore topped the Asia-Pacific region at second overall, followed by China at seventh, Korea at 10th, Taiwan at 13th and Japan at 19th. The United States reclaimed the top spot globally, while last year's leader Canada fell to fifth. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国全球数字化、人工智能竞争力排名上升8位，升至第10
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国在周三由国际管理发展研究院（IMD）发布的《2026年世界数字与人工智能竞争力排名》（WDAIR）中上升8位，在70个国家中排名第10。IMD是一家享有盛誉的瑞士商学院，以全球竞争力基准评估而闻名。在人口超过2000万的国家中，韩国位列第4，仅次于美国、加拿大和中国。韩国科学技术与信息通信部宣布，韩国在全部5个评估类别中均取得全面进步，分别为治理、技术基础设施、效率、人力资源开发以及社会态度与价值观。值得注意的是，韩国在效率方面上升10位，升至全球第3；在技术基础设施方面上升4位，升至第3。韩国在政府执行力和技术基础方面展现出不 unmatched 的领先地位，在政府核心系统指数以及研发（R&D）支出占国内生产总值比例两项指标上均居全球第1。该国还在研发基础设施和IT/传媒市场资本化方面保持第3。在新加入的人工智能专项指标中，韩国各项表现均十分出色。该国在人工智能采用指数、人工智能论文和人工智能准备度方面均排名第8，在公民对人工智能的信任度方面排名第10。此外，韩国在企业敏捷性方面升至第20，而上一年为第46；风险投资可获得性以及高技能外国人才招聘也取得显著提升。IMD今年将评估框架从原《世界数字竞争力排名》更新为WDAIR，纳入人工智能采用、治理和伦理指标，并将历史排名追溯调整至2022年。在各地区中，新加坡以总排名第2位居亚太地区首位，其后依次为中国第7、韩国第10、中国台湾第13和日本第19。美国重夺全球第1，去年的榜首加拿大降至第5。本文在生成式人工智能协助下撰写，并由《韩国时报》编辑

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Sangmidang expands food bank support with 2 refrigerated trucks
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Sangmidang Holdings said Wednesday that its charitable foundation donated two refrigerated trucks to the Korea Foodbank on Tuesday, expanding a delivery support program launched to help local food banks safely transport donated food. The nationwide food bank network distributes donated food and household necessities to vulnerable people through about 440 sites, according to the company. Sangmidang began donating food in 1998, when Korea launched its food bank program amid the Asian financial crisis.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: Sangmidang Holdings周三表示，其慈善基金会周二向韩国食品银行捐赠了两辆冷藏货车，扩充了一项配送支持计划。该计划旨在帮助当地食品银行安全运输捐赠食品。据该公司介绍，韩国全国食品银行网络通过约440个站点向弱势群体分发捐赠食品和生活必需品。1998年，亚洲金融危机期间韩国启动食品银行计划，Sangmidang也开始捐赠食品。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Sangmidang Holdings said Wednesday that its charitable foundation donated two refrigerated trucks to the Korea Foodbank on Tuesday, expanding a delivery support program launched to help local food banks safely transport donated food. The latest contribution brings the total number of trucks provided since the foundation signed a partnership agreement in October 2022 to 12. The foundation plans to provide eight more by 2030. Sangmidang Holdings Chairman Hur Young-in and Kim Hyun-hoon, president of the Korea National Council on Social Welfare, attended the handover ceremony in Dongjak District in Seoul. The company also donated 4,000 bakery products, which were loaded onto the trucks. The vehicles will serve Busanjin District in Busan and Gyeryong, South Chungcheong Province. The company said aging vehicles have hampered deliveries at some food banks, with refrigeration failures and frequent breakdowns creating operational difficulties. Replacing the vehicles also posed a financial burden to the food-sharing organization. The nationwide food bank network distributes donated food and household necessities to vulnerable people through about 440 sites, according to the company. Sangmidang began donating food in 1998, when Korea launched its food bank program amid the Asian financial crisis. Its Paris Croissant and Paris Baguette franchisees were the first to participate, followed by other group brands, including Baskin-Robbins and Dunkin'. “Our food-sharing partnership with Foodbank, which began in 1998, has been a cherished commitment for 28 years,” Hur said. “We will continue working to contribute to a warmer and healthier society.” The company said its affiliates and franchisees have donated a cumulative 344 billion won ($257 million) worth of food as of the first half of this year, accounting for about 10 percent of all food bank donations. Sangmidang said the figure was the highest among Korean food companies. Sangmidang said about 1,200 businesses in Korea have participated in food donations, with annual contributions averaging 17 billion won over the past five years
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: Sangmidang增派2辆冷藏卡车，扩大食品银行援助
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: Sangmidang Holdings周三表示，其慈善基金会于周二向韩国食品银行捐赠了两辆冷藏货车，以扩大一项旨在帮助当地食品银行安全运输捐赠食品的配送支持项目。基金会自2022年10月签署合作协议以来提供的货车总数，此次新增后达到12辆。基金会计划到2030年再提供8辆。Sangmidang Holdings董事长Hur Young-in和韩国全国社会福祉委员会会长Kim Hyun-hoon出席了位于首尔东作洞区的车辆交付仪式。该公司还捐赠了4,000件烘焙食品，并将其装载到货车上。这些车辆将服务于釜山广安区和忠清南道牙邑市。公司表示，车辆老化导致一些食品银行的配送受阻，制冷故障和频繁抛锚造成了运营困难。更换车辆也给食品共享组织带来经济负担。据该公司介绍，全国食品银行网络通过约440个站点向弱势群体分发捐赠食品和生活必需品。1998年亚洲金融危机期间，韩国启动食品银行项目，Sangmidang也开始捐赠食品。其Paris Croissant和Paris Baguette加盟商率先参与，随后集团旗下其他品牌也加入进来，包括Baskin-Robbins和Dunkin'。Hur说：“我们与韩国食品银行于1998年建立的食品共享伙伴关系，是28年来始终珍视的承诺。我们将继续努力，为构建更温暖、更健康的社会作出贡献。”该公司表示，截至今年上半年，其关联公司和加盟商累计捐赠价值3440亿韩元（2.57亿美元）的食品，约占食品银行全部捐赠的10%。Sangmidang称，这一数字在韩国食品企业中处于最高水平。Sangmidang表示，韩国约有1,200家企业参与了食品捐赠，过去五年的年度捐赠额平均为170亿韩元

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: AMCHAM raises $127,000 for student scholarships
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: The American Chamber of Commerce in Korea (AMCHAM) raised a record 175 million won ($127,000) for university scholarships at its annual charity event on Tuesday, bringing together business leaders to support students from financially disadvantaged backgrounds. Organized by AMCHAM’s Partners for the Future Foundation, the event featured 44 CEOs and senior executives from member companies volunteering as servers, personally serving dinner to approximately 440 guests.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 美国商会驻韩国机构（AMCHAM）周二在年度慈善活动上筹集了创纪录的1.75亿韩元（$127,000），用于大学助学金。该活动汇聚商界领袖，支持来自经济困难家庭的学生。活动由AMCHAM的未来伙伴基金会组织，44家会员公司的首席执行官和高级管理人员担任志愿者服务员，亲手为约440名宾客上菜。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: The American Chamber of Commerce in Korea (AMCHAM) raised a record 175 million won ($127,000) for university scholarships at its annual charity event on Tuesday, bringing together business leaders to support students from financially disadvantaged backgrounds. The total marked a 17 percent increase from the 150 million won raised a year earlier. Organized by AMCHAM’s Partners for the Future Foundation, the event featured 44 CEOs and senior executives from member companies volunteering as servers, personally serving dinner to approximately 440 guests. The number of executive volunteers increased from 41 last year. Now in its 19th year, CEO Servers’ Night is one of AMCHAM’s signature charity events, bringing business leaders out of their boardrooms to serve guests and raise funds for university students in financial need. “CEO Servers’ Night brings business leaders together in a different capacity, united by a common purpose: helping students pursue their education,” AMCHAM Chairman James Kim said. Kim said the record fundraising reflected the business community’s commitment to supporting the next generation, adding that the foundation would continue helping students overcome financial barriers to higher education. Established in 2000, the Partners for the Future Foundation has awarded scholarships to 5,000 students and currently supports approximately 200 students annually through contributions from AMCHAM member companies

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Global food service and restaurant franchise operator, Theborn Korea, has partnered with Italian oven manufacturer UNOX to program its standardized recipes into commercial equipment, paving the way for an automated K-food rollout across Europe. Theborn Korea said Wednesday it signed a memorandum of understanding with UNOX on Nov. 4 at the Italian company's headquarters, combining its expertise in Korean cuisine and TBK sauces with UNOX's commercial cooking technology. Under the agreement, the companies will test Korean dishes using 11 varieties of TBK sauces and convert cooking conditions into data to develop standardized recipes and operating manuals. The goal is to allow local restaurant workers with little experience preparing Korean food to produce dishes with consistent taste and quality using UNOX smart ovens. Founded in 1990, UNOX specializes in commercial smart ovens and recorded global revenue of 360 million euros (540.6 billion won) last year, according to Theborn Korea. Its product lineup includes convection ovens, which use circulating hot air for even cooking, and combination ovens that integrate hot air and steam. The latter can automatically control cooking time, temperature and humidity through programmed recipes, with more than 1,000 cooking programs already available. Theborn Korea expects the partnership to introduce TBK sauces to international food buyers and chefs attending cooking demonstrations at UNOX headquarters. The company also plans to invite global food and retail industry representatives to its Korean headquarters for demonstrations showcasing how its sauces can simplify the preparation of Korean dishes. The partnership forms one part of Theborn Korea's broader European expansion strategy, alongside its food consulting collaboration with German retail group Globus, which has already introduced TBK sauces and standardized Korean recipes at two hypermarket food courts. "This agreement will create new business opportunities in the European market by combining Theborn Korea's expertise in developing Korean dishes using TBK sauces with UNOX's cooking technology," a company official said. "We will continue aggressive sales activities to make Korean cuisine more accessible to overseas customers through recipes using TBK sauces while expanding our global business," the official added. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 全球餐饮服务及餐厅特许经营运营商Theborn Korea与意大利烤箱制造商UNOX达成合作，将其标准化食谱编程至商用设备中，为韩餐在欧洲的自动化推广铺平道路。Theborn Korea周三表示，双方已于11月4日在UNOX意大利公司总部签署谅解备忘录，将Theborn Korea在韩国料理及TBK酱料方面的专长与UNOX的商用烹饪技术相结合。根据协议，两家公司将使用11种TBK酱料测试韩国菜品，并将烹饪条件转化为数据，以开发标准化食谱和操作手册。其目标是让缺乏韩餐制作经验的当地餐厅工作人员，也能利用UNOX智能烤箱制作出味道和品质保持一致的菜品。据Theborn Korea介绍，UNOX成立于1990年，专注于商用智能烤箱，去年全球营收为3.6亿欧元（5,406亿韩元）。其产品系列包括以循环热风实现均匀烹饪的热风烤箱，以及集成热风和蒸汽的多功能烤箱。后者可依据预设食谱自动控制烹饪时间、温度和湿度，目前已有1,000多个烹饪程序。Theborn Korea预计，此次合作将把TBK酱料推向国际食品采购商，以及参加UNOX总部烹饪演示的厨师。该公司还计划邀请全球食品及零售行业代表赴其韩国总部参加演示，展示其酱料如何简化韩国菜品的制作。此次合作是Theborn Korea欧洲扩张战略的一部分；此外，该公司还与德国零售集团Globus开展食品咨询合作，后者已在两处大型超市美食区推出TBK酱料和标准化韩国食谱。一名公司官员表示：“这项协议将Theborn Korea利用TBK酱料开发韩国菜品的专长与UNOX的烹饪技术相结合，从而在欧洲市场创造新的商业机会。”该官员补充道：“我们将继续积极开展销售活动，通过使用TBK酱料的食谱让海外客户更容易接触韩国料理，同时拓展全球业务。”本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: A revision of the Chiang Mai Initiative Multilateralisation (CMIM), a multilateral currency swap arrangement among Korea, China, Japan and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), took effect Wednesday, the Bank of Korea said. All 13 members of the ASEAN+3 group have completed their internal procedures for signing the revised agreement, which was endorsed at the ASEAN+3 Finance Ministers' and Central Bank Governors' Meeting in May 2025, according to the BOK. The revised CMIM includes the Rapid Financing Facility, which provides prompt financial assistance to members facing urgent balance of payments needs. It took effect Wednesday, seven days after the completion of the signing procedures, the central bank said. Launched in 2010, the CMIM is a multilateral currency swap arrangement among ASEAN+3 members aimed at providing liquidity to member economies in times of financial crisis. The facility has a total pool of $240 billion, with Korea contributing $38.4 billion

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Gwanghwamun Square in downtown Seoul will glow blue Wednesday evening, as Seoul invites residents and visitors to honor United Nations veterans whose sacrifices helped defend Korea's freedom and peace during the 1950-53 Korean War. The Seoul Metropolitan Government will hold a public memorial at the Garden of Gratitude on Wednesday, marking UN Veterans International Memorial Day with candlelight, a special lighting ceremony and opportunities for citizens to share messages of appreciation. The evening program will begin after sunset with a candle-lighting event, allowing visitors to receive free LED candles and gather around the installation known as Lights of Gratitude 23. At 8 p.m., 23 lights representing countries that sent troops to the Korean War will glow blue, the color associated with the United Nations. The lights will turn on and off in sequence 23 times, symbolizing gratitude to the countries and veterans who contributed to defending Korea. Visitors will also be invited to write messages of remembrance and appreciation at stations near the installation and the entrance to Freedom Hall, an underground exhibition space at the site. The messages will be displayed on a memorial wall along Freedom Hall's staircase through Sunday, allowing visitors to reflect on the veterans' contributions beyond the main ceremony. The city will also provide photo props for participants, including international visitors, and encourage people to share their experiences through social media hashtags, including #UNVeteransInternationalMemorialDay_Gwanghwamun and #GardenOfGratitude. The annual memorial day honors U.N. veterans who fought to protect Korea during the Korean War and recognizes their contributions alongside those of the countries they represented. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh: 首尔市中心的广华门广场将于周三晚闪耀蓝光，首尔市邀请当地居民和访客向联合国老兵致敬。1950年至1953年朝鲜战争期间，这些老兵为捍卫朝鲜的自由与和平作出了牺牲。首尔市政府将于周三在感恩花园举行公众纪念活动，通过点亮蜡烛、特别灯光仪式以及邀请市民分享感言，纪念联合国老兵国际纪念日。晚间活动将在日落后以点灯仪式开始，访者可免费领取LED蜡烛，并聚集在名为“感恩之光23”的灯光装置周围。晚上8时，23盏代表派兵参加朝鲜战争国家的灯光将亮起蓝色，这种颜色与联合国有关。灯光将依次明灭23次，象征对为保卫朝鲜作出贡献的国家和老兵表达感激。访者还可受邀在灯光装置附近及自由厅入口处的写字台写下缅怀和感谢留言。自由厅是现场的地下展览空间。这些留言将展示在自由厅楼梯旁的纪念墙上，持续至周日，让访者在主仪式结束后继续缅怀老兵所作的贡献。市政府还将为参与者提供拍照道具，包括国际访客使用的道具，并鼓励人们通过社交媒体标签分享体验，包括#UNVeteransInternationalMemorialDay_Gwanghwamun和#GardenOfGratitude。这个年度纪念日向朝鲜战争期间为保护朝鲜而战的联合国老兵致敬，并肯定他们及其所代表国家的贡献。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: Turbulent geopolitics: 'Korean Dream' initiative can be a path forward
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: Because South Korea must present the oppressed North Korean people with a clear constitutional vision and blueprint for their future, we must look to the “Korean Dream” — a vision for unified Korea rooted in our shared national identity.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 由于韩国必须向受压迫的朝鲜人民展示清晰的宪政愿景和未来蓝图，我们必须展望“韩国梦想”——这一以共同民族身份为基础、实现统一朝鲜国的愿景。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: As the Sinamrok River Bridge — a core logistical gateway on the North Korea–China border — officially opens and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un makes a visit to Dandong, China, the Northeast Asian geopolitical landscape is rapidly restructuring into a tightly knit North Korea–China–Russia axis. Having gained nuclear capabilities, North Korea has secured external and economic safeguards through China and Russia, emboldening Kim Jong-un to aggressively push his “hostile two-state doctrine” and sever all ties with South Korea. This tectonic shift not only renders South Korea’s traditional appeasement policies obsolete but also diminishes any realistic expectations for meaningful breakthroughs in potential future U.S.–North Korea summits. With China and Russia actively ignoring international sanctions, Kim has no structural incentive to compromise with Washington or rush into dialogue for sanctions relief, effectively neutralizing America's primary leverage. While a nuclear-armed Kim regime backed by Beijing and Moscow may appear impregnable from the outside, a fatal flaw lies within North Korea itself. Deprived of freedom and human rights under strict information blockades for eight decades, the North Korean populace suffers under extreme poverty and oppression. Kim’s diplomatic maneuvers are calculated political steps designed strictly to preserve his autocratic rule, not to improve the lives of his people. As Dr. Hyun Jin Preston Moon, chairman of the Global Peace Foundation (GPF), pointed out at the recent One Korea International Forum, North Korea’s decision to abandon unification and declare its two-state doctrine presents a strategic window of opportunity for South Korea to seize the initiative on peninsular unification. Renouncing unification directly contradicts the instructions of Kim’s predecessors, Kim Il-sung and Kim Jong-il, and effectively negates the North Korean regime's own identity — a contradiction that places Pyongyang in an extremely awkward position if South Korea responds proactively. From a historical perspective, the North Korean regime was never a legitimate successor to the Korean nation and its heritage. The Republic of Korea is the sole legitimate government representing the freedom and prosperity of the Korean people on the peninsula, whereas the North Korean regime originated under the shadow of foreign Soviet influence. Its recent deployment of troops to the Russia–Ukraine war serves as stark proof that it remains nothing more than a puppet state. As explicitly stated in Article 4 of the Constitution of the Republic of Korea, the ultimate objective of inter-Korean policy must always be peaceful unification based on the basic order of free democracy. The target of this strategy must be the North Korean people, not an illegitimate regime that acts as a foreign proxy. Because South Korea must present the oppressed North Korean people with a clear constitutional vision and blueprint for their future, we must look to the “Korean Dream” — a vision for unified Korea rooted in our shared national identity. Anchored in the founding principle of "Hongik Ingan (to benefit all humanity)," the Korean Dream delivers hope — human rights, liberty and economic prosperity — to the oppressed people of the North while empowering Koreans on both sides of the border as active agents of unification. Simultaneously, it deters provocations through a steadfast South Korea–U.S. alliance and trilateral security cooperation with Japan while presenting neighboring powers with a compelling rationale of a unified Korea as a model state contributing to Northeast Asian stability and global peace. A peaceful, Korean-led unification is a moral imperative the international community cannot reject and a win-win resolution for all neighboring nations. First, adopt the "Korean Dream" as official national policy. The South Korean government should immediately adopt the Korean Dream as its formal unification framework. Moving past short-term approaches that fluctuate with changing political administrations, South Korea must re-anchor its national narrative on an enduring bipartisan vision. Second, it is necessary to transition from the Ministry of Unification to a civil-led unification committee. The current Ministry of Unification — often weaponized for political agendas — should be replaced by a non-partisan, citizen-driven "Civil Unification Committee." Moving away from bureaucratic, state-to-state transactions, civil society and grassroots initiatives at home and abroad must be led by unification discourse and civic exchanges. Third, we must integrate the Korean Dream into national education. The core concepts of the Korean Dream should be incorporated into the K–12 public school curriculum. By educating future generations to view unification not as a financial burden but as a historic opportunity for restoring human rights and a national leap forward, South Korea can overcome growing skepticism among its youth. Even amidst the geopolitical headwinds of the North Korea–China–Russia realignment, commitment to a unified Korean Peninsula must not waver. By projecting a vision rooted in national identity and universal values alongside a robust security posture, South Korea can liberate the North Korean people and bring genuine peace and prosperity to Northeast Asia. Seo In-teck is the standing chairman of Action for Korea United. He is a civic leader dedicated to advancing the Korean Dream vision and promoting citizen-led initiatives for a free and unified Korea

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 随着新鸭绿桥——朝鲜与中国边境的核心物流门户——正式启用，朝鲜领导人金正恩访问中国丹东，东北亚地缘政治格局正迅速重组为紧密相连的朝鲜—中国—俄罗斯轴心。朝鲜获得核能力后，借助中国和俄罗斯获得外部与经济保障，使金正恩更有底气积极推进其“敌对两朝论”，并切断与韩国的一切联系。这一结构性转变不仅使韩国传统的绥靖政策失去作用，也降低了未来任何潜在的美朝峰会取得实质性突破的现实可能性。在中国和俄罗斯公开无视国际制裁的情况下，金正恩没有结构性动力与华盛顿妥协，也不会急于通过对话换取解除制裁，从而实质上抵消了美国的主要杠杆。尽管得到北京和莫斯科支持的拥核金氏政权从外部看似坚不可摧，但朝鲜内部却存在致命缺陷。在长达八十年严格封锁信息、剥夺自由和人权的状态下，朝鲜民众生活困苦，遭受极端贫穷与压迫。金正恩的外交斡旋只是经过精密盘算的政治步骤，其目的严格在于保住自己的专制统治，而非改善人民的生活。正如全球和平基金会（GPF）主席 Hyun Jin Preston Moon 博士在近期举行的“一韩国际论坛”上所指出的，朝鲜决定放弃统一并宣布“两朝论”，为韩国抢占半岛统一的主动权创造了战略机遇。放弃统一直接违背金正恩的前任金日成和金正日的指示，也实际上否定了朝鲜政权自身的身份认同；如果韩国采取积极回应，平壤将陷入极其尴尬的处境。从历史角度看，朝鲜政权从来都不是朝鲜民族与文化遗产的合法继承者。大韩民国是代表半岛上朝鲜人民自由与繁荣的唯一合法政府，而朝鲜政权则是在外国苏联势力影响的阴影下产生的。其近期向俄罗斯—乌克兰战争派遣 troops，构成一个 stark 证明：它仍然不过是一个傀儡政权。《大韩民国宪法》第4条明确规定，朝韩政策的最终目标始终必须是以自由民主的基本秩序为基础的和平统一。这一战略的对象必须是朝鲜人民，而不是充当外国代理人的非法政权。由于韩国必须向受压迫的朝鲜人民明确展示未来的宪政愿景与蓝图，我们必须展望“韩国梦”——一种植根于共同民族认同的统一朝鲜愿景。韩国梦以“弘益人间”（造福全人类）的建国原则为基础，为北方受压迫的人民带来希望——人权、自由和经济繁荣——同时赋能边境两侧的朝鲜人成为统一的积极推动者。与此同时，韩国通过坚定的韩美同盟以及与日本的三方安全合作，威慑挑衅，并向周边国家阐明统一后的韩国作为促进东北亚稳定与全球和平的示范国家所具有的吸引力。由朝鲜主导的和平统一，是国际社会无法拒绝的道德使命，也是所有邻国实现互利共赢的解决方案。第一，将“韩国梦”确定为正式的国家政策。韩国政府应立即将韩国梦作为正式的统一框架。韩国必须摆脱随政治当局更替而摇摆的短期做法，将国家叙事重新锚定于持久的 bipartisan 愿景。第二，有必要从统一部转型为由公民主导的统一委员会。经常被用作政治议程工具的现任统一部，应由无党派、由公民推动的“公民统一委员会”取代。统一工作应摆脱官僚式的国家间交易，转而由统一 discourse 和民间交流来引领国内外的公民社会与基层倡议。第三，我们必须将韩国梦纳入国民教育。韩国梦的核心概念应纳入韩国K–12公立学校课程。通过教育后代把统一视为恢复人权、推动民族跃升的历史机遇，而非财政负担，韩国可以克服年轻一代中日益增长的疑虑。即使朝鲜—中国—俄罗斯重新结盟带来地缘政治逆风，对统一朝鲜半岛的承诺也绝不能动摇。只要韩国在展现植根于民族认同和普世价值的愿景时，同时保持强有力的安全态势，就能解放朝鲜人民，并为东北亚带来真正的和平与繁荣。Seo In-teck 是 Action for Korea United 的常任主席。他是一位公民领袖，致力于推动韩国梦愿景，并倡导由公民主导的自由统一朝鲜倡议

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body: Korea's exports more than doubled in the first 10 days of November from a year earlier, customs data showed Wednesday, bringing the country closer to reaching $1 trillion in annual exports. Outbound shipments reached $33.5 billion in the Nov. 1-10 period, compared with $15.7 billion a year earlier, according to data from the Korea Customs Service. It was the highest export value recorded for the first 10 days of any November. Imports rose 45 percent on-year to $24.7 billion over the cited period, resulting in a trade surplus of $8.8 billion. By sector, exports of chips soared 331.2 percent to $16.6 billion. Semiconductors accounted for 49.7 percent of the total outbound shipments, up 25.3 percentage points from a year earlier. Outbound shipments of petroleum products also more than doubled to $2 billion over the period. Exports of cars, on the other hand, fell 4.3 percent to $1.4 billion. By destination, exports to China vaulted 148 percent to $9.16 billion, while those to the United States surged 163.6 percent to $6.79 billion. Cumulative exports this year through Tuesday, meanwhile, reached $963.6 billion, putting South Korea on track to surpass $1 trillion in annual exports for the first time ever. The cumulative trade surplus over the same period stood at $303.7 billion
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body_zh: 韩国关税厅周三公布的数据显示，韩国11月前10天的出口额较去年同期增长一倍以上，使该国更接近实现1万亿美元年度出口额的目标。根据韩国关税厅的数据，11月1日至10日期间，韩国出口额达到335亿美元，而去年同期为157亿美元。这是历任何一个11月前10天录得的最高出口额。同期进口额同比增长45%，达到247亿美元，顺差为88亿美元。按行业划分，芯片出口额飙升331.2%，达到166亿美元。半导体占出口总额的49.7%，较去年同期上升25.3个百分点。同期石油产品出口额也增长一倍以上，达到20亿美元。与此同时，汽车出口额下降4.3%，为14亿美元。按目的地划分，对中国出口额跃升148%，达到91.6亿美元；对美国出口额激增163.6%，达到67.9亿美元。与此同时，截至本周二，韩国今年累计出口额达到9636亿美元，使该国有望首次实现1万亿美元年度出口额。同期累计贸易顺差为3037亿美元

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显强调、相互尊重与信任是两国关系的基础。韩国外交部周二表示，他与乌克兰外长安德烈·西比哈举行会谈时强调了这一观点。这是两国自乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基于9月披露将两名朝鲜战俘移交韩国以来首次举行的会谈。此前，两国因这一事件产生了日益严重的分歧。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: FMs meet for 1st time since rift over confidentiality of NK POW transfer Foreign Minister Cho Hyun stressed mutual respect and trust as the foundation for bilateral relations during his talks with Ukrainian counterpart Andrii Sybiha, the Korean foreign ministry said Tuesday. It was their first meeting since a deepening rift emerged between the two countries over Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's September disclosure of the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war (POWs) to South Korea. Their discussion took place on the sidelines of the Group of Seven Foreign Ministers’ Meeting in France on Tuesday (local time). "Cho stressed that mutual respect, trust and the faithful implementation of agreements between countries are fundamental prerequisites for developing bilateral relations, expressing hope that all pending issues between the two countries will be resolved amicably," the ministry said in a press release. The remarks are being interpreted as a repetition of the South Korean government’s demand for Ukraine to apologize for the disclosure, which Seoul claims the two sides had agreed to keep confidential. The ministry’s statement, however, did not state whether the two ministers directly talked about the POW issue. In response, Sybiha called for continued diplomatic efforts to manage and advance bilateral ties in a stable manner, according to the release. The tensions stem from Zelenskyy's announcement during a United Nations General Assembly speech on Sept. 23 that two North Korean POWs had been transferred to South Korea. The North Korean soldiers were captured while fighting for Russia in Ukraine in 2025. Lee expressed disappointment on X (formerly Twitter) the following day, saying Ukraine had breached the agreement to keep the transfer confidential. Kyiv denied that such an agreement existed, prompting Cheong Wa Dae to demand an explanation and apology on Sept. 27. After South Korea said it received only what it described as an "insufficient" apology from the Ukrainian side, it recalled its ambassador to Ukraine, Park Ki-chang, and withdrew some embassy personnel from the country in October, citing Kyiv's failure to take steps to resolve the dispute, along with persistent threats of Russian airstrikes. Despite the tensions, the South Korean government decided to provide $100 million in humanitarian aid to Ukraine from its 2027 budget, which also covers contributions to a NATO trust fund and other programs. Cho said that South Korea remains firmly committed to supporting Ukraine as a responsible member of the international community. He added that Seoul will keep exploring ways to deliver essential humanitarian aid and support Ukraine's reconstruction
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 韩国外交部长在与乌克兰外长会晤后强调维护双边互信
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh:
就朝鲜战俘移交保密问题产生裂痕后，韩国外长赵显首次会晤乌方外长。韩国韩国外交部周二表示，赵显在与乌克兰外长安德烈·瑟比哈会谈时强调、相互尊重和信任是发展双边关系的基础。韩国《韩民族日报》报道，这是两国自乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基9月披露将两名朝鲜战俘移交给韩国以来，双方外长首次会面。报道援引韩国外交部周二发布的新闻稿称，双方于当地时间周二在法国举行的七国集团外长会议期间进行了会谈。

韩国外交部在新闻稿中表示：“赵显强调，相互尊重、信任以及忠实履行国家间协议，是发展双边关系的根本前提，并希望两国之间所有悬而未决的问题都能通过友好方式解决。”

分析人士认为，这番表态是在重申韩国政府的要求，即要求乌克兰就披露战俘移交一事道歉。韩国方面称，双方此前约定对这一移交行动保密。不过，该声明没有说明两位外长是否直接讨论了战俘问题。

据报道，瑟比哈在回应中呼吁继续通过外交努力，以稳定的方式管理和推进双边关系。

紧张局势源于泽连斯基9月23日在联合国大会发言时宣布，两名朝鲜战俘已被移交给韩国。这两名朝鲜士兵是在2025年于乌克兰为俄罗斯作战时被抓获的。

李在明随后一天在X（原Twitter）上表示失望，称乌克兰违反了关于对战俘移交一事保密的协议。基辅方面否认双方存在此类协议，促使青瓦台要求乌方作出解释并于9月27日道歉。

在韩国表示其只收到乌方所谓“不充分的”道歉后，韩国于10月召回了驻乌克兰大使朴基昌，并从该国撤回了部分使馆人员，理由包括基辅未采取行动解决争端，以及俄罗斯空袭威胁持续存在。

尽管双方关系紧张，韩国政府仍决定从2027年预算中向乌克兰提供1亿美元人道主义援助。这笔预算还包括向北约信托基金和其他项目的捐款。

赵显表示，韩国作为国际社会负责任的一员，仍将坚定支持乌克兰。他补充说，首尔将继续寻找向乌克兰运送人道主义援助物资并支持其重建的方法

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: WASHINGTON — Human Rights Watch (HRW) has urged the United Nations to address North Korea's human rights situation alongside security issues in future diplomatic engagement with Pyongyang. In a commentary published Monday, the New York-based rights group, citing a recent U.N. report highlighting deepening repression in the country, said the U.N. General Assembly should recommend that future dialogue with North Korea address human rights and security concerns together, rather than treating them as separate issues. "Security and rights issues need to be addressed together. The U.N. General Assembly has the power to forge these connections, even as the Security Council remains deadlocked," Audrey Gregg, HRW's senior coordinator for Asia, wrote in a commentary published Monday. "Security and rights issues need to be addressed together. Gregg added that North Korean rights issues should not be displaced by the focus on security issues, as the United States and South Korea pursue diplomatic dialogues with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un. The commentary came after U.N. Special Rapporteur Elizabeth Salmon presented a report on North Korea's human rights situation to a U.N. General Assembly committee on Oct. 27. It highlighted North Korea's increased use of public executions, expanded surveillance and tighter restrictions on basic freedoms, according to HRW. Gregg also argued that North Korea's human rights violations, particularly forced labor, are closely linked to its nuclear weapons program, citing previous U.N. findings. "The government devotes massive resources to maintaining its nuclear weapons and missile stockpiles while many North Koreans face chronic hunger," Gregg wrote

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: For many consumers, paying by card or mobile phone has become the new normal as Korea moves toward a cashless society. Starbucks Korea introduced cashless stores at 103 locations nationwide in November 2018, accepting only cards and mobile payments. Among them, 45.8 percent opposed a cashless society, compared with 17.7 percent who supported it.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 随着韩国迈向无现金社会，对许多消费者而言，刷卡或使用手机支付已成为新常态。韩国星巴克于2018年11月在全韩103家门店推出无现金商店，只接受银行卡和移动支付。其中，45.8%的人反对无现金社会，而支持者为17.7%。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: A 67-year-old man surnamed Cho living in Bucheon, Gyeonggi Province, recently tried to pay for a cup of coffee at Starbucks with cash, only to be told that the store accepted only credit cards and mobile payments. "I just wanted to pay in cash, but they told me it had been the store's long-standing policy not to accept it. I knew most people paid by card these days, but I never expected a store to refuse cash altogether," he said. "Since then, I've made sure to always carry a card." His experience comes as cash is becoming harder to use in everyday life in Korea, with more cafes, buses and even bank branches moving away from physical payments. For many consumers, paying by card or mobile phone has become the new normal as Korea moves toward a cashless society. But for those who still rely on cash, the growing number of places that no longer accept it is making everyday purchases increasingly difficult. The shift has been underway in the retail sector for years. Starbucks Korea introduced cashless stores at 103 locations nationwide in November 2018, accepting only cards and mobile payments. The practice has since expanded. In the public transportation sector, the Seoul Metropolitan Government began piloting cashless buses in 2021. As of April this year, 180 of the city's 394 bus routes were operating without cash payments. The move is now reaching the banking sector, with some banks operating branches that do not handle cash and checks. KB Kookmin Bank, which opened its first cashless branch in Gimpo, Gyeonggi Province, in 2019, now operates six such locations after adding four this year. iM Bank opened a cashless branch in Wonju, Gangwon Province, in 2024, while BNK Busan Bank launched two such branches in Seoul in January last year. Citibank Korea is also set to stop handling cash and checks at its Gangnam branch starting in December. However, data shows that cash remains an important payment method for some Koreans, particularly older people and lower-income households. According to the Bank of Korea's 2025 Payment and Settlement Report, individuals spent an average of 324,000 won ($240) in cash per month, accounting for 17.4 percent of their total spending. The share was higher among people aged 70 and older, at 32.4 percent, compared with 14.7 percent among those in their 20s. The gap was wider across income groups. People earning less than 1 million won a month spent 59.4 percent of their monthly expenditures in cash, compared with 15.1 percent among those earning 9 million won or more. A 2025 central bank survey conducted among 2,000 adults suggested that many consumers are reluctant to give up cash. Among them, 45.8 percent opposed a cashless society, compared with 17.7 percent who supported it. The central bank warned that consumers with limited digital literacy could suffer more as an increasing number of businesses and services refuse to accept cash. "Consumers with lower levels of digital literacy are expected to experience greater declines in consumer welfare as cashless stores and services become more widespread. Elderly people, in particular, are likely to be disproportionately affected, as they tend to rely more heavily on cash and have lower levels of digital literacy," it said in a report published in 2025. "Policy measures should be introduced to promote cash acceptance. In the long term, there also should be measures to ensure that digitally disadvantaged groups can easily use new payment methods."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 韩国迈向无现金社会，老年人却落在身后
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 京畿道富川市一名67岁的赵姓男子近日试图用现金在星巴克买一杯咖啡，却被告知该店只接受信用卡和移动支付。他说：“我只是想用现金付款，但他们告诉我，这家店长期以来一直都不收现金。我知道如今大多数人都刷卡付款，但我从没想到一家商店会完全拒绝现金。”他说：“从那以后，我每次出门都会确保随身带着银行卡。”随着韩国日常生活中越来越难以使用现金，更多咖啡馆、公交车甚至银行网点放弃接受现金支付，这名男子的经历正是这一趋势的体现。随着韩国迈向无现金社会，对许多消费者而言，刷卡或使用手机付款已成为新常态。但对仍依赖现金的人来说，日益增多、不再接受现金的场所正让日常购物变得越来越困难。这种转变在零售业已持续多年。2018年11月，星巴克韩国在全国103家门店推出无现金商店，只接受银行卡和移动支付，此后这一做法不断扩大。在公共交通领域，首尔市政府于2021年开始试点无现金公交。截至今年4月，该市394条公交线路中有180条不收现金。这一举措现已延伸至银行业，一些银行开设了不办理现金和支票业务的网点。KB国民银行于2019年在京畿道金浦开设首家无现金银行网点，今年新增4家后，目前共有6家同类网点。iM银行于2024月在江原道原州开设无现金银行网点，BNK釜山银行则于去年1月在首尔推出两家同类网点。花旗银行韩国也计划从12月起停止办理江南分行的现金和支票业务。然而，数据显示，现金对部分韩国人而言仍是重要的支付方式，尤其是老年人和低收入家庭。根据韩国银行《2025年支付与结算报告》，个人每月平均使用现金324,000韩元（$240），占其总支出的17.4%。70岁及以上人群的这一比例较高，达到32.4%，而20多岁人群则为14.7%。不同收入群体之间的差距更大。月收入低于100万韩元的人将每月支出的59.4%用于现金，而月收入达到900万韩元或以上的人，这一比例仅为15.1%。韩国银行2025年对2,000名成年人开展的调查显示，许多消费者不愿放弃现金。其中45.8%的人反对无现金社会，支持者为17.7%。韩国银行警告称，随着越来越多商家和服务拒绝接受现金、数字素养有限的消费者可能遭受更大影响。该行在2025年发布的一份报告中称：“随着无现金商店和服务日益普及，数字素养较低的消费者预计将面临更大的消费者福利下降。尤其是老年人，由于他们往往更依赖现金，且数字素养较低，因此很可能受到不成比例的影响。”报告说：“应出台政策措施，推动商家接受现金。从长远来看，还应采取措施，确保在数字技术方面处于不利地位的群体能够轻松使用新的支付方式。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.title: How Disney+'s 'The Remarried Empress' wins over Gen Z, global viewers
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.summary: Disney+’s new Korean original series "The Remarried Empress" features Korean actors addressing one another with Western names while navigating a fictional European-style empire in elaborate gowns and military uniforms. Within just three days of release, the drama officially became the most-watched Disney+ local original series of all time worldwide, based on cumulative global views.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.summary_zh: Disney+的新韩国原创剧集《再婚皇后》讲述了韩国演员身穿华丽礼服和军装，在一个虚构的欧洲风格帝国中彼此以西方名字相称的故事。该剧上线仅3天，便根据全球累计观看量，正式成为Disney+历史上全球观看人数最多的本地原创剧集。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.body: Disney+’s new Korean original series "The Remarried Empress" features Korean actors addressing one another with Western names while navigating a fictional European-style empire in elaborate gowns and military uniforms. When the initial teaser trailers were released, some viewers expressed skepticism, comparing the visual aesthetic to a cosplay convention. However, upon its official premiere on Nov. 3, the series completely shattered expectations. Within just three days of release, the drama officially became the most-watched Disney+ local original series of all time worldwide, based on cumulative global views. Based on the wildly popular web novel and webtoon of the same name, "The Remarried Empress" follows Navier (Shin Min-a), the perfect empress of the Eastern Empire. When her husband, Emperor Sovieshu (Ju Ji-hoon), demands a divorce to elevate his mistress, Navier accepts — on the condition that she be granted approval to remarry Heinrey (Lee Jong-suk), prince of the Western Kingdom. The show quickly dominated international streaming charts. According to global tracking data, "The Remarried Empress" surged to No. 1 in 33 countries and regions while soaring to No. 2 overall on Disney+’s global TV rankings, standing right behind Marvel's "Vision Quest." Domestically and regionally, it locked down the top spot in Korea, Hong Kong, Taiwan and Japan, while sweeping weekly Korean drama buzzworthiness rankings. To capitalize on the show's immersive world-building, Disney+ recently opened an interactive pop-up store in Seongsu-dong, Seongdong District, Seoul. Running until Sunday, visitors are greeted as "Lady" or "Lord" and given custom nobility titles, inviting fans directly into the romance fantasy universe. At the entrance, visitors provide their information to receive custom imperial guest badges with a world-appropriate name and country of origin. Inside, attendees explore meticulously recreated sets of Empress Navier’s private quarters, including her bedroom and writing suite. The pop-up also showcases actual dresses and accessories worn by Shin Min-a, bringing the webtoon's grand mise-en-scène into reality. In an interactive photo booth, visitors sit on a royal throne as half a dozen attendants shower them with theatrical compliments. "I stumbled upon the pop-up while walking by and waited about 10 minutes to get in," said Kim Bo-mi, a 21-year-old university student. "I had only watched short clips of the show before, but feeling like an empress in real life was so much fun. Sitting on the throne while butler staff fawned over me was a bit embarrassing, but being treated like 'Lady Dravea' for a day made me really want to watch the full series." A K-content creator in her late 30s shared her experience on social media. "The staff were so sweet — my heart completely melted. They engaged in playful small talk and kept telling me how beautiful I looked, which made the experience unforgettable," she said. Culture critic Jung Duk-hyun highlighted the show's daring genre expansion. "There is a surprisingly addictive pull to the show. While the core story follows familiar romance-fantasy tropes, the unfamiliar European setting — complete with grand palaces, lavish balls and high-society political intrigue — becomes remarkably refreshing when portrayed by Korean actors," he said. "Even in an era where fantasy elements are widely accepted, K-dramas are still traditionally expected to ground themselves in reality. Portraying a Western-style romance where characters casually transform into birds is a provocative leap. Yet, this gamble works because of its high execution quality," Jung explained. "Despite the initial unfamiliarity, the lavish set design, costume direction,\ and subdued, grounded directing style prevent the fantasy from feeling floaty. Anchored by heavy, stable performances from Ju and Shin, alongside striking visual fits from Lee Jong-suk and Lee Se-young, the show lands its ambitious vision."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.title_zh: Disney+剧集《再婚女皇》如何赢得Z世代和全球观众
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.body_zh: Disney+的新韩国原创剧集《重婚后皇》讲述韩国演员在一个虚构的欧洲式帝国中穿着华丽礼服和军装，彼此以西方名字相称的故事。首支预告片发布时，一些观众心存质疑，将该剧的视觉风格比作漫展。然而，该剧于11月3日正式首播后，彻底打破了人们的预期。根据累计全球观看量，该剧上线仅3天，便正式成为Disney+历史上全球观看人数最多的本地原创剧集。《重婚后皇》改编自同名热门网络小说和网络漫画，讲述东方帝国完美皇后的故事。纳维耶（信敏雅饰）的丈夫索维许皇帝（朱智勋饰）为迎娶情人而要求与她离婚，纳维耶接受了这一决定，但条件是获准改嫁西方王国海因里王子（李钟硕饰）。该剧迅速登顶国际流媒体榜单。全球追踪数据显示，《重婚后皇》在33个国家和地区升至第1位，在Disney+全球电视剧排名中跃居总榜第2，仅次于漫威的《视界 quests》。在韩国本土及整个地区，该剧包揽韩国、中国香港、中国台湾和日本地区的第1名，并横扫韩国周播剧集热度排行榜。为充分发挥该剧沉浸式世界观的吸引力，Disney+最近在首尔城东区圣水洞开设了一家互动快闪店。活动持续至周日，到店访客会受到“女士”或“阁下”的欢迎，并获赐专属贵族头衔，仿佛直接进入该剧的浪漫奇幻世界。访客在入口登记个人资料，即可领取带有符合世界观设定的姓名和原籍国家的定制皇室宾客徽章。店内，访客可以探索细致还原的纳维耶皇后私人居所布景，包括她的卧室和书房。快闪店还陈列了信敏雅在剧中实际穿戴的礼服与配饰，将网络漫画的华丽场景变为现实。在互动照相亭里，访客坐上王座，六名侍从争相向其献上戏剧化的赞美。21岁的大学生金宝米说：“我路过时发现了这家快闪店，排队等了大约10分钟才进去。此前我只看过该剧的一些短片，但在现实中当皇后的感觉太有趣了。坐在王座上被管家员工追捧让我有些不好意思，不过当一天‘ dravea女士’确实让我非常想看完这部剧。”一位30多岁的K内容创作者在社交媒体上分享了自己的体验。她说：“工作人员非常亲切，彻底融化了我的心。他们会和我轻松闲聊，还不断告诉我有多漂亮，这让这次体验难以忘怀。”文化评论家郑德贤强调了该剧大胆拓展题材类型的重要性。他说：“这部剧有一种出人意料的吸引力。虽然核心故事采用了人们熟悉的浪漫奇幻套路，但由韩国演员出演的陌生欧洲背景——宏伟的宫殿、奢华的舞会和上流社会的政治阴谋——显得格外令人耳目一新。”他说：“即便在奇幻元素已被广泛接受的时代，K剧传统上仍被要求立足现实。描绘一段西方风格的爱情故事，其中角色还能随意变成鸟，是一种颇具挑衅意味的跨越。然而，这次冒险之所以成功，是因为其制作水准很高。”郑解释道：“尽管起初存在陌生感，但华丽的布景设计、服装造型指导以及克制而扎实的导演风格，让奇幻元素不会显得悬浮。智勋和敏雅的厚重、稳定表演构成全剧基石，再加上李钟硕和Lee Se-young令人惊艳的外形契合，该剧最终实现了其雄心勃勃的构想。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: Professor from Japan explains what Korean men have to offer Hosaka Yuji, a Japanese-born naturalized Korean and special professor at Korea University's Graduate School of Public Administration, has identified what Japanese women find attractive about Korean men. Hosaka cited two main reasons Korean men are increasingly sought after as marriage partners by Japanese women: their direct expressions of affection and their attentiveness.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 日本教授解读韩国男性的优势：日本出生的归化韩国人、高丽大学公共行政研究生院特聘教授保坂裕二指出，日本女性认为韩国男性具有吸引力的特点。保坂列举了两项主要理由，说明日本女性越来越希望选择韩国男性作为结婚对象：他们会直接表达爱意，而且体贴周到。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: Professor from Japan explains what Korean men have to offer Hosaka Yuji, a Japanese-born naturalized Korean and special professor at Korea University's Graduate School of Public Administration, has identified what Japanese women find attractive about Korean men. The growing number of marriages between Korean men and Japanese women, he said, reflects the popularity of Korean men's affectionate expressions and thoughtfulness among Japanese women. He also suggested that images of Korean men shaped by Korean dramas have played a role. “Matchmaking agencies specializing in Korea-Japan marriages have opened in Tokyo,” he noted. Hosaka made the remarks during an appearance on the YouTube channel Woongdal Bookstore on Sunday. He described this as a clear indication that Japanese women have developed a strong preference for Korean men. Hosaka cited two main reasons Korean men are increasingly sought after as marriage partners by Japanese women: their direct expressions of affection and their attentiveness. While Japanese men rarely say “I love you” in everyday life, Korean men tend to express their feelings more openly, he said. “Japanese women are deeply touched by gestures such as a man walking on the side of the traffic when accompanying a woman on the sidewalk, or cutting up an entire steak for her,” Hosaka explained. Hosaka also pointed to the influence of K-dramas in boosting Japanese women's favorable perceptions of Korean men. “Korean men in Korean dramas are portrayed as people who risk their lives to protect women,” he said. “The image of a man willing to devote everything he has to the woman he loves has become the ideal type for many Japanese women.” Another factor Japanese women reportedly appreciate is that, unlike in Japan, where wives traditionally take their husbands' surnames after marriage, women in Korea retain their own family names. “Quite a few Japanese women feel that Korea is actually a place where they can preserve their own identities,” Hosaka said. What do Japanese women offer that Korean men find attractive? Hosaka pointed to their attentive listening and tendency not to immediately express disagreement. “Japanese women have a strong image of treating what men say as important and not immediately contradicting them. They don't start by saying, ‘No, that's not right,’” he said. He added that this tendency is largely shaped by childhood upbringing, with Japanese women often taught from an early age not to immediately reject what another person says. Marriages between Korean men and Japanese women totaled 1,494 last year, up 306, or 25.8 percent, from the previous year. This was the highest figure since statistics began being compiled in 2008. The annual increase was the second-largest on record, following a rise of 340 marriages in 2024. The trend contrasts with a decline in international marriages between Korean men and women from Vietnam, China and Thailand, which have traditionally accounted for a large share of international marriages in Korea. This article from the Hankook Ilbo, the sister publication of The Korea Times, is translated by a generative AI system and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 从切牛排到表达爱意：日裔教授谈韩国男性的魅力
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 日本教授解读韩国男性对 Hosaka Yuji 的吸引力。出生于日本、归化成为韩国籍的高丽大学公共行政研究生院特任教授 Hosaka Yuji 指出，哪些特质会让日本女性觉得韩国男性有吸引力。他说，韩国男性与日本女性之间的婚姻数量不断增加，反映出韩国男性深情的表达方式和体贴入微深受日本女性欢迎。他还提出，韩剧塑造的韩国男性形象也发挥了一定作用。他指出：“专门撮合韩日婚姻的婚介机构已在东京开业。”Hosaka 周日亮相 YouTube 频道 Woongdal Bookstore 时发表了上述言论。他将这一现象描述为日本女性对韩国男性形成强烈偏好的明确迹象。Hosaka 列举了日本女性越来越倾向于将韩国男性选为配偶的两个主要原因：他们会直接表达爱意，以及 attentive、体贴入微。他说，日本男性在日常生活中很少说“我爱你”，韩国男性则往往会更加公开地表达自己的感受。Hosaka 解释道：“诸如陪女性走在人行道上时让女性走在靠近车流的一侧，或把整块牛排切好留给女性之类的举动，会让日本女性深受触动。”Hosaka 还指出，韩剧提升了日本女性对韩国男性的好感。他说：“韩剧中的韩国男性被描绘成愿意冒生命危险保护女性的人。一个愿意为自己所爱的女性倾尽所有的男人形象，已成为许多日本女性心中的理想类型。”据报道，日本女性欣赏的另一个因素是，与日本妻子婚后通常要改随丈夫姓氏不同，韩国女性会保留自己的娘家姓氏。Hosaka 说：“相当多的日本女性觉得，韩国其实是一个能够保留自我身份的地方。”那么，日本女性有哪些地方吸引韩国男性？Hosaka 指出，她们善于倾听，而且倾向于不会立即表达反对意见。他说：“日本女性给人留下了高度重视男性所说的话、不会立即反驳他们的鲜明印象。她们不会一开口就说‘不，那不对’。”他补充道，这种倾向在很大程度上源于童年教育，日本女性往往从小就被教导不要立即否定别人说的话。去年，韩国男性与日本女性之间的婚姻共有1,494对，比上一年增加306对，增幅为25.8%。这是自2008年开始编制相关统计数据以来的最高数字。这一年度增幅在有记录以来位居第二，仅次于2024年增加340对婚姻的升幅。与此同时，韩国男性与越南、中国和泰国女性之间的国际婚姻数量有所下降，而这些国家女性过去一直在韩国国际婚姻中占据很大比例。本文来自《韩国时报》的姊妹报《韩国先驱报》，由生成式人工智能系统翻译，并经《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111100.title: 관광공사, '관광벤처 파이널 데모데이'서 우수기업 6곳 선정

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111100.title_zh: 韩国观光公社在“旅游创投企业最终路演”活动上选出6家优秀企业
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111100.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者李相瑞报道：韩国观光公社11日表示，该机构举办了“2026观光创业风险企业最终演示日”，并评选出6家优秀企业。前一天在首尔中区“MASIL”举行的活动，旨在激活观光公社所支持的观光创业企业与投资机构之间的交流，扩大招商引资机会，并强化观光创业企业的商业化能力。观光创业企业、主要投资机构、青年预备创业者等约100人出席，14家企业通过面向招商引资的企业说明与推介活动展示了商业模式和增长战略。这些企业通过模拟投资评审，最终入选了6家运营相关服务的优秀企业：基于外国游客视频的观光消费数据分析服务“美人首尔”、基于客户行为数据的门店购买转化解决方案“Ravenly”、整合钓鱼信息、船舶预订和装备购买的海洋休闲平台“About Fishing”、外国游客购物增值税退税综合解决方案“The Service Platform”等。韩国观光公社表示，将继续跟进并提供后续支持，确保此次成果转化为实际投资，同时通过与各地区创意经济创新中心联动的一对一咨询，为青年创业准备和创业企业进军地方市场提供支持。同一天举行的“BETTER里电池项目”成果分享会吸引了项目参与企业、地方政府和旅游业界相关人士等约60人出席，介绍了项目迄今取得的成果。该项目将观光创业企业的创意与地方独有资源结合，在人口减少地区进行实证，今年以全罗南道 강진郡和全罗北道金济市为对象推进项目。韩国观光公社观光产业本部长民炳善表示：“我们将支持企业挖掘增长潜力，并以地方实证成果为基础，推动后续投资与合作，不断拓宽观光企业与地方共同增长的基础。”举报请通过KakaoTalk联系okjebo。〈版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再次分发及用于AI学习和应用〉2026/11/11 08:21发送，2026年11月11日08时21分发送

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111108.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认与一名涉嫌中国间谍的女性有婚外情，此事引发个人丑闻，并开始冲击美国国家安全和对华半导体出口政策。10日（当地时间），科技媒体The Information报道称，Alice Huang（中国名黄 rus）利用与黄仁勋的关系，帮助中国企业绕过限制获取并运输价值至少75亿美元（约10万亿韩元）的英伟达AI芯片。报道称，Alice Huang与据称是其丈夫的Kan Wei以及妹妹Huang Wei等家人一起，构建了连接中国、新加坡和马来西亚的复杂企业网络，以获取英伟达芯片。由于美国对华出口管制导致包括“Shanghai Suntury LTOng”等被她和丈夫用作对华联系纽带的中国企业出现英伟达芯片订单中止或延迟，Alice Huang便出面利用英伟达等方面的关系确保供货。据判断，通过走私输入中国或以租赁方式提供给中国的英伟达高性能半导体包括H100、H200和A100在内，总数达到24万个。报道指出，她一方面利用与黄仁勋的关系在科技界和投资者等群体中建立信任，另一方面始终对自身发挥的具体作用保持含糊，并在文件上不留下痕迹，以逃避追查。报道可在KakaoTalk的okjebo查看。版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载、复制及用于AI学习和应用。2026年11月11日11时41分发布，2026年11月11日11时41分发稿

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111108.title_zh: 吴说“很难搞统一选举”，提及退出轨道……张说“怀疑存在政治意图”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111108.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者金妍贞（自由民主党记者）＝在吴世勋市长针对保守派整合案的上诉审获释、保守派整合成为舆论焦点之际，一直看似在缩小距离的党代表张东赫与吴市长，又因党内路线和领导体制问题公开发生对立。吴世勋市长11日在接受《中央日报》采访时说：“有一点很清楚，如果以张东赫体制参加大选，首都圈选举恐怕会非常困难。非常体制似乎更灵活一些。”他接着说：“无论是否经历非常体制这一过渡期，选举都必须在符合首都圈选民情绪的状态下进行，也就是说，必须让选民能在我们党看到新的希望。对此我很明确。”张代表当天在首尔新罗酒店举行的TV朝鲜主办论坛上与记者见面时说：“现在说不能以现有领导体制参加大选，或者说需要转向非常体制，这绝不是为了真正赢得大选，也不是为了国民力量党，除了别有政治目的之外别无其他解释。”他表达了不满情绪。张代表说：“我现在担心首尔市民正因房地产和民生问题而痛苦，但我看吴市长似乎非常关心我们党内部的问题。”他接着说：“那由我担任首尔市长，吴市长来担任党代表，我们换个位置不就行了吗。”他还说：“现在说不能以现有领导体制参加大选、需要转向非常体制，是因为目前多项民意调查指标反而指向与这一主张完全相反的方向，因此我真不知道是否还有必要回应这种说法。我想，这或许只是反映了希望新领导层上台的一种愿望。”张代表强调：“眼下我们正因‘李在明减刑法’进行坚决的租赁斗争。现在最重要的是集中精力推动李在明减刑法、未来应对基金等租赁斗争。”随后，他向吴市长表示：“事到如今，吴市长体察首尔市民的生活疾苦，而国民力量党以党领导层为中心、以院内领导层为中心体察国民生活，才是利党、利民和走向大选胜利的道路。”此前，吴市长在6月地方选举前后批评张东赫代表的路线和纪律政治等，要求张代表辞职，但最近又与张代表共同进行租赁斗争，相对保持了较近距离。报道请通过KakaoTalk okjebo发送。〔版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、翻印及用于人工智能学习和利用〕2026年11月11日11时38分发布
