https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary: A team of US officials visited India earlier this month for talks on the proposed bilateral trade agreement (BTA), as New Delhi and Washington remain engaged for an early conclusion of the first tranche of the deal, an official said on Tuesday. Indian officials remain positive about the proposed mutually beneficial agreement and ruled out any disruption to the negotiations following the outcome of the recent US midterm elections.
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 一名美国官员周二表示，美国官员团队本月早些时候访问印度，就拟议中的双边贸易协定（BTA）举行会谈，新德里和华盛顿仍在努力推动尽早敲定该协议的第一批条款。印度官员对这项拟议中的互利协议持积极态度，并排除美国近期中期选举结果会干扰谈判的可能性。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: A team of US officials visited India earlier this month for talks on the proposed bilateral trade agreement (BTA), as New Delhi and Washington remain engaged for an early conclusion of the first tranche of the deal, an official said on Tuesday. The two sides discussed issues related to customs and trade facilitation during meetings in New Delhi last week, the official said, requesting anonymity. Indian officials remain positive about the proposed mutually beneficial agreement and ruled out any disruption to the negotiations following the outcome of the recent US midterm elections. The US and India have a very consequential relationship which, apart from trade, draws strengths from economic, political and security imperatives, an official said, asking not to be named. According to trade experts, uncertainty created by Washington’s frequent trade measures and the use of tariffs as a negotiating tool had been major hurdles to signing an interim BTA, even though a preliminary draft is almost ready. The two countries issued a joint statement on February 7 outlining a framework for an interim BTA. However, the agreement was not signed after the US Supreme Court invalidated the legal basis for the preferential tariff mechanism Washington had offered, the experts said. India is now awaiting a preferential tariff framework that gives it exporters competitive access compared with exporters from competing countries, they said. The US government is also keen to finalise the agreement at the earliest, they added. In September, US Ambassador Sergio Gor said India and the United States were working to build a “fair, reciprocal and mutually beneficial” trade relationship. “The US-India relationship stands at a historic high point. Pick any sector and the United States and India are working together on it,” Gor said at the 66th annual session of the Automotive Component Manufacturers Association (ACMA) in New Delhi. HT reported it on September 3. Gor said cooperation between the two countries extended from information technology and data centres to pharmaceuticals, defence sales and military exercises. He also pointed to potential cooperation in space, citing NASA’s invitation to ISRO to participate in its Moon Base programme. India and the US have been negotiating a bilateral trade agreement since Prime Minister Narendra Modi and US President Donald Trump met in Washington on February 13, 2025. In February this year, the two countries announced that they had finalised a framework for an interim BTA. Subsequent changes to the US tariff regime, however, have affected the negotiations
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 美国官员访问印度，就拟议中的双边贸易协议举行会谈
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 一名美国官员周二表示，本月初，一支美国官员团队访问印度，就拟议中的双边贸易协议（BTA）举行会谈；目前，新德里和华盛顿仍在推动尽早敲定该协议的第一阶段内容。该官员在上周于新德里举行的会议中介绍了相关情况，并要求匿名。印度官员仍对拟议中的互利协议持积极态度，并排除美国近期中期选举结果对谈判造成任何中断的可能。另一名要求匿名的官员表示，美印关系非常重要，除贸易外，这种关系还受到经济、政治和安全需要的推动。据贸易专家称，尽管初步草案已接近完成，但华盛顿频繁采取贸易措施以及把关税作为谈判工具，给签署临时BTA造成了重大障碍。专家表示，两国于2月7日发表联合声明，概述了临时BTA的框架。然而，美国最高法院裁定华盛顿所提供的优惠关税机制失去法律依据后，该协议并未签署。专家称，印度目前正等待一套优惠关税框架，使印度出口商相较于来自竞争国家的出口商获得具有竞争力的市场准入。他们补充说，美国政府也希望尽早敲定协议。9月，美国大使Sergio Gor表示，印度和美国正努力建立“公平、互惠和互利”的贸易关系。Gor在新德里举行的汽车零部件制造商协会（ACMA）第66届年会上说：“美印关系正处于历史最高点。无论选择哪个行业，美国和印度都在携手合作。”《论坛时报》于9月3日报道了此事。Gor表示，两国之间的合作涵盖信息技术、数据中心、药品、防务产品销售和军事演习等领域。他还指出双方在太空领域存在合作潜力，并提到NASA邀请印度空间研究组织（ISRO）参与其“月球基地”计划。自总理Narendra Modi与美国总统Donald Trump于2025年2月13日在华盛顿会晤以来，印度和美国一直在谈判双边贸易协议。今年2月，两国宣布已完成临时BTA框架。然而，美国关税制度随后发生的变化对谈判产生了影响

Unlock these with Subscription With 425.61 MW of domestic rooftop solar installations in Tamil Nadu that have benefited from the PM Surya Ghar scheme, the Tamil Nadu Green Energy Corporation is taking efforts to bring more households under rooftop solar. However, industry and consumer representatives say the State government should address a couple of basic policy issues so that more households go in for rooftop solar. “While the government advertisements claim that consumers will get to pay nothing as bi-monthly energy charges if they instal rooftop solar, in reality, they have to pay network charges,” says K. Kathirmathiyon, secretary of Coimbatore Consumer Cause. A.D. Thirumurthi, advisor of the National Solar Energy Federation of India, says the consumers should be exempted from network charges for rooftop solar. Further, in the case of additional solar energy generated in a financial year that goes unused, the consumers should be paid at least the average power purchase cost for the excess solar energy they feed to the grid. Mr. Kathirmathiyon explained that if a consumer instals a five KW rooftop solar and his bi-monthly consumption is 500-550 units, he will supply the excess to the grid. He does not get any payment for the additional power. Instead, he will have to pay nearly ₹5,800 annually as network charges. Why should a consumer pay for solar energy that he has generated and not consumed, he asks. “Tamil Nadu should adopt an approach similar to Kerala instead of allowing surplus electricity credits to lapse without compensation. Network charges applicable to domestic rooftop solar investors under the TNERC tariff framework with effect from October 22, 2021 constitute another major disincentive,” he says. The Government and the Tamil Nadu Electricity Regulatory Commission should ensure domestic rooftop solar power producer/consumer is paid for the surplus electricity remaining unadjusted at the end of the settlement period (31st March). It should also withdraw network/wheeling charges levied on domestic rooftop solar power producers. Mr. Thirumurthi says residents who consume more than 500 units of electricity in two months stand to benefit more if they go in for solar. https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title: Engaged with Russia, Ukraine over food corridor: MEA
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary: India has exchanged ideas with Russia and Ukraine on opening “food corridors” to facilitate grain exports from Black Sea ports as part of a broader ceasefire proposal and is working with other stakeholders for the return of peace in the region, the external affairs ministry said on Tuesday.
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 印度外交部周二表示，印度已与俄罗斯和乌克兰就开辟“粮食走廊”、便利黑海港口粮食出口交换意见，并正与其他利益相关方合作，推动该地区恢复和平。这些走廊属于更广泛停火提议的一部分。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: India has exchanged ideas with Russia and Ukraine on opening “food corridors” to facilitate grain exports from Black Sea ports as part of a broader ceasefire proposal and is working with other stakeholders for the return of peace in the region, the external affairs ministry said on Tuesday. During a phone conversation with Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Monday, Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelensky suggested that India can take the lead in ensuring uninterrupted food supplies through the Black Sea by mediating the establishment of food corridors. The conversation was followed by a phone call between external affairs minister S Jaishankar and his Russian counterpart Sergey Lavrov. “On the issue of food corridors, we have exchanged ideas with both sides. India remains in touch with both sides, as well as with interested parties, to contribute towards the return of peace to the region,” he said without going into details. Jaiswal’s remarks marked the first acknowledgement from the Indian side about the work on food corridors. The move is also in line with India’s efforts to protect the interests of the countries of the Global South, which have been hit by food, fuel and fertiliser shortages since the start of the Russia-Ukraine conflict in February 2022. Modi and Zelensky shared perspectives on the ongoing conflict during their phone conversation, and discussed its humanitarian aspects and various efforts to restore peace that are currently underway, Jaiswal said. Modi reiterated India’s firm commitment to contribute towards peace in every possible way, and this was followed by the call between Jaishankar and Lavrov that focused on diplomatic initiatives aimed at ending the conflict, he said. “India has been emphasising that the way forward is to take the path of dialogue and diplomacy. In recent months, our PM has expressed that ‘endless wars must now give way to end of war’,” Jaiswal said. “In keeping with this idea of bringing peace to the region, India has been engaged with both Russia and Ukraine and we have conveyed certain ideas to them.” These ideas include the safety of commercial shipping in the Black Sea, addressing immediate concerns of Russia and Ukraine related to grain and energy exports, and “non-attack possibilities” or stopping attacks on infrastructure. India’s contacts with the leadership of Russia and Ukraine came even as the two sides were preparing for talks brokered by the US in Abu Dhabi. People familiar with the matter said the Indian side is also in touch with other parties in Europe, including the European Union and the “E3”, or France, Germany and the UK, which have been engaged in diplomatic and security initiatives aimed at ending the hostilities. Zelensky, in his conversation with Modi on Monday, said India should “identify what steps it can take and what dialogue it can pursue with other leaders to help bring the war to an end”. He proposed food security as an area where India can contribute at a time when Russia is “blocking” grain exports via the Black Sea. “India is ready to mediate in establishing food corridors, and we are counting on these efforts to continue,” Zelensky said. India is among the very few countries that have maintained contacts with Russia and Ukraine since the start of the conflict. Modi has spoken to Russian President Vladimir Putin and Zelensky several times on the need to end the war, emphasising that solutions cannot be found on the battlefield or under the shadow of the gun. Jaishankar had conveyed India’s ceasefire proposal when he visited Kyiv on September 3 and met Zelensky and foreign minister Andrii Sybiha. Both Russia and Ukraine have welcomed the proposal
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 印度外交部：已就粮食走廊问题与俄罗斯、乌克兰接洽
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 印度外交部周二表示，作为更广泛停火方案的一部分，印度已与俄罗斯和乌克兰交换意见，讨论开辟“粮食走廊”，以便利从黑海港口出口粮食；印度还正与其他相关方合作，推动该地区恢复和平。周一，印度总理莫迪与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基通电话时，泽连斯基建议印度发挥牵头作用，通过斡旋建立粮食走廊，确保黑海粮食供应不中断。随后，外交部长苏杰生与俄罗斯外长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫通了电话。苏杰生说：“关于粮食走廊问题，我们已与双方交换意见。印度仍与双方以及相关各方保持联系，为推动该地区恢复和平作出贡献。”他未透露更多细节。杰索瓦尔的这番言论标志着印度方面首次承认有关粮食走廊的工作。此举也符合印度保护全球南方国家利益的努力；自2022年2月俄乌冲突爆发以来，这些国家一直受到粮食、燃料和化肥短缺的影响。杰索瓦尔说，莫迪与泽连斯基在通话中交换了对持续冲突的看法，并讨论了冲突的人道主义影响以及目前正在进行的各项恢复和平努力。莫迪重申印度决心以一切可能方式为和平作出贡献，随后杰尚卡尔与拉夫罗夫通了电话，重点讨论旨在结束冲突的外交倡议。杰索瓦尔说：“印度一直强调，前进的方向是走对话与外交之路。近几个月来，我们的总理已表示，‘无休止的战争现在必须让位于战争的终结。’”他补充说：“本着为该地区带来和平这一理念，印度一直与俄罗斯和乌克兰保持接触，并向双方传达了某些想法。”这些想法包括保障黑海商业航运安全，应对俄罗斯和乌克兰有关粮食及能源出口的紧迫关切，以及探索“非攻击可能性”或停止袭击基础设施。就在印度与俄罗斯和乌克兰领导层接触之际，双方正准备参加由美国斡旋、定于阿布扎比举行的会谈。知情人士称，印度方面还与欧洲其他各方保持联系，包括欧洲联盟以及“E3”国家，即法国、德国和英国；这些国家正参与旨在结束敌对行动的外交与安全倡议。泽连斯基周一与莫迪通话时表示，印度应“确定能够采取哪些措施，以及可以与其他领导人开展哪些对话，以帮助结束战争”。他提议，在俄罗斯“阻碍”粮食经黑海出口之际，印度可以在粮食安全方面作出贡献。泽连斯基说：“印度已准备为建立粮食走廊进行斡旋，我们期待这些努力能够继续。”印度是自冲突爆发以来仍与俄罗斯和乌克兰保持联系的少数国家之一。莫迪已多次与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和泽连斯基通话，强调结束战争的必要，并指出解决方案无法在战场上或枪口阴影下找到。杰尚卡尔9月3日访问基辅并会见泽连斯基和外交部长安德rii·瑟比哈时，转达了印度提出的停火方案。俄罗斯和乌克兰均对该方案表示欢迎……

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title: Hasina’s plan to return home will require a travel document: MEA
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary: India on Tuesday refused to be drawn on the issue of former prime minister Sheikh Hasina seeking a passport from the Bangladesh high commission to facilitate her return home next month, with the external affairs ministry only saying that such travel plans will require a “travel document”.
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 印度周二表示，不愿就前总理Sheikh Hasina向孟加拉国高级委员会申请护照、以便其下月回国的议题发表评论。印度外交部仅表示，此类出行计划需要持有“旅行证件”。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: India on Tuesday refused to be drawn on the issue of former prime minister Sheikh Hasina seeking a passport from the Bangladesh high commission to facilitate her return home next month, with the external affairs ministry only saying that such travel plans will require a “travel document”. Hasina, who has lived in self-imposed exile in India since her government was toppled in a student-led uprising in August 2024, approached the Bangladesh mission in New Delhi on Monday to seek a passport and a national identity card ahead of her planned return home in December. The request was swiftly dismissed by Bangladesh’s deputy foreign minister Humaiun Kobir, who reiterated Dhaka’s demand for her extradition. External affairs ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal declined to comment when he was asked about Hasina seeking a passport from Bangladeshi authorities at a regular media briefing. “The question that you asked is essentially a question that you must pose to the Bangladesh high commission. This is a matter which they would be in a better position to convey to you, what is the sense they have on this particular issue,” he said. Jaiswal responded to another question on Bangladesh’s demand for Hasina’s extradition by repeating India’s stated position that this is “a legal matter, and it will be dealt with accordingly”. When Jaiswal was asked specifically whether the extradition of a person will be possible if they did not possess a passport, he replied: “Obviously, for the travel of people, you need a travel document. That is what I understand, but it is a technical matter.” Bangladeshi authorities revoked Hasina’s passport after she fled to India, and the activities of her Awami League party were banned. Her request for a passport and national identity card are being seen as preparations for her return to Bangladesh in December, since possession of the travel document will give her a greater say in deciding the circumstances of her return. The former PM has said in several recent interviews that she intends to return home next month despite facing the possibility of arrest. Hasina was sentenced to death by Bangladesh’s International Crimes Tribunal in 2025 for crimes against humanity on the ground that she was responsible for ordering a crackdown on student-led protests that left hundreds dead and thousands injured. Hasina denies any wrongdoing, has rejected the tribunal’s verdict, and has challenged the legitimacy of her trial. Her presence in India has emerged as a key irritant in relations between New Delhi and the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) government in Dhaka. Bangladeshi officials have also urged the Indian side not to allow her to air her political views from Indian soil
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 印度外交部称，哈西娜返乡计划需要旅行证件
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 印度周二拒绝就前总理谢赫·哈西纳向孟加拉国驻印度高级专员公署申办护照、以便她下月返乡一事发表评论。印度外交部仅表示，此类出行计划需要持有“旅行证件”。2024年8月，哈西纳政府在由学生主导的抗议中被推翻，此后她一直自愿流亡印度。周一，哈西纳前往孟加拉国驻新德里使团，申办护照和国民身份证，为计划于12月返乡作准备。孟加拉国外交部副部长胡迈恩·科比尔迅速拒绝了这一请求，并重申达卡要求引渡哈西纳的立场。外交部发言人兰迪尔·贾伊瓦尔在例行记者会上被问及哈西纳是否向孟加拉国当局申办护照时，拒绝置评。他说：“你们提出的这个问题，实质上应当向孟加拉国驻印度高级专员公署提出。他们更有资格向你们说明对这一具体问题的看法。”在被问及孟加拉国要求引渡哈西纳一事时，贾伊瓦尔重申印度既定立场，称这“属于法律事务，将依法处理”。当被具体问到，如果一个人没有护照，是否仍可能将其引渡时，他回答：“显然，人们出行需要旅行证件。据我理解，这是技术性问题。”哈西纳逃往印度后，孟加拉国当局吊销了她的护照，其人民-awami联盟政党的活动也被禁止。外界认为，她申办护照和国民身份证是在为12月返回孟加拉国作准备，因为持有旅行证件将使她在决定返乡条件方面拥有更大的话语权。这位前总理近日在多次采访中表示，尽管面临被捕的可能，她仍打算于下月返乡。2025年，孟加拉国国际犯罪法庭以危害人类罪判处哈西纳死刑，理由是她应对下令镇压由学生主导的抗议负责，该抗议造成数百人死亡、数千人受伤。哈西纳否认有任何不当行为，拒绝接受法庭裁决，并质疑审判的合法性。她人在印度已成为新德里与达卡孟加拉国民族主义党（BNP）政府关系中的一个主要摩擦点。孟加拉国官员还敦促印度方面不要允许她在印度境内发表政治观点

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title: India rejects Khalistani separatist Pannun's US lawsuit as ‘fabricated, malicious attack'
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary: India on Tuesday rejected the case filed by Khalistani separatist Gurpatwant Singh Pannun in the US against National Security Adviser Ajit Doval and the government, describing such moves as “fabricated and malicious attacks” that will not stand the test of legal processes. At the same time, the Indian side has officially taken up the “frivolous nature” of Pannun’s lawsuit with US authorities, people familiar with the matter said on condition of anonymity.
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 印度周二驳回了旁遮普分离主义分子古尔帕特万特·辛格·潘努恩在美国针对国家安全顾问阿吉特·多瓦尔和印度政府提起的诉讼，称此类举动是“捏造且恶意的攻击”，经不起法律程序的考验。与此同时，知情人士在匿名条件下表示，印度方面已正式向美国当局指出潘努恩诉讼“轻率”的性质。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: India on Tuesday rejected the case filed by Khalistani separatist Gurpatwant Singh Pannun in the US against National Security Adviser Ajit Doval and the government, describing such moves as “fabricated and malicious attacks” that will not stand the test of legal processes. At the same time, the Indian side has officially taken up the “frivolous nature” of Pannun’s lawsuit with US authorities, people familiar with the matter said on condition of anonymity. The people noted that the NSA enjoys diplomatic immunity and said the legal moves by Pannun are aimed at keeping the Khalistan issue in the limelight and have no legal merit, they said. External affairs ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal dismissed the case filed by Pannun when he was asked about the matter at a regular media briefing. He also made it clear that all official communications related to the issue will have to be routed through India’s law ministry. “We reject the fabricated and malicious attacks on our high officials, as also we reject the frivolous lawsuits,” he said. “Requests for serving of judicial documents in India can only be routed through India’s designated central authority, that is the ministry of law and justice.” The two developments mark separate steps in the process of formally notifying the defendants in the civil suit, which alleges that Indian officials conspired to assassinate Pannun at his New York home in 2023. However, neither amounts to a judicial finding on the allegations, and the latest court order does not establish any liability on the part of the Indian government or the two officials. In a letter to the US District Court for the Southern District of New York dated October 20, the state department stated that it transmitted the summons, complaint and notice of suit to the Indian embassy under cover of a diplomatic note signed on September 30 and delivered on October 9. Also Read | No bail for two linked to Khalistan terror module The department said the transmission was undertaken in discharge of its statutory responsibilities under the US Foreign Sovereign Immunities Act (FSIA), while making clear it was not taking any position on the merits of the case or whether all legal requirements for service had been fulfilled. The people cited above said this was not the proper procedure for serving such documents. They also noted that such matters come under the purview of The Hague Convention, especially the Service Convention of 1965 that governs the cross-border service of judicial documents. India has for long taken up the activities of Pannun and other Khalistani separatists based in North America with the US side, including the threats issued by them against Indian diplomats and missions. The Indian side has also informed the US side of the frivolous nature of legal cases filed by the separatists. The diplomatic note from the US asked the Indian government to forward the documents to the appropriate authority and take steps to avoid a default judgment. It referred to a 60-day period within which a defendant is required to file an answer or other responsive pleading, warning that failure could expose it to a judgment without an opportunity to present its arguments or evidence. The state department’s transmission, however, should not be read as an endorsement of Pannun’s allegations or as a determination of the Indian government’s liability. The department expressly clarified its action didn’t reflect a position on whether service had been properly effected, the status or character of the defendants, or the merits of the claims and possible defences. Separately, in an order dated November 9, US district judge Katherine Polk Failla allowed Pannun to send summonses for Doval and Goel to designated district courts in Delhi, which would be requested to serve them as if they were summonses issued by Indian courts. The ruling followed Pannun’s difficulties in serving Doval personally during his visits to the US. According to court filings, he made three attempts to serve the summons to the NSA, but security personnel prevented process servers from doing so. Pannun claimed his attempts to route the documents through India’s law ministry, also failed. The law ministry returned the documents with a brief communication stating that the summons did not fall within relevant categories. Pannun argued this amounted to India’s determination that the Hague Convention didn’t apply, freeing him to seek alternative methods of service. The US judge rejected this contention and said the Indian authority’s response was too ambiguous to establish it had made a legal determination on The Hague Convention’s applicability. Instead, the court held that the Hague Convention applied to civil proceedings but permitted service through Indian courts under Article 19, which preserves domestic legal procedures allowing more permissive methods of transmitting foreign judicial documents. The judge relied on Section 29(c) of India’s Code of Civil Procedure, which allows summonses issued by notified foreign civil courts to be sent to Indian courts and served as if they had been issued by those courts. A January 12, 2009 government notification extended this provision to civil courts in countries party to the Hague Convention. However, the US court left open the possibility of revisiting this conclusion if the Indian government or an Indian court expresses a contrary view. The judge identified Patiala House, Dwarka and Tis Hazari court complexes in Delhi as possible receiving courts and held that summonses can be mailed to them for service on Doval and Goel. The process, however, is not complete. Pannun has been directed to submit by November 30 a proposed packet containing the summonses, a draft order detailing the proposed procedure, relevant Indian legal provisions and the documents returned by India’s law ministry. Only after examining and approving these materials will the US court direct its clerk to transmit the packet to the designated Indian courts. The November 9 order is confined to Doval and Goel. It does not grant the same relief to other defendants, including the Indian government, former RAW officer Vikash Yadav and Nikhil Gupta. Nor does it determine whether the US court has jurisdiction to adjudicate the substantive claims or what defences, including any immunity-related objections, may be available to the defendants. Pannun, who has been designated a terrorist by India, filed the civil suit in 2024 against the Indian government and several individuals, seeking to hold them liable for an alleged conspiracy to kill him. India has denied state involvement in the alleged plot. The civil proceedings run parallel to a criminal prosecution in the US arising from the alleged murder-for-hire conspiracy. US prosecutors have accused Nikhil Gupta of working with Vikash Yadav to arrange Pannun’s assassination. Gupta pleaded guilty in February. Doval and Goel have not been charged in that criminal case
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 印度谴责旁努恩在美诉讼，称其为“捏造且怀有恶意的攻击”
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 印度周二驳回了旁遮普分离主义分子古尔帕特万特·辛格·潘嫩在美国针对印度国家安全顾问阿吉特·多瓦尔和印度政府提起的诉讼，称此类举动是“捏造且恶毒的攻击”，经不起法律程序的考验。与此同时，据知情人士透露，在不公开姓名的情况下，印度方面已正式向美国当局指出潘嫩诉讼“轻率无据”的性质。知情人士称，国家安全顾问享有外交豁免权，潘嫩采取的法律行动旨在让旁遮普问题持续受到关注，不具备任何法律依据。在例行媒体吹风会上被问及此事时，印度外交部发言人兰迪尔·贾伊瓦尔否定了潘嫩提起的案件。他还明确表示，与该问题有关的所有官方通信都必须通过印度法律部转交。他说：“我们驳斥针对我方高级官员的捏造且恶毒的攻击，也驳斥这些轻率无据的诉讼。”他表示：“在印度境内送达司法文书，只能通过印度指定的中央主管机关，即法律与司法部转交。”这两项进展分别属于正式通知该民事诉讼被告程序的独立步骤。该诉讼指控印度官员于2023年阴谋在潘嫩位于纽约的住所将其暗杀。不过，两者均不构成法院对相关指控的司法认定，最新法院命令也未认定印度政府或这两名官员承担任何责任。国务院在10月20日致纽约南区美国联邦地区法院的一封信中表示，已通过一份9月30日签署、10月9日送达的外交照会，将传票、起诉书及诉讼通知转交印度大使馆。相关阅读｜两名与旁遮普恐怖组织有关人员不准保释。该部门表示，转交这些文件是为履行美国《外国主权豁免法》（FSIA）规定的法定职责，同时明确说明其不对案件是非曲直或所有送达法律要求是否均已得到满足表明立场。上述知情人士称，这并非送达此类文件的适当程序。他们还指出，此类事项属于《海牙公约》的管辖范围，尤其是规范跨境送达司法文件的1965年《送达公约》。长期以来，印度一直就潘嫩及其他旅居北美的旁遮普分离主义分子的活动与美方交涉，包括他们针对印度外交官和使团发出的威胁。印度方面也已向美方说明这些分离主义分子提起的法律案件轻率无据。美国外交照会要求印度政府将文件转交适当机关，并采取措施避免因缺席而作出缺席判决。照会提及60天的期限，被告须在此期间提交答辩状或其他回应性诉状，并警告若未按要求提交，可能在无法陈述其主张或提交证据的情况下被判决。不过，不应将国务院的转交行为解读为认可潘嫩的指控，或认定印度政府承担责任。该部门明确澄清，其行动不表示对是否已妥善完成送达、被告的身份或性质，以及索赔的实体内容和可能提出的抗辩采取任何立场。另据一项日期为11月9日的命令，美国地区法官凯瑟琳·波尔克·法伊拉准许潘嫩向德里的指定地区法院发送针对多瓦尔和戈尔的传票，并请求这些法院按印度法院签发的传票予以送达。该裁定源于潘嫩在多瓦尔访问美国期间难以向其本人送达传票的问题。根据法院文件，他曾三次尝试向国家安全顾问送达传票，但安保人员阻止送达员执行送达。潘嫩声称，他通过印度法律部转交文件的尝试也告失败。法律部将文件退回，并附上一份简短说明，称传票不属于相关类别。潘嫩认为，这等于印度认定《海牙公约》不适用，从而使他可以寻求其他送达方式。美国法官驳回了这一主张，称印度主管部门的回复过于含糊，无法证明其已就《海牙公约》的适用性作出法律认定。法院反而认定，《海牙公约》适用于民事诉讼，但允许依据第19条通过印度法院完成送达；该条保留了国内法律程序，允许采用更为宽松的方式传递外国司法文件。法官援引了印度《民事诉讼法》第29(c)条。该条允许将经通知的外国民事法院签发的传票送交印度法院，并视同由这些法院签发的传票予以送达。2009年1月12日的一项政府通知将这一规定扩大适用于加入《海牙公约》国家的民事法院。不过，美国法院保留了重新审议这一结论的可能性。如果印度政府或印度法院持相反观点，法院可再次审查该问题。法官将德里的帕蒂亚拉宫、德瓦卡和蒂斯哈扎里法院综合体列为可能的接收法院，并认定传票可邮寄至这些法院，用于向多瓦尔和戈尔送达。不过，整个程序尚未完成。潘嫩已被要求在11月30日前提交一套拟议材料，其中包括传票、详细说明拟议程序的命令草案、相关印度法律规定，以及印度法律部退回的文件。美国法院审查并批准这些材料后，才会指示书记员将材料转交给指定的印度法院。11月9日的命令仅涉及多瓦尔和戈尔，并未给予其他被告同样的救济，包括印度政府、前印度调查局官员维卡什·亚达夫和尼基尔·古普塔。该命令也未裁定美国法院是否对审理实体索赔具有管辖权，也未确定被告可提出哪些抗辩，包括与豁免权有关的异议。潘嫩已被印度认定为恐怖分子。他于2024年针对印度政府和数名个人提起该民事诉讼，要求追究他们据称参与杀害他的阴谋责任。印度否认政府参与上述阴谋。该民事诉讼与美国的刑事诉讼同步进行，后者源于据称存在的付费谋杀阴谋。美国检方指控尼基尔·古普塔与维卡什·亚达夫合作安排潘嫩遇刺。古普塔于2月认罪。多瓦尔和戈尔尚未在这起刑事案件中被起诉

https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-federal-a.summary_zh: 国会调查得出结论，已故声名狼藉的金融家杰弗里·爱泼斯坦在2005年后犯下的罪行，如果不是联邦调查人员和检察官的“失误”，本可得到阻止。共和党主导的美国众议院监督委员会周二公布了最终报告，指控有关方面对爱泼斯坦及其长期合作者吉斯兰·麦克斯韦尔刑事调查的处置存在“长达数十年的”失当。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-federal-a.body: Crimes committed by the late disgraced financier Jeffrey Epstein after 2005 could have been prevented were it not for "failures" by federal investigators and prosecutors, a congressional investigation has concluded. The Republican-led US House Oversight Committee on Tuesday released its final report into what it described as the "decades-long" mishandling of the criminal investigations into Epstein and his long-term associate Ghislaine Maxwell. The report's findings are based on interviews and depositions with witnesses, government files, and financial records over a 15-month period. Epstein died in 2019 as he awaited trial on sex trafficking charges. "While some of these failures involved an exercise in poor judgment by the USAO, others appeared to be the result of Epstein's pervasive and wide-reaching influence," the report reads, referring to the US Attorney's Office. It states that, rather than fully investigating allegations in other states, the USAO for the Southern District of Florida entered into an agreement with Epstein in 2007 that allowed him to evade federal prosecution. Regarding Epstein's death in a New York prison , investigators concluded this was a result of "a series of institutional failures at the facility," which included staffing shortages, overworked employees, poor recordkeeping, and lax security practices. Testimony the panel solicited was "unable to definitively dispel certain theories" surrounding Epstein's death, the report states, including accounting for a lapse in surveillance footage. It found the Justice Department (DoJ) failed to communicate about document releases and that deficient redactions exposed survivors' sensitive personal information. The DoJ has released millions of pages of Epstein-related files in response to legislation from Congress. Earlier this year, the department had to remove thousands of documents related to Epstein from its website after victims said their identities had been compromised. The report also alleges that financial institutions like American Express enabled human trafficking and immigration fraud by allowing Epstein to use decoy flights and dummy itineraries to transport foreign workers across borders. The BBC has contacted American Express for comment. The investigative panel recommended that Congress should pass legislation to prevent the weaponisation of non-disclosure agreements, which they said Epstein used to silence survivors. "Epstein operated with impunity, shielded and enabled by powerful connections and a justice system that repeatedly failed his victims," said James Comer, the Republican chairman of the committee. He called upon the DoJ to "interview or re-interview key witnesses, investigate Epstein associates accused of criminal activity, and ensure survivors have access to their records. The department remains under bipartisan scrutiny regarding the Epstein files. In the state of New Mexico, where Epstein had a ranch, the top state prosecutor accused the DoJ of stonewalling their criminal investigation. "With all due respect, the Chairman's recommendations have already been addressed," a department spokesperson said in response to Comer's report. The report accuses Democrats of being "obsessed" with trying to implicate US President Donald Trump and that an "unfounded witch hunt continued without regard for the interests of survivors". Trump has previously said he was friendly with Epstein before they fell out in 2004. The president's name appears thousands of times in the Epstein files, but appearing in the documents does not suggest any wrongdoing. The committee's review did not identify any documents that would implicate Trump, the report concluded. In a statement, Rep. Robert Garcia, the top Democrat on the Oversight Committee, alleged his Republican colleagues "released a report based on an incomplete investigation and zero public hearings on Jeffrey Epstein". Garcia accused the Justice Department of withholding "over 2.5 million pages of documents". "We will not allow the President and his allies to dismiss this investigation," said Garcia, who is expected to lead the committee when Democrats take control of Congress in January following the recent midterm elections. The family members of one of Epstein's most prominent accusers, the late Virginia Roberts Giuffre, thanked Comer for releasing Tuesday's report. "A sentence from the report stands out to us: 'Questions remain as to whether the DOJ has released all its relevant documents.' We could not agree more and urge that all 7 million-plus files be released," Sky and Amanda Roberts said in a statement. "There are many more individuals who have yet to be identified and brought to justice," they said
https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-federal-a.title_zh: 报告发现，美国联邦当局本可阻止爱泼斯坦实施犯罪行为
https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-federal-a.body_zh: 国会调查得出结论，如果不是联邦调查人员和检察官“失职”，已故且声名狼藉的金融家杰弗里·爱泼斯坦在2005年以后犯下的罪行本可得到阻止。共和党主导的美国众议院监督委员会周二发布最终报告，描述了对爱泼斯坦及其长期合作者吉斯兰·麦克斯韦尔刑事调查进行“数十年”处理不当的情况。报告结论基于历时15个月的证人访谈和证词、政府档案以及财务记录。爱泼斯坦于2019年sex trafficking（性交易）指控受审期间死亡。报告称：“其中一些失职是美国联邦检察官办公室作出错误判断的表现，另一些则似乎是爱泼斯坦无处不在且影响深远的结果。”报告提及美国联邦检察官办公室时如此写道。报告指出，佛罗里达州南区联邦检察官办公室没有全面调查其他州提出的指控，而是于2007年与爱泼斯坦达成协议，使他得以逃避联邦起诉。关于爱泼斯坦在纽约一所监狱死亡一事，调查人员认定，这是“该设施一系列制度失职”的结果，包括人员短缺、员工超负荷工作、记录管理不善以及安保措施松懈。报告称，专家组收集的证词“无法明确排除围绕爱泼斯坦死亡的某些说法”，其中包括解释为何部分监控录像出现缺失。报告发现，司法部（DoJ）未能就文件公开事宜进行沟通，而且不充分的删节处理暴露了幸存者的敏感个人信息。响应国会立法，司法部已公开数百万页与爱泼斯坦有关的文件。今年早些时候，受害者称其身份信息遭到泄露后，该部门不得不从网站上删除数千份与爱泼斯坦有关的文件。报告还指控，American Express等金融机构纵容人口贩运和移民欺诈，允许爱泼斯坦使用诱饵航班和虚假行程，将外国劳工运送出境。BBC已联系American Express置评。调查小组建议国会通过立法，防止不披露协议被武器化；小组称，爱泼斯坦利用此类协议迫使受害者保持沉默。委员会共和党主席詹姆斯·科默说：“爱泼斯坦在 powerful connections（强大关系）的庇护和助推下肆无忌惮，而司法系统也一再未能为其受害者伸张正义。”他呼吁司法部“约谈或重新约谈关键证人，调查被控从事犯罪活动的爱泼斯坦关联人员，并确保受害者能够获取与其有关的记录。近期中期选举结束后，民主党预计于1月掌控国会，届时将领导该委员会。目前，该部门因爱泼斯坦文件一事仍受到两党审视。在爱泼斯坦拥有一处牧场的新墨西哥州，该州最高检察官指控司法部阻挠州刑事调查。部门发言人在回应科默的报告时表示：“我们充分尊重主席，但主席的建议实际上已经得到落实。”报告指控民主党“执迷于”试图将美国总统唐纳德·特朗普牵涉其中，并称“无根据的猎巫行动无视幸存者的利益，持续进行”。特朗普此前曾表示，他与爱泼斯坦曾是朋友，双方于2004年闹翻。特朗普的名字在爱泼斯坦文件中出现了数千次，但名字出现在文件中并不意味着存在任何不当行为。报告总结称，委员会审查并未发现任何会牵连特朗普的文件。监督委员会首席民主党众议员罗伯特·加西亚在一份声明中指称，其共和党同事“发布了一份基于不完整调查且未举行任何公开听证会的杰弗里·爱泼斯坦报告”。加西亚指控司法部扣留了“超过250万页文件”。加西亚说：“我们不会允许总统及其盟友 dismissing（搁置）这项调查。”预计民主党在近期中期选举后于1月掌控国届时，加西亚将领导该委员会。爱泼斯坦最知名的指控者之一、已故弗吉尼亚·罗伯茨·朱弗的家人感谢科默发布周二的报告。Sky Roberts和Amanda Roberts在一份声明中说：“报告中的这句话令我们印象深刻：‘司法部是否已经公开所有相关文件，目前仍存疑问。’我们完全赞同，并敦促公开全部超过700万份文件。”她们说：“还有许多尚未被查明并绳之以法的人。”

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fina.body: Layer 1 . –1,000 business leaders to sign pact on policy reforms, enterprise growth at Blueprint Summit 2.0 December 3 As Gaye seeks 50-year African businesses, unveils digital platform ABUJA –THE Presidency on Tuesday, said Nigeria’s ambition of building a $1 trillion economy by 2030 depends largely on bringing millions of economically active Nigerians, particularly women, youths and small business owners, into the formal financial system. The Presidency also noted that to unlock the $1 trillion future by 2030, Nigeria must urgently formalize its grassroots economy, maintaining that bringing millions of women, youth, and small business owners into the formal financial system is no longer optional but a prerequisite for growth. Technical Adviser to the President on Economic and Financial Inclusion, Dr Nurudeen Abubakar Zauro, stated this in Abuja while announcing a partnership between the Presidential Committee on Economic and Financial Inclusion (PreCEFI) and the Africa CEO Club ahead of the Africa Blueprint Summit 2.0 billed to hold on December 3, 2026. Zauro said financial inclusion must go beyond opening bank accounts to providing individuals and businesses with access to credit, savings, insurance, pensions, investment opportunities and wider markets. He maintained that the Federal Government’s economic transformation agenda could not achieve its full potential while significant segments of the population remained excluded from formal financial services and productive economic activities. According to him, financial inclusion is a critical driver of economic growth, enterprise development, job creation and national prosperity. According to him: “This work sits at the heart of the Federal Government’s economic agenda. Millions of our citizens, many of them women, young people, rural households and small business owners, still operate outside the formal financial system. ”They lack access to savings, credit, insurance and pensions. If we are to build a one trillion dollar economy, we cannot leave them behind. Inclusion is not charity. It is growth.” The presidential aide said PreCEFI, under the leadership of Vice President Kashim Shettima, was coordinating government institutions, regulators and private-sector stakeholders to expand financial access and ensure that no economically active Nigerian was left behind. Zauro identified digital public infrastructure, consumer protection and simplified onboarding procedures as essential to removing barriers to financial services, particularly the challenges of formal identification and inadequate banking facilities. He stressed that financial inclusion must translate into productive activities, including business expansion, agricultural financing, employment generation and access to domestic and international markets. ”Opening an account is the first step, not the last. True inclusion means that the small business can borrow, grow, hire and one day sell across borders,” he said. Explaining the partnership with Africa CEO Club, Zauro said the collaboration would bridge the gap between financial inclusion and enterprise development by connecting entrepreneurs with institutions offering finance, regulatory support and market opportunities. The summit themed “The Builders’ Mandate: From Blueprint to Build,” is scheduled for December 3, 2026, at the Congress Hall of Transcorp Hilton, Abuja, with about 1,000 business leaders, investors, policymakers and regulators expected from across Africa and the diaspora. He said participants would develop a Builders’ Mandate outlining 10 priority policy interventions expected from governments and 10 corresponding commitments from the private sector to promote economic growth, investment and sustainable businesses. Zauro said PreCEFI would ensure that the interests of micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs), particularly women, and youth-led businesses, feature prominently in discussions on access to capital, regulatory reforms and enterprise development. In her remarks, President of the Africa CEO Club, Dr Fatoumatta Gaye, said the summit would address what she described as Africa’s “institutional deficit”, characterised by the inability of many businesses to survive beyond their founders. She lamented that several African enterprises lacked effective succession plans, management structures and institutional frameworks to ensure continuity across generations. ”Africa does not lack brilliant founders. What we lack are institutions that outlive them. Too many of our businesses rise with one person and fall with that same person. Too few become 50-year companies,” she said. Gaye said the Builders’ Mandate would be endorsed by participating business leaders and presented to governments, while the Africa CEO Club would monitor and publicly report progress on its implementation throughout 2027. She recalled that the maiden edition, held on November 27, 2025, at the Afreximbank African Trade Centre, Abuja, attracted more than 600 business and policy leaders and over 60 media organisations. She disclosed that the inaugural summit facilitated business transactions through its Deal Room and secured $5 million for the development of the Africa CEO Club’s digital ecosystem. According to her, the organisation has since established its headquarters in Abuja, recruited more than 60 employees, expanded its membership and strengthened partnerships with public- and private-sector institutions. She said the digital platform, designed to connect business leaders and enterprises across Africa, would be launched on March 18, 2027. On the December summit, Gaye said the first panel, “Capital That Builds,” would examine sustainable financing and long-term capital for business expansion. Expected speakers, she said, include AMCON Managing Director, Gbenga Alade; Managing Director of the Bank of Agriculture, Ayo Sotinrin; Moniepoint Chief Executive Officer, Tosin Eniolorunda; and Director-General of the Governance Delivery Unit, Dr Olusiji Aina. Other sessions will address policy as infrastructure, business succession and institutional development, alongside a founders’ conversation, live podcast, investment Deal Room and exhibition for MSMEs and start-ups seeking investors, buyers and development partners. Gaye said the event would also be livestreamed to an expected audience of at least three million people. Describing the partnership with PreCEFI as strategic, Gaye said financial inclusion was fundamental to building sustainable enterprises, citing women traders seeking their first bank accounts, young entrepreneurs accessing loans and small manufacturers entering export markets. She urged African business owners and investors to participate in the summit, arguing that collective engagement would strengthen the private sector’s influence on policies concerning taxation, access to finance and investment. Gaye announced that early-bird registration would close on November 15, while groups registering more than three participants would receive a 20 per cent discount. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fina.title_zh: 金融普惠是蒂努布实现1万亿美元国内生产总值目标的关键
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fina.body_zh: 第一层。Blueprint Summit 2.0将于12月3日举行，1,000名商界领袖将签署有关政策改革和企业发展的协议；Gaye寻求打造可存续50年的非洲企业，并公布数字平台。阿布贾——总统府周二表示，尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）力争到2030年建成1万亿美元经济，其目标在很大程度上取决于能否让数百万经济活跃的尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）民众，尤其是女性、青年和小企业主，正式纳入金融体系。总统府还指出，要释放尼日利亚到2030年实现1万亿美元经济前景的潜力，尼日利亚必须 urgently 推动基层经济正规化，并强调让数百万女性、青年和小企业主正式纳入金融体系已不再是可选项，而是增长的必要前提。总统经济与金融包容技术顾问Dr Nurudeen Abubakar Zauro周二在阿布贾宣布了总统经济与金融包容委员会（PreCEFI）与Africa CEO Club的合作，同时宣布将于2026年12月3日举行的Africa Blueprint Summit 2.0。Zauro表示，金融包容必须超越开设银行账户，进一步为个人和企业提供信贷、储蓄、保险、养老金、投资机会以及进入更广泛市场的渠道。他强调，在population中仍有相当一部分人被排除在正规金融服务和生产性经济活动之外的情况下，联邦政府的经济转型议程无法充分发挥潜力。据他所说，金融包容是经济增长、企业发展、创造就业和国家繁荣的重要驱动力。他表示：“这项工作处于联邦政府经济议程的核心位置。数百万公民仍游离于正规金融体系之外，其中许多是女性、年轻人、农村家庭和小企业主。他们无法获得储蓄、信贷、保险和养老金。如果我们要建设一个1万亿美元的经济体，就不能把他们落下。包容不是施舍，而是增长。”总统助理表示，在副总统Kashim Shettima的领导下，PreCEFI正协调政府机构、监管部门和私营部门利益相关方，以扩大金融可及性，确保没有任何经济活跃的尼日利亚人掉队。Zauro指出，数字公共基础设施、消费者保护和简化的开户程序，是消除金融服务障碍的关键，尤其是正式身份认证困难和银行设施不足等问题。他强调，金融包容必须转化为生产性活动，包括扩大经营、农业融资、创造就业以及进入国内和国际市场。“开户是第一步，而不是最后一步。真正的包容意味着小企业能够借贷、发展、招聘，并最终跨境销售，”他说。Zauro在解释与Africa CEO Club的合作时表示，双方将通过把创业者与提供融资、监管支持和市场机会的机构连接起来，弥合金融包容与企业发展之间的鸿沟。峰会主题为“建设者的使命：从蓝图走向建设”，定于2026年12月3日在阿布贾Transcorp Hilton的Congress Hall举行，预计将有约1,000名来自非洲各地及非洲侨民的商业领袖、投资者、政策制定者和监管人员参加。他说，与会者将制定一项“建设者的使命”，提出政府对政策落实的10项优先干预措施，以及私营部门为促进经济增长、投资和可持续发展的 Businesses 所需的10项相应承诺。Zauro表示，PreCEFI将确保微型、小型和中型企业（MSMEs），尤其是女性企业和青年主导企业，在资本获取、监管改革和企业发展等讨论中得到充分重视。Africa CEO Club主席Dr Fatoumatta Gaye在发言中说，本次峰会将探讨她所称的非洲“制度赤字”，其特征是许多企业无法在创始人之后继续生存。她哀叹，非洲许多企业缺乏有效的继任计划、管理架构和确保跨代延续的制度框架。“非洲不缺杰出的创始人。我们缺的是能够比他们存续更久的制度。我们的太多企业随一个人崛起，又随同一个人衰败。能够成为50年企业的太少，”她说。Gaye表示，“建设者的使命”将由参会商业领袖签署并提交给各国政府，Africa CEO Club则将在整个2027年监督执行情况并公开报告进展。她回顾说，首届峰会于2025年11月27日在阿布贾Afreximbank African Trade Centre举行，吸引了600多名商业和政策领袖以及60多家媒体机构。她透露，首届峰会通过其Deal Room促成商业交易，并为Africa CEO Club数字生态系统的发展筹集了500万美元。据她说，该组织此后已在阿布贾设立总部，招聘了60多名员工，扩大了会员规模，并加强了与公共部门和私营部门机构的合作。她说，旨在连接非洲各地商业领袖和企业的数字平台将于2027年3月18日上线。关于12月举行的峰会，Gaye表示，首场论坛“建设资本”将探讨企业扩张所需的可持续融资和长期资本。她说，预计发言者包括AMCON董事总经理Gbenga Alade、农业银行董事总经理Ayo Sotinrin、Moniepoint首席执行官Tosin Eniolorunda，以及Governance Delivery Unit总干事Dr Olusiji Aina。其他场次将讨论政策作为基础设施、企业继任和制度发展，并包括创始人对话、现场播客、投资Deal Room，以及面向寻求投资者、买家和发展伙伴的MSMEs和初创企业的展览。Gaye表示，活动还将直播，预计观众至少达到300万人。Gaye在描述与PreCEFI的合作时称其具有战略意义，并表示金融包容是建设可持续企业的基础。她以寻求首个银行账户的女性商人、获得贷款以扩大经营的年轻创业者，以及进入出口市场的小型制造商为例，敦促非洲企业主和投资者参加峰会，认为各方共同参与将增强私营部门在税收、融资渠道和投资等政策问题上的影响力。Gaye宣布，早鸟注册将于11月15日截止；团体注册超过3名参与者可享受20%的折扣。本文表达的意见不代表Vanguard newspapers及其任何员工的观点

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/11/n.summary: Nigeria’s banking system is expected to receive N2.448 trillion in liquidity inflows this week, largely driven by maturing Open Market Operations (OMO) bills, even as the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) and the Debt Management Office (DMO) prepare fresh debt auctions to absorb excess cash from the financial system.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/11/n.summary_zh: 预计尼日利亚银行系统本周将获得 2.448 万亿奈拉流动性流入，主要由到期的公开市场操作（OMO）票据推动；与此同时，尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）和债务管理办公室（DMO）正准备举行新的债券拍卖，以吸收金融系统中的过剩现金。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/11/n.body: Nigeria’s banking system is expected to receive N2.448 trillion in liquidity inflows this week, largely driven by maturing Open Market Operations (OMO) bills, even as the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) and the Debt Management Office (DMO) prepare fresh debt auctions to absorb excess cash from the financial system. This is according to the Weekly Market Report by the Financial Markets Dealers Association (FMDA), where it projected that OMO maturities would account for N2.298 trillion of the expected inflows, while Treasury bills maturities would contribute N148.565 billion. The anticipated liquidity injection comes against the backdrop of sustained efforts by the CBN to manage excess naira liquidity, with the apex bank raising N5.667 trillion through OMO auctions conducted on November 3 and 6. The anticipated inflows are expected to test the CBN’s liquidity management strategy, particularly as the DMO prepares to raise fresh funds from the market. The N800 billion offer, against only N148.565 billion in Treasury bills maturities, also provides an avenue to withdraw liquidity from the financial system, alongside potential further OMO interventions. Meanwhile, the foreign exchange market recorded divergent movements, with the naira appreciating at the official window but weakening at the parallel market. The country’s external reserves also declined marginally by 0.16 per cent week-on-week to $55.133 billion, following their recent rise above the $55 billion mark, the highest level since December 2008. In the international oil market, average Brent crude fell by 13.45 per cent to $99.97 per barrel, retreating from an intraday high above $116 recorded the previous week. FMDA attributed the decline to easing Middle East supply concerns following signs of de-escalation involving Iran after the United States midterm elections. In the fixed-income market, average FGN bond yields rose by 20 basis points to 16.37 per cent, driven largely by the seven-year instrument, which increased by 104 basis points. Conversely, Treasury bills yields declined by 35 basis points to 17.67 per cent, reflecting a divergence in movements across both segments of the market. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/11/n.title_zh: 债务管理办公室计划发行8000亿奈拉国库券，银行系统预计流入2.45万亿奈拉流动性
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/11/n.body_zh: 预计本周尼日利亚银行系统将获得2.448万亿奈拉流动性流入，主要由到期的公开市场操作（OMO）票据推动；与此同时，尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）和债务管理办公室（DMO）正准备推出新的债券拍卖，以吸收金融体系中的多余现金。据金融市场交易商协会（FMDA）的《每周市场报告》称，OMO到期票据将贡献预计流入资金中的2.298万亿奈拉，国库券到期则将带来1485.65亿奈拉。此次预期流动性注入是在CBN持续努力管理过剩奈拉流动性的背景下出现的；该最高银行机构已通过11月3日和6日举行的OMO拍卖筹集了5.667万亿奈拉。预计流入的资金将考验CBN的流动性管理策略，尤其是在DMO准备从市场筹集新资金之际。8000亿奈拉的发行规模相对于仅1485.65亿奈拉的国库券到期规模，也为从金融体系回收流动性以及可能进一步干预OMO提供了渠道。与此同时，外汇市场走势分化，奈拉在官方窗口升值，但在平行市场走弱。该国外汇储备环比小幅下降0.16%，至551.33亿美元；此前储备 recently 升破550亿美元关口，创下自2008年12月以来的最高水平。在国际石油市场，布伦特原油均价下跌13.45%，至每桶99.97美元，从前一周盘中突破116美元的 highs 回落。FMDA将这一跌幅归因于美国中期选举后伊朗局势出现缓和迹象，使市场对中东供应的担忧减轻。在固定收益市场，尼日利亚联邦政府（FGN）债券平均收益率上升20个基点至16.37%，主要由七年期工具推动，该工具收益率上升104个基点。相反，国库券收益率下降35个基点至17.67%，反映出市场两个板块走势分化。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区以及世界各地设有办公室。它是尼日利亚面向政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛中等阶层的权威新闻媒体，涵盖所有平台，并致力于成为新思想、文化与技术交汇的平台，服务于有抱负者和千禧一代。该报秉持公共信托精神，寻求真理与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育和社区，以及人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送邮件至hello@thisdaylive.com或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/11/e.body: Former Director General of United Nations Industrial Development Organisation (UNIDO), Dr. Kandeh Kolleh Yamkella, was on a familiar turf on Tuesday, October 6, 2026. The occasion was the 6 th Adeola Odutola Lecture, which was organised by the Manufacturers Association of Nigeria (MAN) as part of its 54 th Annual General Meeting. The topic of his lecture was “Leveraging National Industrial Policy to Position Nigeria as Africa’s Industrial Hub.” As he mounted the podium, his audience was expectant. One, the distinguished guest lecturer, Yamkella, has spent more than two decades, studying, analysing, promoting, packaging, delivering and advising government and businesses on industrial policies. Two, the federal government in February 2026 launched Nigeria Industrial Policy (NIP), the first in the country’s history. The kernel of Yamkella’s message was clear and direct: the federal government should back its NIP with a clearly defined energy policy for the country, stating that energy policy must be part of an effective industrial policy. He said: “Energy policy is industrial strategy. If we do not fix that, industry will die because no industrial strategy can succeed without reliable electricity.” This is already killing industries in Nigeria as energy cost is reported to constitute between 30 and 40 per cent of manufacturer’s production cost. And for some manufacturers, the energy cost is as high as 60 per cent. “You know the story. It (energy) is killing your industry. Manufacturers spent an estimated N1.3 trillion on self-generated power in 2025, up from N781 billion in 2023, with energy now accounting for as much as 35 to 40 per cent of production costs. Here, some people even say 60 per cent of their operating costs. Whereas energy makes up roughly between 5.0 and 15 per cent manufacturing costs in countries such as India, Vietnam, Indonesia, Turkey, Mexico and South Africa.” He remarked that the strategic point where Asia is beating Nigeria and most of Africa, is energy cost which it subsidies for its manufacturers. For Asia, energy and water is subsidised but in factories have to generate their own power and have their own boreholes. “So energy policy has to be part of industrial policy.” Yamkella stated that countries do not industrialise simply by producing policy documents. According to him, industrial policy matters only when it becomes productive capacity, investment, technology, competitiveness, pushes value addition and creates jobs. Otherwise, it is as good as a piece of paper. He, therefore, tasked government on practical, deliberate implementation of industrial policy. Policy, he said, is one side of the coin. And government deciding that it will drive industrialisation another. That is how the Asians have done it. Because the risks and constraints are many even though Nigeria has the essential foundations for an industrial powerhouse. Yet, he reminded his audience that potential is not performance. Otherwise manufacturing contributions should not be between seven and eight per cent of the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) as it is currently in Nigeria. In addition, manufacturing exports generate only 3.0 per cent of the country’s export revenue, which, he said, is far below several other African peers. He pointed out that Nigeria’s biggest economic paradox has been that the country has a large market and abundant resources, yet imports dominate everyday consumption. “I am aware of the government’s effort to change this narrative through the Nigerian industrial policy launched on February 17 this year. Nigeria’s industrial challenge is therefore not a shortage of ambition or enterprise. It is the need to convert scale into productivity, competitiveness, and exports. So we must ask ourselves what it will take to make this ambition a reality at a time that the world is changing,” he said. One of the ways to realise Nigeria’s industrial ambition is for the government to ensure that its newly launched industrial policy must become industrial action. The former UNIDO chief said, “Policy is only the starting point. The true test of any industrial policy lies not in its design alone, but in the execution. So there are key parameters that government must monitor deliberately to check if the policy is working. These parameters are how many new factories are being established because of the new policy? How many existing factories are expanding? How much domestic value is created? How much investment is mobilised? “I say this because in my career at UNIDO, over 75 countries I went to, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, the European countries, China, you name it, their governments are actually visiting factories to measures performance. If it is not going where they want it, the government will put public capital and change policy. The countries I know in Asia that made that break, like Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and others who are catching up, Vietnam, Cambodia, their governments measure how many new factories did we create?” Yamkella said that rather than waiting for MAN to complain, governments in Nigeria should be asking MAN: how do we help your members grow? That’s how Indians grow. He added, “That is why when the consultant came here to look at your textile sector, he looked at the cost of energy and water in Nigerian factories and said that even with cheap labour, you cannot compete because we find other ways to subsidise them by making electricity cheap. So government itself must want to measure and be a friend of MAN and the manufacturers on how to make them do better so that they can create jobs and wealth? It is deliberate policy. It is not just a paper. Government has to be deliberate. But there’s some hope.” Apart from addressing the high cost energy, Yamkella said that Nigeria must think beyond its borders by become world’s dominant players in cement. fertiliser and electric car battery manufacturing. This, he stated, will require a new supply chain that will link the country with Togo and Congo. “Now, fertilizer. Nigeria is producing urea. Togo has phosphate, and Congo has potash. Nigeria could be top five producer of fertilizer in five years. That is the aim, that is the dream. That is why Nigeria must think beyond its borders. You have the core already; your neighbours have the others. Morocco, Togo, Congo. It’s about you producing. But industrial policy should support that now to grow. How do we make that transform Nigeria into one of the leading fertilizer producers of the world? Because I tell you, from America to Europe, everybody’s struggling for fertilizer, ”he said. Yamkella also believed that Nigeria can lead Africa in automobile manufacturing by using deliberate policy actions to drive production. He said: “Nigeria’s industrial future cannot be defined by domestic market alone. Nigeria must manufacture for Nigeria, but also for West Africa, the rest of Africa, and in fact, the world. The opportunity before us is greater than the constraints. I know that, yes, Nigeria can be the powerhouse and the hub for West Africa, and in fact, for the rest of the continent as well.” He recognised that Nigeria has one of Africa’s largest automotive markets and significant assembling capacity. But remarked that there is gap between license capacity and actual production that reminds us that license are not factories. According to him, “installed capacity is not production and assembly without local value chains is not industrial transformation.” Nevertheless, the opportunity, however, is substantial in Nigeria to compete in electric motorcycles, battery swapping systems, buses, fleet vehicles, battery packs assembly, charging infrastructure, and other components for the automotive industry. “But the biggest opportunity I see, and you are doing it already because your solid minerals policy on lithium that says if you want our lithium, you should process 30 per cent here,” he said, adding that Nigeria has “one policy already that is already attracting three, four companies to process your lithium. Put another policy to say now you make the batteries here. “You become the battery hub for the region. That is industrial policy in action. But it has to be backed now by other policies,”he said. Yamkella said that it is good that Nigeria has come back to embrace industrial policy after decades of deindustrialisation that was occasioned by wholesale embrace of the Washington Consensus that it is all about market liberalisation on the premise that industrial policy is not necessary anymore. “ And of course, Africa followed that doctrine. And a lot of industries died, especially here (Nigeria). UNIDO did studies here in Nigeria during my tenure to show the death of Nigerian industry. And we call it de-industrialisation because Nigeria suddenly opened its market. Well, when I went to Asia, it was the opposite. They were still supporting industry.” The Asians never listened. They continued to use public capital, public policy to directly support the industry,” he added. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/11/e.title_zh: 能源政策是制造业取得竞争优势的最终驱动力
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/11/e.body_zh: 联合国工业发展组织（UNIDO）前总干事坎德·科莱·亚姆凯拉博士于2026年10月6日星期二回到了一个熟悉的地方。此次活动是制造商协会（MAN）举办的第54届年度大会的一部分，也是第6届阿德奥拉·奥杜托拉演讲会。亚姆凯拉演讲的题目是《利用国家工业政策将尼日利亚打造为非洲工业中心》。他登上讲台时，台下听众满怀期待。首先，这位 Distinguished 客座演讲者亚姆凯拉花了二十多年研究、分析、推广、阐释和实施工业政策，并向政府和企业提供工业政策方面的建议。其次，联邦政府于2026年2月推出尼日利亚工业政策（NIP），这是该国历史上的第一部工业政策。亚姆凯拉讲话的核心明确而直接：联邦政府应以一项界定清晰的能源政策支持尼日利亚工业政策，并指出能源政策必须成为有效工业政策的一部分。他说：“能源政策就是工业战略。如果不解决这个问题，工业就会消亡，因为没有可靠的电力，任何工业战略都不可能成功。”据报道，能源成本占制造商生产成本的30%至40%，这已经在扼杀尼日利亚的工业；对一些制造商而言，能源成本甚至高达60%。他说：“情况就是这样。它（能源）正在扼杀你们的工业。2025年，制造商在自行发电方面支出了估计1.3万亿奈拉，而2023年为7810亿奈拉，如今能源占生产成本的比例高达35%至40%。这里有些人甚至说，能源占运营成本的60%。相比之下，在印度、越南、印度尼西亚、土耳其、墨西哥和南非等国家，能源约占制造成本的5.0%至15%。”他指出，亚洲超越尼日利亚以及非洲大多数国家的战略优势在于能源成本，亚洲为制造商提供补贴。对亚洲而言，能源和用水受到补贴，但工厂必须自行发电、自备水井。“因此，能源政策必须成为工业政策的一部分。”亚姆凯拉表示，一个国家不能仅靠制定政策文件就实现工业化。据他所说，工业政策只有转化为生产能力、投资、技术和竞争力，推动附加值并创造就业机会，才具有实质意义。否则，它不过是一张纸。因此，他要求政府切实而有意识地执行工业政策。他说，政策是硬币的一面，政府决定推动工业化则是另一面。亚洲国家正是这样做的。尽管尼日利亚已经具备成为工业强国的必要基础，但其面临的风险和制约因素众多。然而，他提醒听众，潜力并不等于表现。否则，尼日利亚的制造业贡献如今不应仅为国内生产总值（GDP）的7%至8%。此外，制造业出口仅占该国出口收入的3.0%，据他说，这远低于其他几个非洲同行。他指出，尼日利亚最大的经济悖论在于，该国拥有庞大的市场和丰富的资源，但日常消费仍由进口商品主导。他说：“我知道，政府正努力通过今年2月17日推出的尼日利亚工业政策改变这一局面。因此，尼日利亚面临的工业挑战并非缺乏雄心或进取精神，而是需要把规模转化为生产力、竞争力和出口。因此，在世界正在发生变化的当下，我们必须自问，要采取什么措施才能让这一雄心成为现实。”实现尼日利亚工业雄心的途径之一，是政府确保新推出的工业政策转化为工业行动。这位前UNIDO负责人说：“政策只是起点。任何工业政策的真正考验不仅在于其设计，更在于其执行。因此，政府必须有意识地监测一些关键参数，以检验政策是否奏效。这些参数包括：新政策促使多少新工厂建立？多少现有工厂正在扩大？创造了多少国内附加值？动员了多少投资？我之所以这么说，是因为我在UNIDO任职期间走访了75个国家，包括孟加拉国、斯里兰卡、欧洲国家、中国，以及所有你能想到的地方。它们的政府确实会实地走访工厂，衡量绩效。如果发展没有达到预期，政府就会投入公共资本并调整政策。我所了解的亚洲国家中，那些实现突破的国家，如孟加拉国、斯里兰卡以及其他正在赶上的国家，包括越南、柬埔寨，它们的政府会衡量我们建成了多少新工厂。”亚姆凯拉表示，尼日利亚各级政府不应坐等制造商协会抱怨，而应主动询问制造商协会：“我们如何帮助会员实现增长？”印度人正是这样发展的。他补充说：“因此，当顾问前来考察你们的纺织业时，他查看了尼日利亚工厂的能源和用水成本，并指出，即使劳动力廉价，你们也无法参与竞争，因为我们会通过降低电力价格，采用其他方式提供补贴。因此，政府本身必须有意愿去衡量绩效，并成为制造商协会和制造商的伙伴，帮助他们做得更好，从而创造就业和财富。这是一项有意实施的政策，不只是一张纸。政府必须有明确的行动意愿。不过，仍有一些希望。”除了应对高能源成本外，亚姆凯拉还表示，尼日利亚必须突破国界局限，成为水泥、化肥和电动汽车电池制造领域的世界主导者。为此，必须建立将该国与多哥和刚果连接起来的新供应链。他说：“现在说化肥。尼日利亚正在生产尿素。多哥拥有磷酸盐，刚果拥有钾盐。尼日利亚五年内可以成为全球前五大化肥生产国。这是目标，也是梦想。因此，尼日利亚必须突破国界。你们已经拥有核心原料，邻国则拥有其他原料，包括摩洛哥、多哥和刚果。关键在于你们开展生产。但工业政策现在就应予以支持，以推动增长。我们要如何实现这一目标，让尼日利亚成为世界主要化肥生产国之一？因为我告诉你，从美洲到欧洲，所有人都在争夺化肥。”亚姆凯拉还认为，尼日利亚可以通过有针对性的政策行动推动生产，在非洲汽车制造领域发挥领导作用。他说：“尼日利亚的工业未来不能只由国内市场来定义。尼日利亚不仅要为尼日利亚生产，还要为西非、非洲其他地区，乃至全世界生产。摆在我们面前的机会大于制约因素。我知道，尼日利亚确实可以成为西非乃至整个非洲大陆的工业强国和中心。”他承认，尼日利亚拥有非洲最大的汽车市场之一和 significant 组装能力，但也指出，牌照产能与实际产量之间仍存在差距，这提醒人们，牌照并不等于工厂。据他所说，“已安装产能不等于生产，没有本地价值链的组装也不等于产业转型”。尽管如此，尼日利亚在电动摩托车、换电系统、客车、车队车辆、电池组装配、充电基础设施以及汽车工业其他零部件领域，仍有巨大的竞争机会。他说：“但我看到的最大机会在于，而且你们已经在行动，因为你们的固态矿产政策针对锂作出规定：想获得我们的锂，就必须将30%的加工留在本地。”他补充说，尼日利亚“已经制定了一项政策，而且这项政策已经吸引三四家公司加工你们的锂。再制定一项政策，规定现在必须在本国制造电池。届时，你们就会成为本地区的电池中心。这就是工业政策的实际运用。但现在还必须有其他政策配合。”亚姆凯拉表示，尼日利亚在经历数十年的去工业化之后重新拥抱工业政策是一件好事；此前，该国全面接受华盛顿共识，以市场自由化为核心，并以前提“工业政策已不再必要”为依据。“当然，非洲也追随了这一信条。结果许多工业消亡了，尤其是在这里（尼日利亚）。我任职期间，UNIDO在尼日利亚开展研究，揭示尼日利亚工业的消亡。我们称之为去工业化，因为尼日利亚突然开放了市场。然而，当我去亚洲时，情况正相反。它们仍在支持工业。亚洲人从未听信这套说法。他们继续利用公共资本和公共政策直接支持工业。”他补充道。THISDAY创刊于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.summary_zh: 韩国半导体产业的繁荣为大型芯片企业的员工带来了巨额奖金，有些人甚至开始考虑提前退休。“他们说经济正在蓬勃发展，但感觉却毫无希望。”这种反差凸显了韩国经济日益扩大的分化。人工智能热潮推动半导体企业盈利激增，提升了企业利润，却没有给产业之外的劳动者和企业带来同等好处。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body: Korea's semiconductor boom is generating enormous bonuses for employees at major chipmakers, with some even considering early retirement. But for young job seekers struggling to land their first job and small business owners facing falling sales, the country's economic recovery feels increasingly out of reach. "Even with strong qualifications, it's difficult to get past the initial resume screening," said a job seeker in their 20s. "They say the economy is booming, but it feels hopeless." The contrast highlights a widening divide in Korea's economy, where soaring semiconductor earnings fueled by the artificial intelligence boom have lifted corporate profits without delivering comparable benefits to workers and businesses outside the industry. While employees at Samsung Electronics and SK hynix anticipate substantial performance bonuses, young people face a prolonged employment slump. Luxury retailers and department stores are enjoying robust sales even as neighborhood restaurants and small businesses struggle to survive. The growing disparity raises questions about whether Korea's headline economic growth is translating into meaningful improvements in living standards across industries, income groups and regions. According to September employment data released by the national statistics agency, the number of employed people aged 15 to 29 fell by 147,000 from a year earlier, marking the 47th consecutive month of decline. The youth employment rate dropped 1.1 percentage points to 44 percent, extending its downward trend to 29 consecutive months. Even those who secure stable jobs face another obstacle: the soaring cost of housing. Apartment prices in Seoul have risen for 91 consecutive weeks, making homeownership increasingly difficult for young workers without substantial financial support from their families. A 38-year-old office worker surnamed Park, who recently set up a marital home in Anyang, Gyeonggi Province, said a decade of employment had still not been enough to afford a home in Seoul. "I was shocked that even after working for 10 years, the two of us still couldn't afford a single home in Seoul," Park said. "I've come to realize how much the timing of living under the Moon Jae-in and Lee Jae Myung administrations can affect the wealth gap." Park's comments reflect frustration over the role of housing prices and government policies in shaping wealth accumulation across generations. For some semiconductor employees, however, the financial picture looks dramatically different. An employee at Samsung Electronics said the industry's current boom had brought expectations of extraordinary performance bonuses. "I graduated from a regional national university and got a job without much difficulty in 2018," the employee said. "With the semiconductor boom this year, I heard I could receive around 700 million won ($500,000) in bonuses early next year, so I bought a home in Bundang." The employee said reports of potential bonuses totaling 8 billion won over five years had even prompted thoughts of joining the "FIRE" movement, short for Financial Independence, Retire Early. The figures reflect the employee's account and expectations rather than confirmed companywide payouts, but illustrate the striking contrast between workers benefiting from the semiconductor boom and those struggling to enter the labor market. While the government considers how to allocate growing tax revenues, many neighborhood businesses are struggling with weak demand and rising operating expenses. For Yoo Deok-hyun, 67, who has operated a Korean restaurant near Daebang Station in Seoul's Yeongdeungpo District for 12 years, news of an economic boom bears little resemblance to his daily reality. "Sales have fallen 20 to 30 percent compared with a year ago, while ingredient prices have risen 10 to 20 percent depending on the item," Yoo said. Yoo has reduced his workforce by two employees to manage expenses, but the cuts have not been enough to offset declining revenue and rising costs. Official figures suggest that the pressure extends well beyond individual businesses. According to the Korea Real Estate Board, the nationwide vacancy rate for general commercial properties rose from 11.96 percent in the first quarter of 2021 to 13.36 percent in the second quarter of this year. The rate increased for seven consecutive quarters beginning in the third quarter of 2024, reaching its highest level since 2021. Last year, approximately 976,000 business operators shut down, down from 1.008 million the previous year but still close to the 1 million mark. Among them, 317,406 had operated their businesses for at least five years before closing, the highest figure since 2005. For many former business owners, financial difficulties continue long after their shops close. According to Financial Supervisory Service data obtained by Rep. Park Hong-bae of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea, 275,981 self-employed borrowers who had closed their businesses at least six months earlier held a combined 21.12 trillion won in outstanding bank loans as of the end of June. That represented a 54 percent increase from the end of 2021. Over the same period, their overdue loan balances surged 369.5 percent, underscoring the lasting financial burden facing former small business owners. In sharp contrast, Korea's premium retail sector is enjoying strong growth. According to the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources, department store sales increased by an average of 18.98 percent year-on-year during the first eight months of this year. Sales of imported luxury goods grew by a monthly average of 28.7 percent over the same period. The figures suggest that spending among affluent consumers remains resilient even as many households and small businesses struggle with the rising cost of living. The divergence also underscores the uneven nature of the economic recovery, with the semiconductor industry and high-end consumption benefiting from favorable conditions while sectors dependent on domestic demand remain under pressure. Economists warn that Korea's heavy reliance on semiconductors could leave the broader economy vulnerable if the current industry boom loses momentum. Kim Jung-sik, professor emeritus of economics at Yonsei University, said stronger headline growth has done little to ease the difficulties facing businesses and workers dependent on domestic demand. "Even though the economic growth rate is rising, domestic demand remains sluggish, leaving self-employed business owners and young job seekers in a difficult situation," Kim said. He also warned that Korea's other major industries, including automobiles, petrochemicals and heavy industry, are facing increasing competitive pressure from China. "If the semiconductor industry also enters a downturn, problems will begin to emerge in the weakest parts of our economy," he said. The widening divide carries broader social risks. When economic growth benefits only a limited segment of society, frustration over unequal opportunities and diminished prospects for upward mobility can intensify. Recent social tensions in France offer a reminder of how economic inequality and uncertainty about the future can contribute to wider public discontent. For Korea, the challenge is ensuring that the benefits of the semiconductor boom extend beyond a handful of successful companies and their employees. Without stronger job creation, a recovery in domestic consumption and more opportunities for wealth accumulation, the country's impressive economic growth figures may continue to mask the financial struggles of many ordinary Koreans. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.title_zh: 百万美元奖金与关门歇业的店铺：韩国经济的两面
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body_zh: 韩国半导体产业繁荣为大型芯片企业的员工带来了巨额奖金，有些人甚至开始考虑提前退休。但对于难以找到第一份工作的年轻求职者和销量下滑的小企业主来说，该国的经济复苏似乎越来越遥不可及。一名20多岁的求职者说：“即使资历条件很强，也很难通过最初的简历筛选。他们说经济一片繁荣，但感觉毫无希望。”这种反差凸显了韩国经济中日益扩大的鸿沟。人工智能热潮推动半导体企业利润飙升，却未能给该行业之外的劳动者和商家带来同等收益。Samsung Electronics和SK hynix的员工预计将获得可观的业绩奖金，与此同时，年轻人却面对长期持续的就业低迷。即使奢侈品零售商和百货商店销售强劲，街边餐厅和小企业仍在艰难求生。不断扩大的差距引发了这样的疑问：韩国总体经济增速加快，是否正在转化为各行业、不同收入群体和各地区生活水平的实质性改善？据国家统计机构发布的9月就业数据，15岁至29岁的就业人数同比减少14.7万人，连续第47个月下降。青年就业率下降1.1个百分点，降至44%，下行趋势已延续29个月。即便是找到稳定工作的人，也要面对另一重障碍：不断飙升的住房成本。首尔公寓价格已连续91周上涨，没有家庭大力经济支持的年轻劳动者愈发难以拥有住房。一名38岁的办公室职员Park最近在京畿道安养市建立婚房。他说，工作10年后仍买不起首尔的住房。“我震惊的是，即便工作了10年，我们两个人在首尔仍买不起一套房。”Park说，“我逐渐意识到，在Moon Jae-in和Lee Jae Myung两届政府执政时期生活，会在多大程度上影响财富差距。”Park的言论反映出人们对住房价格和政府政策如何塑造不同世代财富积累的不满。然而，对一些半导体行业员工来说，财务状况截然不同。一名Samsung Electronics员工说，该行业当前的繁荣让员工对非凡的业绩奖金充满期待。这名员工说：“我毕业于地方国立大学，2018年不费什么周折就找到了工作。听说今年半导体行业繁荣，明年年初我可能拿到约7亿韩元（$500,000）的奖金，于是我在Wonju市富平郡买了房。”他说，关于未来五年奖金总额可能达到80亿韩元的报道，甚至让他萌生了加入“FIRE”运动的想法。FIRE是Financial Independence, Retire Early的缩写，意为“财务自由，提前退休”。这些数字反映的是该员工的说法和预期，而非公司已确认的全员奖金发放额，但它们清楚展现了从半导体繁荣中获益的劳动者与难以进入就业市场者之间的鲜明反差。在政府考虑如何分配不断增加的税收收入之际，许多社区商家却因需求疲软和运营成本上升而艰难经营。67岁的Yoo Deok-hyun在首尔永登浦区大bang站附近经营一家韩国餐厅已有12年。经济繁荣的消息与他的日常现实几乎毫无相似之处。Yoo说：“与一年前相比，销售额下降了20%至30%，而食材价格因品类不同上涨了10%至20%。”为控制开支，Yoo裁减了两名员工，但裁员仍不足以抵消收入下降和成本上升的影响。官方数据表明，压力远不局限于个别商家。据韩国房地产院数据，全国普通商业地产空置率从2021年第一季度的11.96%升至今年第二季度的13.36%。该比率自2024年第三季度起连续7个季度上升，达到2021年以来最高水平。去年约有97.6万名经营者关停 businesses，数量低于上一年的100.8万名，但仍接近100万大关。其中，317,406人在关停前经营至少5年，创2005年以来最高纪录。对许多前经营者而言，店铺关闭后，经济困难仍会长期持续。据韩国执政党民主党议员Park Hong-bae获得的金融监督院数据，截至6月底，至少在6个月前已经关停企业的27.5981万名自营 borrower 仍有合计21.12万亿韩元的未偿银行贷款，较2021年底增加54%。同期，他们的逾期贷款余额飙升369.5%，凸显前小企业主长期承受的财务负担。与此形成鲜明对比的是，韩国高端零售业正蓬勃增长。据韩国产业通商资源部数据，今年前8个月百货商店销售额同比平均增长18.98%。同期，进口奢侈品销售额月均增长28.7%。这些数字表明，即使许多家庭和小企业艰难应对生活成本上涨，富裕消费者的消费仍保持韧性。这种分化也凸显了经济复苏的不均衡：半导体行业和高消费领域受益于有利环境，而依赖国内需求的行业仍承受压力。经济学家警告，韩国对半导体行业依赖程度较高，如果当前行业繁荣失去动力，更广泛的经济将面临脆弱性。延世大学名誉经济学教授Kim Jung-sik说，总体增长走强几乎未能缓解依赖国内需求的商家和劳动者所面临的困难。Kim说：“尽管经济增长率上升，国内需求依然疲软，使自营业主和年轻求职者处境艰难。”他还警告，韩国包括汽车、石化和重工业在内的其他主要产业，正面临来自中国的日益激烈的竞争压力。他说：“如果半导体行业也进入下行阶段，我们经济中最薄弱的部分就会开始出现问题。”不断扩大的鸿沟还会带来更广泛的社会风险。当经济增长只惠及社会一小部分群体时，人们对机会不平等和向上流动前景黯淡的不满可能加剧。法国近期的社会紧张提醒人们，经济不平等和对未来的不确定性可能促成更广泛的社会不满。对韩国而言，挑战在于确保半导体繁荣的收益不再局限于少数成功企业及其员工。如果没有更强的就业创造、国内消费复苏和更多财富积累机会，该国亮眼的经济增长数据可能继续掩盖许多普通韩国人的财务困境。本文转载自《韩国时报》的姊妹报《韩国先驱报》，由生成式人工智能系统翻译、《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111101.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者民善熙=韩国外交部长赵显于10日（当地时间）在法国巴黎与乌克兰外长安德烈·西比哈举行会谈，强调相互尊重与信任、切实履行协议是发展两国关系的基本前提。据外交部介绍，赵显借主要7国（G7）外长会议之机举行的当天会谈中表达上述立场，并表示希望两国之间的各项悬案能够得到圆满解决。此番言论被认为考虑到韩国政府就乌克兰违反关于将朝鲜军战俘送往韩国的非公开协议而提出的道歉要求，以及防止此类事件再次发生等措施。西比哈在会谈后于自己的X（原Twitter）账号上表示：“确信两国关系全面正常化将采取进一步措施”“这就是我们为实现这一目标而努力的结果”。这是韩国政府上月8日召见常驻乌克兰大使朴基昌，并于同月20日撤回一半公职人员后，两国外长首次直接会面。韩国政府一直要求乌方作出明确解释、道歉并承诺防止事件重演，但外交部当天的新闻发布中并未确认乌方道歉或承诺防止事件重演等具体进展。外交部官员评价此次会谈称：“这意味着双方将确认彼此立场，并继续为解决矛盾、寻找切入点而开展外交努力。”赵显当天表示，韩国政府对支持乌克兰的原则立场保持不变，将继续研究向乌克兰民众提供所需人道主义援助以及协助重建的方案。西比哈对韩方的支持表示感谢，并希望包括韩国在内的国际社会继续密切协商，为乌克兰和平作出努力。报道传送：KakaoTalk okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载·再分发，禁止用于AI学习及使用> 2026/11/11 08:30发布。2026年11月11日08时30分发布（首尔=韩联社）赵显外交部长于10日（当地时间）在法国巴黎出席G7外长会议期间会见乌克兰外长安德烈·西比哈并举行会谈。2026.11.11 [外交部提供。禁止转售及用于数据库] photo@yna.co.kr （首尔=韩联社）赵显外交部长于10日（当地时间）在法国巴黎出席G7外长会议期间会见乌克兰外长安德烈·西比哈，双方握手交谈。2026.11.11 [外交部提供。禁止转售及用于数据库] photo@yna.co.kr

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111102.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 신재우 기자 = 우크라이나가 도널드 트럼프 미 행정부의 경고에도 러시아 정유 시설에 드론 공격을 강화하면서 러시아 전체 원유 정제능력의 약 30%가 타격을 입은 것으로 전해졌다. 역내 연료난 속에서도 미국과 합의에 따라 경유를 수출하고 있는 러시아는 우크라이나의 잇따른 공격으로 연료 수급에 더욱 큰 차질을 빚을 것으로 보인다. 10일(현지시간) 로이터통신에 따르면 러시아 석유업계 관계자 2명은 우크라이나가 지난달 말부터 러시아 정유시설에 대한 드론 공격을 재개하면서 전체 정제능력의 약 30%에 해당하는 시설이 영향을 받았다고 밝혔다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111102.summary_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者申宰宇＝据报道，乌克兰不顾唐纳德·特朗普美国政府的警告，加大了对俄罗斯炼油设施的无人机攻击，俄罗斯全国原油炼化能力约30%受到打击。尽管面临地区燃料短缺，俄罗斯仍按照与美国的协议出口柴油，随着乌克兰接连发动袭击，其燃料供应预计将面临更大障碍。据路透社10日（当地时间）报道，俄罗斯石油业界人士称，自上月底乌克兰恢复对俄罗斯炼油设施发动无人机袭击以来，炼油能力中相当于全国约30%的设施受到影响。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111102.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 신재우 기자 = 우크라이나가 도널드 트럼프 미 행정부의 경고에도 러시아 정유 시설에 드론 공격을 강화하면서 러시아 전체 원유 정제능력의 약 30%가 타격을 입은 것으로 전해졌다. 역내 연료난 속에서도 미국과 합의에 따라 경유를 수출하고 있는 러시아는 우크라이나의 잇따른 공격으로 연료 수급에 더욱 큰 차질을 빚을 것으로 보인다. 10일(현지시간) 로이터통신에 따르면 러시아 석유업계 관계자 2명은 우크라이나가 지난달 말부터 러시아 정유시설에 대한 드론 공격을 재개하면서 전체 정제능력의 약 30%에 해당하는 시설이 영향을 받았다고 밝혔다. 지난 일주일 동안 러시아의 주요 정유시설 35곳 가운데 9곳이 우크라이나의 공격을 받아 가동 차질 등 비상 상황이 발생했다. 업계 소식통들에 따르면 지난달 말 이후 공격받은 정유시설들의 설계상 원유 정제능력은 하루 약 30만t(220만 배럴)에 달한다. 다만 공격받은 시설이 모두 가동을 중단한 것은 아니어서 실제 원유 처리량 감소 규모는 이보다 적을 것으로 추정된다. 업계 소식통들은 지난달 말 하루 약 70만t(500만 배럴)이었던 러시아의 원유 처리량이 이번 공격으로 하루 최대 20만t 줄었을 것으로 추산했다. 러시아의 대형 정유시설도 공격을 피하지 못했다. 지난 9일 밤에는 우크라이나 드론이 러시아에서 두 번째로 큰 키리시 정유시설을 타격해 화재가 발생했다. 우크라이나는 지난달 말 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 발표한 러시아와 우크라이나 간 에너지시설 공격 중단 조치가 실효를 거두지 못하자 러시아 정유시설에 대한 공세를 강화해왔다. 세르게이 라브로프 러시아 외무장관은 전날 러시아 일간 코메르산트 기고문에서 우크라이나가 러시아 에너지시설 공격을 중단하라는 트럼프 대통령의 요구를 무시하고 있다고 비판했다. 반면 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령은 자국의 공격은 우크라이나 에너지 기반 시설을 겨냥한 러시아의 공습에 대응하는 차원이라고 주장했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/11 08:25 송고 2026년11월11일 08시25분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111102.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者申在宇＝据报道，尽管唐纳德·特朗普的美国政府发出警告，乌克兰仍加大力度袭击俄罗斯炼油设施，俄罗斯整体原油炼化能力约30%遭受打击。俄罗斯在与美国达成协议后继续出口柴油，即使区域内燃料短缺不断加剧，乌克兰接连发动袭击预计也将使俄罗斯的燃料供应面临更大障碍。据路透社10日（当地时间）报道，俄罗斯石油业界人士称，自上月底乌克兰恢复对俄罗斯炼油设施发动无人机袭击以来，约占整体炼化能力30%的设施受到影响。过去一周，俄罗斯35座主要炼油设施中有9座遭乌克兰袭击，发生运营中断等紧急情况。据业界消息人士介绍，上月底以来遭袭炼油设施的设计原油炼化能力约为每天30万吨（220万桶）。不过，并非所有遭袭设施都停止运营，因此实际原油加工量的降幅预计小于上述数字。业界消息人士估算，俄罗斯原油加工量上月底约为每天70万吨（500万桶），此次袭击预计使日加工量最多减少20万吨。俄罗斯大型炼油设施也未能躲过袭击。9日晚，乌克兰无人机袭击了俄罗斯第二大炼油设施基里希炼油厂，并引发火灾。上月底特朗普美国总统宣布俄罗斯与乌克兰之间暂停攻击能源设施的措施未能奏效后，乌克兰加强了对俄罗斯炼油设施的攻势。俄罗斯外长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫在前一天刊登于俄罗斯日报《商业报》的文章中批评称，乌克兰无视特朗普总统要求停止袭击俄罗斯能源设施的呼吁。与此同时，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，乌克兰发动袭击是为了回应俄罗斯针对乌克兰能源基础设施发动的袭击。报道可通过KakaoTalk发送给okjebo。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、重新发布，禁止用于人工智能学习及使用。2026年11月11日08:25发布

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111102.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 황철환 기자 = IBK투자증권은 크래프톤[259960]에 대한 목표주가를 42만원에서 30만원으로 하향 조정했다고 11일 밝혔다. 투자의견은 '매수'를 유지했다. 이승훈 연구원은 "크래프톤의 2026년 3분기 실적이 컨센서스(시장평균전망치·매출액 1조1천177억원, 영업이익 2천715억원)를 하회했다"면서 2027년 추정 주당순이익(EPS) 하향 조정을 반영해 목표주가를 낮췄다고 밝혔다. 크래프톤은 3분기 매출액이 9천714억원으로 전년 대비 11.6% 증가했으나, 영업이익은 2천250억원으로 35.5% 감소했고, 지배순이익은 641억원 손실로 적자전환했다고 전날 공시했다. 이 연구원은 "매출 감소의 핵심 원인은 PC 매출 급감으로, 유료화 콘텐츠 감소와 서브노티카 2 초기 효과 소멸 영향"이라면서 "반면 PUBG PC·콘솔 월간활성사용자수(MAU)는 두 자릿수 성장을 유지했고, 모바일도 전분기 대비 11.8% 성장했다"고 설명했다. 또, 영업비용은 전분기 대비 감소했으나 게임스컴 참가 영향으로 마케팅비가 650억원으로 증가했고, 영업외손익에선 달러 약세로 외화 손실이 있었다고 덧붙였다. 다만 4분기에는 PUBG PC 실적은 벤틀리·IVE와의 콜라보레이션 등에 힘입어 뚜렷한 반등세를 보일 것이고, 모바일 부문에서는 신흥시장 저사양 단말기 유저층을 타깃으로 한 저용량 버전 BGMI 에어가 출시될 예정이라고 이 연구원은 강조했다. 이 연구원은 "2027년에는 '팰월드 모바일', 'PUBG: 데드넷(DED.NET)', '노 로우(NO LAW)' 등 핵심 신작 파이프라인이 본격 가동되며 외형 및 이익 성장의 모멘텀으로 작용할 것"이라고 내다봤다. 그는 "2026년 연간 총 주주환원액은 배당과 자사주 매입·소각을 포함할시 현재 시가총액의 9.3% 수준인 9천172억원"이라면서 "견고한 주주환원책이 주가 하단을 지지하는 가운데, 내년 신작 라인업 가동으로 실적 개선 가능성이 높다"고 말했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/11 08:24 송고 2026년11월11일 08시24분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111102.title_zh: IBK证券下调CraFTon目标价……“已反映明年每股收益下调”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111102.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者黄铁铉＝IBK投资证券11日宣布，将Krafton（259960）的目标股价由42万韩元下调至30万韩元，维持“买入”投资评级。研究员李昇勋表示：“Krafton第三季度业绩低于市场一致预期（市场平均预测：营收1.1177万亿韩元、营业利润2715亿韩元）。”他说，鉴于下调了对2027年预期每股收益（EPS）的预测，因此调低了目标股价。Krafton前一天公告称，公司第三季度营收为9714亿韩元，同比增长11.6%，但营业利润为2250亿韩元，同比下降35.5%，归母净利润亏损641亿韩元，陷入亏损。该研究员解释道：“营收下降的核心原因是PC营收骤减，受到付费内容减少和Subnautica 2初期效应消退的影响。另一方面，PUBG PC和主机版月活跃用户数（MAU）保持两位数增长，移动版也较上一季度增长11.8%。”他还表示，尽管营业费用环比下降，但由于参加Gamescom，营销费用增至650亿韩元；营业外损益方面，美元走弱导致汇兑损失。不过，该研究员强调，第四季度PUBG PC业务将在与Bentley、IVE等合作项目的推动下明显反弹，移动业务则计划推出面向新兴市场低配置设备用户的低容量版本BGMI Air。该研究员预计：“2027年，随着《幻兽帕鲁》手游、《PUBG: Deadnet（DED.NET）》、《No Law》等核心新作品线全面启动，公司规模及利润增长的动能将得到强化。”他说：“2026年全年股东回报总额预计为9172亿韩元，其中包括股息、股票回购与注销，约占当前市值的9.3%；稳健的股东回报政策将为股价提供下限支撑，而明年新作品阵容启动也有望推动业绩改善。”本报通过KakaoTalk（okjebo）接收稿件。版权所有© 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习或利用。2026年11月11日08:24发布

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/zamf.summary_zh: BudgIT发布的一份最新报告显示，赞法拉州位列财政可持续性指数排名前10的州之列。BudgIT在这份新报告中表示：“在财政可持续性这一指标中排名靠前的州，表明其在可用收入范围内管理支出义务的能力相对更强。”
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/zamf.body: Layer 1 Zamfara State was ranked among the top 10 states in the Fiscal Viability Index, a new report released by BudgIT has revealed. The new report titled, “State of States 2026: States ‘ Performance on Pillar B/ Fiscal Viability,” was released on Monday. This comes days after a renowned economist and former Governor of Nigeria’s Central Bank, Emir Muhammadu Sanusi, said he was impressed with the transformational feats recorded by Governor Dauda Lawal in the last three years in Zamfara State. The BudgIT report assesses the fiscal performance of 35 Nigerian states in 2025, the organisation said. “We call this ranking “Fiscal Viability”, but the real name is: Can your state survive without federal handouts?” the organisation said while releasing the report said. “States that rank higher on the Fiscal Viability pillar demonstrate a comparatively stronger capacity to manage their expenditure obligations within the limits of their available revenue,” BudgIT said in the new report. BudgIT is a civic organisation that uses creative technology to simplify public information, stimulate a community of active citizens, and enable their right to demand accountability, institutional reforms, efficient service delivery, and an equitable society. The new report said Zamfara came in 10th on the Fiscal Viability Index, scoring 74.97 per cent, with Enugu (98.38%) and Bayelsa (88.83%) states clinching the first and second positions. The report said Zamfara remained the second-least-indebted state in the federation, with a debt per capita of N19,464. Zamfara is one of the only three states from the northern part of the country that made it to the top 10 positions of the Fiscal Viability Index. The two other states are Gombe (78.07%) and Niger (76.03%), ranking 7th and 9th positions respectively. The report also examined how states generated revenue, managed public expenditure, sustained their finances and prioritised spending across critical sectors. The organisation said the 2026 assessment adopted a revised methodology built around four pillars: revenue performance (40 per cent), fiscal viability (30 per cent), debt sustainability (15 per cent) and spending on selected critical sectors (15 per cent). It also examined states’ dependence on Federation Account allocations, expenditure patterns, capital investments, debt obligations and fiscal pressures across the federation. “This edition introduces a revised methodology that gives greater attention to the developmental impact of public spending, with an assessment of expenditure in agriculture, health, education, and water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH),” the report said. Through its assessment of revenue performance, fiscal viability, debt sustainability and spending in critical sectors, the report provides insights into state governments’ fiscal decisions and how public resources are managed to support development. In 2025, BudgIT revealed in its 2025 States of the States Report that Zamfara’s fiscal performance recorded a boost from 36th position in 2023 to 17th position in 2025 under Governor Lawal. The report said Zamfara’s fiscal performance took a 13-step up in its fiscal performance ranking to 17th. It ranked 26th in 2024, the report said. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/zamf.title_zh: 扎姆法拉跻身财政可持续性表现最佳的10个州之列
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/zamf.body_zh: 扎姆法拉州在财政可持续性指数中位列尼日利亚前10个州，BudgIT最新发布的一份报告披露了这一点。这份题为《2026年各州状况：各州在支柱B/财政可持续性方面的表现》的新报告于周一发布。就在几天前，著名经济学家、尼日利亚中央银行前行长埃米尔·穆罕马杜·萨努西表示，他 impressed 于达乌达·洛亚尔州长过去三年在扎姆法拉州取得的转型性成就。BudgIT表示，该报告评估了尼日利亚35个州在2025年的财政表现。该组织在发布报告时表示：“我们将这一排名称为‘财政可持续性’，但它真正的名称是：没有联邦政府补助，你的州能否生存下去？”“在财政可持续性这一支柱上排名靠前的州，显示出更强的能力，能够在可用收入的范围内履行支出义务。”BudgIT在新报告中这样表示。BudgIT是一家公民组织，利用创新技术简化公共信息，活跃公民群体，并使公民有权要求问责、推动机构改革、实现高效公共服务和公平社会。新报告称，扎姆法拉在财政可持续性指数中排名第10，得分为74.97%；埃努古州（98.38%）和巴耶尔萨州（88.83%）分列第一和第二。报告称，在尼日利亚联邦中，扎姆法拉仍是债务负担第二轻的州，人均债务为N19,464。扎姆法拉是该国北部仅有的三个进入财政可持续性指数前十名的州之一。另外两个州分别是戈姆贝州（78.07%）和尼日尔州（76.03%），分别排名第7和第9。报告还考察了各州如何创造收入、管理公共支出、维持财政平衡，以及在关键领域确定支出优先顺序。该组织表示，2026年的评估采用了围绕四大支柱建立的修订方法：收入表现（40%）、财政可持续性（30%）、债务可持续性（15%）以及在选定关键领域的支出（15%）。评估还考察了各州对联邦账户拨款的依赖程度、支出模式、资本投资、债务义务以及联邦各州面临的财政压力。报告称：“本版评估引入了一套修订方法，更加重视公共支出的发展影响，并评估了农业、医疗、教育以及供水、环境卫生与个人卫生（WASH）领域的支出。”通过评估收入表现、财政可持续性、债务可持续性和关键领域支出，报告揭示了州政府的财政决策，以及公共资源如何被管理以支持发展。BudgIT在2025年《各州状况报告》中披露，在洛亚尔州长任内，扎姆法拉州的财政表现从2023年的第36位提升至2025年的第17位。报告称，扎姆法拉州的财政表现排名上升了13位，升至第17位。报告称，该州在2024年排名第26位，而在洛亚尔州长上任时的2023年，该州排名第36位。此处表达的意见并不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点
