https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 共和党盟友失去关键委员会控制权后，电商巨头面临扩大政治关系的压力 周日，专家和业内人士表示，在民主党于中期选举中取得全面胜利后，Coupang在美国扩大游说策略、拓展共和党盟友以外政治关系的压力日益增加。业内人士表示，Coupang可能会加大在美国的游说力度，以抵御韩国监管压力。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: E-commerce giant feels pressure to broaden political ties as Republican allies lose control of key committees Coupang is facing growing pressure to broaden its lobbying strategy in the United States beyond its Republican allies following the Democrats' sweeping midterm election victory, experts and industry officials said Sunday. The change could be particularly impactful for the e-commerce giant, whose lobbying efforts have helped draw attention in Washington to its dispute with Korean regulators. Republican lawmakers, including members of the House Judiciary Committee, have publicly criticized what they described as discriminatory treatment of the U.S.-headquartered firm in Korea. With Democrats now set to control both chambers of Congress, the institutional backing Coupang has received from Republican lawmakers is expected to weaken, prompting experts and industry watchers to say the company will have to broaden its relationships across both parties to maintain its influence in Washington. “Especially for a digital-focused firm like Coupang, which remains subject to policies under the Republican administration, it is important to balance lobbying efforts between Democrats and Republicans,” said Shin Won-kyu, head of the global economic research team at the Federation of Korean Industries. Coupang's political spending already shows signs of such a shift. According to political contribution records filed with the Federal Election Commission, COUPAC, a political action committee established by Coupang to support U.S. congressional candidates, contributed $185,000 (252 million won) to members of Congress and affiliated political organizations during the first three quarters of this year, up 18.2 percent from a year earlier. Of this year's contributions, $107,000 went to Democratic lawmakers, Democratic-affiliated election organizations and political action committees, while $78,000 went to Republicans and their affiliated groups. Coupang's contributions to Democrats jumped 52.9 percent from a year earlier, while those to Republicans fell 9.8 percent. The figures indicate that the company had already stepped up its overall political spending ahead of the midterms, anticipating a Democratic victory. The shift suggests Coupang had begun preparing for a possible change in the balance of power. "Coupang should pursue lobbying on roughly a 50-50 basis to maintain a balance in the U.S.," said Kim Dae-jong, a professor of business administration at Sejong University. “U.S. President Donald Trump is still a Republican, while Democrats now control both chambers of Congress.” The need for a bipartisan strategy is closely tied to the nature of Coupang's regulatory dispute in Korea. The company has faced scrutiny from Korean authorities over its handling of a massive data breach and other alleged business malpractices, and some U.S. lawmakers have raised concerns about whether Korean regulators are treating U.S. companies fairly. In July, Republican Rep. Michael Baumgartner, a vocal supporter of Coupang in Congress, introduced a bill that would bar foreign government officials from entering the U.S. if they engage in economic discrimination against U.S. companies. He won reelection in Washington state, but will return to a House controlled by Democrats — underscoring the need for Coupang to expand its lobbying reach beyond Republican allies. Industry officials said Coupang could step up its lobbying efforts in the U.S. as it seeks to defend itself against regulatory pressure in Korea. “Korean regulatory authorities show no signs of backing down from their hard-line stance against Coupang’s data breach or other unfair business activities, so the company will rely more on U.S. lobbying to raise its voice against Korean authorities,” an industry official said. A Coupang spokesperson declined to comment on the details of its U.S. lobbying strategy
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 中期选举后，Coupang面临扩大美国游说战略的压力
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 共和党盟友失去关键委员会控制权，电商巨头面临扩大政治关系的压力 专家和行业官员周日报道称，在民主党于中期选举中取得全面胜利后，电商巨头Coupang面临越来越大的压力，需要将其在美国的游说策略从共和党盟友扩大到其他阵营。这一变化对这家电商巨头的影响可能尤其显著，因为其游说努力曾帮助提请华盛顿关注该公司与韩国监管机构的争端。包括众议院司法委员会成员在内的共和党议员，曾公开批评他们所称的美国总部设在韩国的企业遭受歧视性待遇。随着民主党即将控制国会两院，Republican议员给予Coupang的机构支持预计将减弱，促使专家和行业观察人士表示，该公司必须扩大与两党的关系，才能维持在华盛顿的影响力。 韩国商工联会全球经济研究团队负责人Shin Won-kyu表示：“尤其是对于Coupang这样一家以数字业务为主的公司而言，其业务仍受共和党政府政策约束，因此在民主党和共和党之间平衡游说努力十分重要。” Coupang的政治支出已经显现出这种转变的迹象。根据提交给联邦选举委员会的政治献金记录，Coupang为支持美国国会候选人而成立的政治行动委员会COUPAC，今年前三个季度向国会议员及其关联政治组织捐出185,000美元（2.52亿韩元），较上年同期增长18.2%。今年捐款中，107,000美元流向民主党议员、民主党关联选举组织和政治行动委员会，78,000美元则流向共和党及其关联团体。Coupang对民主党的捐款较上年同期跃升52.9%，对共和党的捐款则下降9.8%。这些数字显示，公司在中期选举前已加大整体政治支出，预判民主党将取得胜利。这一转变表明，Coupang已经开始为权力格局可能发生的变化做准备。 世宗大学工商管理学教授Kim Dae-jong表示：“Coupang应当以大约五五开的比例开展游说，以维持在美国内部的平衡。”“美国总统唐纳德·特朗普仍是共和党人，而民主党现在控制着国会两院。” 采取两党战略的需要与Coupang在韩国所面临监管争端的性质密切相关。该公司因处理大规模数据泄露及其他涉嫌不当商业行为而受到韩国当局审查，一些美国议员则担忧韩国监管机构是否公平对待美国企业。7月，共和党众议员Michael Baumgartner在国会上大力支持Coupang，并提出一项法案，禁止对实施经济歧视的美国企业的外国政府官员进入美国。他在华盛顿州成功连任，但将回到由民主党控制的众议院，这进一步凸显了Coupang需要将游说触角扩大到共和党盟友之外。 行业官员表示，Coupang正在寻求抵御韩国的监管压力，因此可能加大在美国的游说力度。一名行业官员说：“韩国监管机构没有迹象表明会放弃针对Coupang数据泄露及其他不公平商业活动的强硬立场，因此该公司将更多依靠美国游说活动来反对韩国当局。” Coupang发言人拒绝对其美国游说策略的细节置评

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The United States acknowledged that certain policy-related variables could affect the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) to Seoul, but reaffirmed its commitment to the existing bilateral agreement that the handover will proceed based on agreed conditions, a Korean lawmaker said Sunday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 一名韩国议员周日表示，美国承认某些与政策有关的变量可能影响战时作战指挥权移交首尔，但再次强调将遵守现有双边协议，根据商定条件推进移交。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The United States acknowledged that certain policy-related variables could affect the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) to Seoul, but reaffirmed its commitment to the existing bilateral agreement that the handover will proceed based on agreed conditions, a Korean lawmaker said Sunday. Rep. Jin Sung-joon of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK), who chairs the National Assembly’s National Defense Committee, briefed reporters at the National Assembly on the outcome of a parliamentary delegation’s trip to the United States from Nov. 1 to 5. He said the delegation was granted entry approval only at the last minute, but was still able to proceed with its scheduled visit to U.S. Indo-Pacific Command and its subordinate component commands in Hawaii. Asked whether the Democratic sweep in the U.S. midterm elections could affect the OPCON transfer process, Jin said he did not expect any significant changes. "Korea and the U.S. have discussed and reached agreements over OPCON transfer for more than 20 years. A Democratic victory (in the U.S.) would not affect the existing bilateral agreements," he said. Regarding the postponement of the Security Consultative Meeting between Korea and the U.S., originally scheduled for November, until next year, Jin cited U.S. officials saying the delay was unrelated to any differences over the OPCON transfer. "The U.S. said the decision was made after taking into account the two countries' defense ministers' and senior military officials' schedules," he added. Jin said U.S. officials assessed the security situation on the Korean Peninsula as stable, despite a series of North Korean actions in the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), including the demolition of inter-Korean connecting roads and the fortification of areas along the Military Demarcation Line (MDL). "However, the officials stressed the need to maintain military readiness, citing North Korea's growing nuclear and missile capabilities and the possibility of abrupt policy shifts," said Jin. Adm. Stephen T. Koehler, commander of the U.S. Pacific Fleet, reportedly said Korea's pursuit of nuclear-powered submarines could strengthen the alliance, expressing willingness to cooperate pending policy decisions by both governments. On Seoul’s request for cooperation in relocating Gwangju Air Base to build a mega semiconductor cluster, Gen. Kevin B. Schneider, commander of Pacific Air Forces, said the relocation is a sovereign decision for the Korean government, while the U.S. military's role is to assess and advise on potential military risks. Asked whether United States Forces of Korea Commander Gen. Xavier Brunson came up in the talks, Jin said he did, but declined to elaborate. Brunson recently drew criticism from ruling party lawmakers after he said, at a seminar in Washington on Oct. 14, that Korea begins at the southern boundary fence line of the DMZ from the perspective of the United Nations Command. The remark sparked controversy because it could be interpreted as placing Korea’s territorial boundary at the southern edge of the DMZ, 2 kilometers south of the MDL. The southern half of the DMZ, which includes villages where South Korean residents live, lies north of that line
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 国防委员会主席称，尽管美国中期选举结果如何，OPCON协议仍然有效
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 一名韩国议员周日表示，美国承认某些与政策相关的变量可能影响战时作战指挥权（OPCON）移交首尔的时间，但再次强调将遵守现有双边协议，在既定条件下推进移交。执政的韩国民主党的金成埈议员担任国会国防委员会主席，他在国会向记者介绍国会代表团于11月1日至5日访问美国的成果。他说，该代表团直到最后一刻才获准入境，但仍得以按计划访问美国印太司令部及其下属驻夏威夷各司令部。记者问，美国中期选举中民主党获胜是否可能影响OPCON移交进程，金成埈表示，他预计不会出现重大变化。他说：“韩国和美国就OPCON移交问题已经讨论并达成协议超过20年。民主党（在美国）获胜不会影响现有双边协议。”谈及原定于11月举行、后推迟至明年的韩美安全磋商会议，金成埈援引美国官员的话称，推迟与双方在OPCON移交问题上的分歧无关。他补充说：“美国表示，这一决定是在考虑两国国防部长和高级军事官员的日程后作出的。”金成埈说，尽管朝鲜在非军事区（DMZ）采取一系列行动，包括拆除南北连接道路以及在军事分界线沿线加固设施，美国官员仍评估朝鲜半岛安全局势保持稳定。金成埈说：“不过，这些官员强调必须维持战备状态，理由是朝鲜的核与导弹能力不断增强，其政策也可能突然转向。”据报道，美国太平洋舰队司令斯蒂芬·T·科勒海军上将表示，韩国发展核动力潜艇的努力能够加强同盟，并表示愿意在两国政府作出政策决定前提供合作。应首尔请求，为建设大型半导体产业集群而合作搬迁光州空军基地，太平洋空军司令凯文·B·施奈德将军表示，搬迁是韩国政府的主权决定，而美国军队的职责是评估潜在军事风险并提供建议。记者问，驻韩美军司令泽维尔·布伦森将军是否在会谈中被提及，金成埈表示确有提及，但拒绝进一步说明。布伦森最近受到执政党议员批评。他于10月14日在华盛顿的一场研讨会上表示，从联合国司令部角度看，韩国始于非军事区南侧围栏线。这番言论引发争议，因为它可能被解读为把韩国的领土边界划在非军事区南缘，即军事分界线以南2公里处。非军事区南半部包括有韩国居民居住的村庄，位于该界线以北

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary: 'Black Friday' for KOSPI prompts needs for reforms The recent "Black Friday" for the Korean stock market brought a frantic mixture of a circuit breaker and sell-side sidecars as the main bourse fell more than 6 percent. Meanwhile, U.S. indexes that had risen immediately after last week's midterm elections also fell.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary_zh: 韩国股市遭遇“黑色星期五”，亟需改革。韩国股市最近的“黑色星期五”引发熔断机制与卖方停牌机制同时启动，主要交易所指数下跌逾6%。与此同时，上周中期选举后立即上涨的美国股市指数也出现下跌。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body: 'Black Friday' for KOSPI prompts needs for reforms The recent "Black Friday" for the Korean stock market brought a frantic mixture of a circuit breaker and sell-side sidecars as the main bourse fell more than 6 percent. Benchmark KOSPI heavyweights SK hynix and Samsung Electronics also took a hit, with their shares falling 10.44 percent and 6.35 percent, respectively, as investors sold in panic, driving the index below 5,000 during trading. Meanwhile, U.S. indexes that had risen immediately after last week's midterm elections also fell. Investors and policymakers woke up to a changed economic climate, triggered by a shift in the U.S. political landscape. Any optimism that last week's U.S. midterm elections had reaffirmed the country’s democratic values was tempered by concerns over the Democrats’ agenda to regulate artificial intelligence (AI) and restrict data center construction. A deeper concern is that these policy shifts come amid growing skepticism over whether the AI boom is actually a bubble and whether massive investments in the sector will ultimately generate profits. Other Asian stock markets, including Taiwan's, also declined Friday. But Seoul’s heavy reliance on its semiconductor sector amplified market volatility, which was pushed up even higher by President Lee Jae Myung's strong pledge to tackle the so-called "Korea discount." In response to the sharp decline, senior officials from Korea’s economic, financial regulatory and monetary agencies convened to discuss emergency measures, including a three-month exemption from collateral reserve requirements on loans to investors in an effort to curb further selling. The measure may for the time being bring some peace to investors, but they now depressed and distrustful are also likely to be wary of government measures. Aggressive investments in AI and a sustained drive in the U.S. to build data centers also contributed to the strong performance by Korea's top chipmakers. But the market landscape has shifted, as has the balance of power in the U.S. Congress. The episode should prompt Korea and its financial authorities to pursue more fundamental reforms to guard against future market shocks. Structural reforms take time, but with the Korean economy forecast to grow by around 3 percent this year, the country must use that momentum to diversify its economic base and reduce its vulnerability to external shocks. We have repeatedly called for greater economic diversification, particularly to reduce the concentration of semiconductors in Korea’s exports and stock market. Exports of semiconductors including high-bandwidth memory and conventional memory chips are estimated to account for about 40 percent of the country’s total exports, which are on track to reach a record $1 trillion as early as this month. SK hynix and Samsung Electronics also make up about 40 percent of KOSPI's total market capitalization. This structure cannot continue to drive sustainable growth for Korea, nor can it produce the surplus profits that fill government coffers. At the same time, Korea cannot afford to lose its competitive edge in semiconductors and must continue investing in research, development and innovation, as reflected in the government’s plans for three major semiconductor projects. The surplus profits from the current chip boom gave the government the confidence to pursue its "three megaprojects," but it still needs future growth engines. Policymakers should focus on deregulation to revive the automotive, shipping and battery sectors, while fostering an environment for emerging sectors such as robotics, biotechnology and small modular reactors to become new engines of growth
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.title_zh: 美国中期选举结果影响韩国股市指数
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body_zh: 韩国股市经历“黑色星期五”，凸显改革需求。韩国股市近期经历“黑色星期五”，主要交易所综合指数跌幅超过6%，熔断机制与卖方临时停牌机制同时启动，市场陷入恐慌。基准指数KOSPI的权重股SK hynix和Samsung Electronics也遭重创，股价分别下跌10.44%和6.35%。投资者恐慌抛售，指数在交易期间跌破5,000点。与此同时，上周美国中期选举结束后一度上涨的美国各大股指也出现下跌。投资者和政策制定者醒来后面对的是一种已经改变的经济环境，其诱因是美国政治格局的转变。上周美国中期选举重新确认该国民主价值观，本应令人们感到乐观，但民主党监管人工智能（AI）和限制数据中心建设的议程引发了担忧。更深层的忧虑在于，人们日益怀疑人工智能热潮是否真是一股泡沫，以及对该行业的大规模投资最终能否创造利润。包括台湾在内的其他亚洲股市周五也出现下跌。然而，首尔过度依赖半导体行业，加剧了市场波动；李在明总统大力承诺解决所谓的“韩国折价”，进一步推高了波动。为应对这一急跌，韩国经济、金融监管和货币机构的高层官员召开会议，讨论应急措施，包括对投资者贷款实施3个月的抵押品准备金要求豁免，以遏制进一步抛售。这项措施或许能暂时安抚投资者，但当前情绪低落、疑虑重重的投资者也可能对政府措施保持警惕。对人工智能进行激进投资，以及美国持续推动建设数据中心，也助力韩国头部芯片制造商取得亮眼表现。然而，市场格局已经改变，美国国会中的权力平衡也是如此。这一事件应促使韩国及其金融 authorities推进更为根本的改革，以防范未来的市场冲击。结构性改革需要时间，而预计韩国经济今年将增长约3%，该国必须利用这一势头实现经济基础多元化，降低对外部冲击的脆弱性。我们反复呼吁推进更大程度的经济多元化，尤其是降低半导体在韩国出口和股市中的集中度。包括高带宽内存和传统存储芯片在内的半导体出口，据估计约占该国出口总额的40%；出口总额最早有望在本月达到创纪录的1万亿美元。SK hynix和Samsung Electronics还合计占KOSPI总市值约40%。这种结构无法继续为韩国推动可持续增长，也无法创造充盈政府财政的过剩利润。与此同时，韩国不能失去在半导体领域的竞争优势，必须继续投资研发和创新；政府计划推进的3个大型半导体项目正体现了这一点。当前芯片热潮带来的过剩利润使政府有信心推进其“三大超级项目”，但韩国仍需打造未来的增长引擎。政策制定者应重点推进放松管制，以重振汽车、航运和电池行业，同时为机器人、生物技术和小型模块化反应堆等新兴行业营造环境，使其成为新的增长引擎

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: US calls for coordinated action against N. Korean cyber threats following Binance hack
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: The United States on Saturday called for international cooperation to combat North Korea's illicit cyber activities following a massive cryptocurrency theft involving Binance. "Particularly in light of the recent hack of Binance, it is critical for governments to work together and do their own part to mitigate the DPRK cyber threat and curb illicit DPRK revenue generation," a State Department spokesperson told Yonhap News Agency in a written response.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 美国星期六呼吁加强国际合作，打击朝鲜的非法网络活动，此前发生了涉及Binance的大规模加密货币盗窃案。美国国务院发言人在书面回复中告诉韩联社：“尤其考虑到Binance近期遭黑客攻击，各国政府必须携手合作，尽到各自责任，减轻朝鲜带来的网络威胁，并切断朝鲜的非法收入来源。”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: The United States on Saturday called for international cooperation to combat North Korea's illicit cyber activities following a massive cryptocurrency theft involving Binance. "Particularly in light of the recent hack of Binance, it is critical for governments to work together and do their own part to mitigate the DPRK cyber threat and curb illicit DPRK revenue generation," a State Department spokesperson told Yonhap News Agency in a written response. DPRK stands for the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, North Korea's official name. The remarks were made in response to an inquiry about potential coordination between Washington and Seoul on additional sanctions following the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation's attribution of the cryptocurrency theft to North Korean actors. The spokesperson also emphasized the importance of enforcing existing international sanctions and taking measures to prevent Pyongyang from financing its weapons programs. "We expect all U.N. member states to enforce existing sanctions and take proactive measures to prevent the DPRK from funding its unlawful WMD and ballistic missile programs," the spokesperson said. "Coordinated unilateral sanctions continue to be a strong tool to prevent the flow of money that supports the proliferation of weapons," the spokesperson added. The remarks came after a South Korean unification ministry official said Thursday that Seoul had not yet begun discussing sanctions over the incident because the circumstances surrounding the theft had not been fully established. South Korea's foreign ministry separately said it was internally reviewing possible additional measures, including unilateral cyber sanctions, but that no decision had been made. The State Department did not directly address whether Washington had shared investigative findings with Seoul or held bilateral discussions on additional sanctions in connection with the incident
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: Binance遭黑客攻击后，美国呼吁协调应对朝鲜网络威胁
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 美国周六呼吁开展国际合作，打击朝鲜的非法网络活动。此前，Binance遭遇大规模加密货币盗窃案。美国国务院发言人在书面回复韩联社时表示：“尤其考虑到近期Binance被盗事件，各国政府必须加强合作，各尽其责，减轻朝鲜网络威胁，并切断朝鲜非法收入来源。”DPRK是朝鲜的正式名称“朝鲜民主主义人民共和国”。这番表态是在回应有关华盛顿与首尔可能协调追加制裁的问题。此前，美国联邦调查局将该起加密货币盗窃案归咎于朝鲜方面。该发言人还强调，执行现有国际制裁以及采取措施阻止平壤资助其武器计划至关重要。发言人说：“我们期望所有联合国会员国执行现有制裁，并采取主动措施，防止朝鲜为其非法的大规模杀伤性武器和弹道导弹计划提供资金。”发言人补充道：“协调一致的单边制裁仍是阻止资金流向支持武器扩散势力的有力工具。”此前，韩国统一部官员周四表示，由于围绕这起盗窃案的有关情况尚未完全查明，首尔尚未开始讨论针对此事的制裁。韩国外交部则单独表示，正在内部审查可能采取的追加措施，包括单边网络制裁，但尚未作出决定。美国国务院没有直接回应华盛顿是否与首尔共享了调查结论，或双方是否就与此案有关的追加制裁举行了双边讨论

https://leadership.ng/2027-elections-70-.title: 2027 Elections: 70 Attacks, 27 Dead As Political Violence Escalates
https://leadership.ng/2027-elections-70-.summary: In a press statement on Sunday, CentreSGD said the rising violence posed a systemic threat to the electoral process, with fewer than 70 days remaining before the January 16, 2027 presidential and National Assembly elections. CentreSGD identified recent attacks in Enugu, Katsina, Ekiti, Sokoto and Kebbi, including the reported killing of an NDC supporter during a campaign flag-off in Enugu, attacks on APC convoys in Katsina, and the assault on AAC presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore in Ado-Ekiti.
https://leadership.ng/2027-elections-70-.summary_zh: CentreSGD在周日的新闻声明中表示，不断加剧的暴力行为对选举进程构成系统性威胁，距离2027年1月16日举行的总统和国民议会选举已不足70天。CentreSGD列举了恩古、卡塔西、埃基蒂、索科托和凯比等地近期发生的袭击，包括据报道在恩古的一次竞选启动集会上杀害一名全国民主大会党支持者、在卡塔西袭击全尼日利亚进步大会党车队，以及在阿多-埃基蒂袭击争取人民民主党总统候选人奥莫耶莱·索沃雷。
https://leadership.ng/2027-elections-70-.body: In a press statement on Sunday, CentreSGD said the rising violence posed a systemic threat to the electoral process, with fewer than 70 days remaining before the January 16, 2027 presidential and National Assembly elections. . Citing Yiaga Africa’s September 2026 National Voting Intentions Survey, the centre said 61 per cent of Nigerians feared violence could prevent them from voting, with the figure rising to 78 per cent in the North-East. She added that 84 per cent of respondents were likely or very likely to vote, while 83 per cent said improved security would encourage participation. CentreSGD identified recent attacks in Enugu, Katsina, Ekiti, Sokoto and Kebbi, including the reported killing of an NDC supporter during a campaign flag-off in Enugu, attacks on APC convoys in Katsina, and the assault on AAC presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore in Ado-Ekiti. The ED also cited allegations of attacks on ADC campaign convoys in Sokoto and Kebbi. The centre noted that some of the incidents were disputed by the parties and authorities concerned, stressing that it did not pronounce on culpability but demanded thorough investigations and prosecution where evidence warranted. The Centre said police arrests linked to the Katsina and Ekiti incidents should lead to transparent prosecutions. It warned that fear could undermine voter participation, particularly among young people, women and persons with disabilities, noting that only 40 per cent of young respondents were very likely to vote, compared with 64 per cent of Nigerians aged 61 and above. The organisation also expressed concern over alleged use of state-linked security outfits and administrative machinery against opposition parties, citing the Sokoto convoy allegations, the sealing of the ADC state office and reported campaign billboard permit fees of up to N200 million in Abia and N150 million in Enugu, Kogi and Cross River. CentreSGD called on the Nigeria Police Force and other security agencies to conduct prompt, transparent and non-partisan investigations into election-related attacks and prosecute perpetrators and sponsors regardless of political affiliation. It also urged political leaders and candidates to condemn violent rhetoric and enforce discipline among party supporters. The centre further called on INEC and the Inter-Agency Consultative Committee on Election Security to publish a threat-based national election security plan, while urging state governments to guarantee equal access to campaign venues, public facilities, permits and advertising spaces. https://leadership.ng/olawepo-hashim-mee.title: Olawepo-Hashim Meets US Commission Over Nigeria’s 3.6m IDPs, Maisango’s Release
https://leadership.ng/olawepo-hashim-mee.summary: Olawepo-Hashim made the call during an engagement with the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom (USCIRF), where he raised concerns over religious persecution, ethnic discrimination, insecurity and the continued displacement of vulnerable communities across the country.
https://leadership.ng/olawepo-hashim-mee.summary_zh: 奥拉韦波-哈希姆在与美国国际宗教自由委员会（USCIRF）举行活动时提出上述呼吁。他在活动中表达了对此全国范围内宗教迫害、族群歧视、安全局势恶化以及弱势社区持续流离失所的担忧。
https://leadership.ng/olawepo-hashim-mee.body: Olawepo-Hashim made the call during an engagement with the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom (USCIRF), where he raised concerns over religious persecution, ethnic discrimination, insecurity and the continued displacement of vulnerable communities across the country. The Accord Party candidate, described as the first major opposition political leader to be engaged by the Commission, also called for the immediate release of Hausa cultural activist, Maisango, whom he alleged was being unlawfully detained without trial. According to a statement from his media office on Sunday, during the engagement on Friday, Olawepo-Hashim acknowledged that Christians in Northern Nigeria face persecution but stressed that religious intolerance and discrimination in the country extend beyond the Christian-Muslim divide. He identified Shia Muslims, minority Islamic sects and Hausa Muslim communities among groups whose experiences of persecution, exclusion and discrimination deserve greater international attention. According to him, Nigeria’s religious freedom challenges are more complex than often portrayed, as ethnic identity and cultural affiliation can also determine how individuals and communities are treated, even among people who share the same religious beliefs. Olawepo-Hashim particularly highlighted the alleged marginalisation of Hausa Muslims in parts of Northern Nigeria, arguing that some communities experience unequal treatment despite professing the same Islamic faith as other groups. He also raised concerns over the continued detention of Maisango, a Hausa cultural activist, who he said remained in custody without trial despite reportedly having been dismissed from his employment with the Department of State Services (DSS). He called for Maisango’s immediate release, emphasising the need for due process, respect for fundamental human rights and protection of citizens against unlawful detention. On the humanitarian situation, Olawepo-Hashim cited approximately 3.68 million internally displaced persons in Nigeria, referencing UNHCR figures as of October 2026. He argued that the displacement crisis cuts across religious and ethnic boundaries, insisting that the plight of displaced Hausa communities and other vulnerable populations should receive equal international recognition. The Accord Party presidential candidate specifically drew attention to reported attacks on communities in Shanga Local Government Area of Kebbi State, including Kalkami, Tungar Bori and Kawara. Reports of the April 2026 attacks indicated that suspected bandits killed residents, set buildings ablaze and forced several families to flee their homes. Olawepo-Hashim said reports of the burning of 11 villages in the area required sustained international attention, alleging that some armed groups operating in the region were more interested in killing residents, destroying settlements and taking control of territories than pursuing religious conversion. He expressed concern over what he described as the government’s failure to adequately protect vulnerable communities and decisively confront armed groups responsible for violence and displacement. He warned that Nigeria must not allow its security and religious freedom challenges to deteriorate further as the country approaches another political transition. Olawepo-Hashim also criticised what he described as inadequate accountability under the present administration, alleging that political considerations had undermined efforts to confront terrorism and other forms of armed violence. Nigeria was designated a Country of Particular Concern by the United States in October 2025, following earlier recommendations by USCIRF. The Commission also called for the designation in its 2026 recommendations. Olawepo-Hashim maintained that international attention must recognise all victims of religious and ethnic persecution rather than concentrate on one religious community to the exclusion of others. He called for a comprehensive approach that acknowledges the experiences of Christians, Shia Muslims, Hausa communities and other vulnerable populations, while holding relevant state institutions accountable for their constitutional responsibility to protect citizens and guarantee fundamental rights. The Accord Party presidential candidate commended USCIRF for its work on religious freedom in Nigeria and acknowledged President Donald Trump’s interest in the issue. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/olawepo-hashim-mee.body_zh: 奥拉韦波-哈希姆在与美国国际宗教自由委员会（USCIRF）会面期间提出诉求，表达了对于宗教迫害、族群歧视、安全局势不佳以及全国脆弱社区持续流离失所的担忧。作为协议党候选人，他被描述为首位接受该委员会会面的主要反对派政治领导人，并呼吁立即释放豪萨文化活动人士迈桑戈，称其据指未经审判即遭非法拘禁。其媒体办公室周日在声明中称，在周五的会面期间，奥拉韦波-哈希姆承认尼日利亚北部的基督徒遭受迫害，但强调该国的宗教不宽容和歧视现象并不限于基督徒与穆斯林之间的分歧。他指出，什叶派穆斯林、少数伊斯兰教派以及豪萨穆斯林社区等群体遭受迫害、排斥和歧视，其经历值得国际社会给予更多关注。据他表示，尼日利亚宗教自由面临的挑战往往比外界描绘的更为复杂，因为族群身份和文化归属也会影响个人和社区的待遇，即便他们持有相同的宗教信仰。奥拉韦波-哈希姆特别强调了据称尼日利亚部分地区边缘化豪萨穆斯林的问题，认为一些社区尽管与其他群体信仰同样的伊斯兰教，却仍遭受不平等对待。他还对豪萨文化活动人士迈桑戈持续被拘禁表示关切，称尽管有报道称其已被国家安全局（DSS）解雇，但其仍在未经审判的情况下被关押。他呼吁立即释放迈桑戈，强调应依法正当行事、尊重基本人权，并保护公民免遭非法拘禁。在人道主义局势方面，奥拉韦波-哈希姆援引联合国难民署截至2026年10月的数据，称尼日利亚境内流离失所者约有368万人。他认为，流离失所危机横跨宗教和族群界限，坚持认为流离失所的豪萨社区及其他脆弱群体同样应得到国际社会的同等关注。协议党总统候选人特别提请关注据报发生在凯比州尚加地方政府辖区对社区的袭击，包括卡尔卡米、通加博里和卡瓦拉。有关2026年4月袭击的报道称，疑似匪徒杀害居民、纵火焚烧建筑，并迫使数个家庭逃离家园。奥拉韦波-哈希姆表示，该地区11个村庄遭焚烧的报告需要国际社会持续关注，并指称在该地区活动的某些武装组织更热衷于杀害居民、摧毁聚居点和控制领土，而非追求宗教皈依。他对政府未能充分保护脆弱社区、果断打击应对暴力和流离失所的武装团体表示担忧。他警告称，随着尼日利亚即将再次进行政治权力交接，该国不能让安全和宗教自由方面的挑战进一步恶化。奥拉韦波-哈希姆还批评现任政府被指问责不足，称政治层面的考量削弱了打击恐怖主义及其他形式武装暴力的努力。在USCIRF此前提出建议后，美国于2025年10月将尼日利亚列为“特别关注国家”。该委员会在其2026年建议中也呼吁作出这一指定。奥拉韦波-哈希姆坚持认为，国际社会在关注宗教和族群迫害受害者时，必须顾及所有受害者，而不应将目光集中于一个宗教群体并排斥其他群体。他呼吁采取全面方针，承认基督徒、什叶派穆斯林、豪萨社区及其他脆弱群体的经历，同时追究相关国家机构的责任，要求其履行保护公民和保障基本权利的宪法职责。协议党总统候选人赞扬USCIRF为尼日利亚宗教自由所做的工作，并认可美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对该问题的关注。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、独家内幕和独到视角，直接传送至您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp频道，随时掌握24/7最新动态 → 加入我们的WhatsApp频道 --> --> 奇布佐·乌凯贝 奇布佐·乌凯贝是《领导力报》的政治记者，专门报道各政党、国民议会和选举委员会

https://punchng.com/photos-nema-receives.summary: The National Emergency Management Agency has received six Nigerian returnees from the United States at the Murtala Muhammed International Airport, Lagos State. NEMA disclosed this in a statement posted on its X handle on Sunday, saying the returnees arrived at the airport’s Cargo Terminal on November 4, 2026.
https://punchng.com/photos-nema-receives.summary_zh: 国家紧急事务管理局在拉各斯州穆尔塔拉·穆罕默德国际机场接收了6名从美国返回的尼日利亚人。国家紧急事务管理局周日在其X账号发布的声明中透露，这些归国人员于2026年11月4日抵达机场货运航站楼。
https://punchng.com/photos-nema-receives.body: The National Emergency Management Agency has received six Nigerian returnees from the United States at the Murtala Muhammed International Airport, Lagos State. NEMA disclosed this in a statement posted on its X handle on Sunday, saying the returnees arrived at the airport’s Cargo Terminal on November 4, 2026. The agency said the reception exercise was conducted through its Lagos Operations Office in collaboration with the United States Consulate, the Federal Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Nigeria Immigration Service and ExecuJet. “The returnees arrived at approximately 10:13 p.m. aboard a Beechcraft 1900 aircraft with registration number N62FF. The group comprised five males and one female, all adults. “Upon arrival, officers of the Nigeria Immigration Service conducted the necessary immigration documentation and profiling to ensure proper identification, record-keeping and a smooth arrival process. “NEMA coordinated the reception in collaboration with the relevant agencies, while necessary reception and post-arrival support services were provided to facilitate the returnees’ transition following their arrival in the country,” the statement said. The agency did not state the circumstances under which the six returned, whether they were deported or returned of their own free will. US, under President Donald Trump, intensified US immigration enforcement, which has prioritized stricter rules, accelerated removals of individuals without legal status, and targeted those with criminal records through initiatives such as the “worst of the worst” lists and West Africa Operations Watch. Nigeria has featured prominently in these efforts, with the US Department of Homeland Security publishing multiple lists of Nigerian nationals identified for deportation in 2026, often linked to offences including fraud and other violations. Meanwhile, NEMA said the returning exercise reflected the Federal Government’s efforts to ensure the safe, orderly and dignified return of Nigerian citizens through coordinated engagement among relevant agencies and partners. https://punchng.com/photos-nema-receives.title_zh: 图片：国家紧急情况管理局接收6名从美国返回的尼日利亚公民
https://punchng.com/photos-nema-receives.body_zh: 国家紧急事务管理局已在拉各斯州穆尔塔拉·穆罕默德国际机场接回6名从美国返回的尼日利亚人。国家紧急事务管理局周日通过其X账号发布的声明披露，这些返回人员于2026年11月4日抵达机场货运航站楼。该机构表示，接机工作由其拉各斯行动办公室协同美国领事馆、联邦外交部、尼日利亚移民局和ExecuJet开展。声明称：“这些返回人员于当地时间晚上10时13分左右抵达，乘坐一架注册号为N62FF的Beechcraft 1900飞机。该团队包括5名男性和1名女性，均为成年人。“抵达后，尼日利亚移民局工作人员办理了必要的入境文件和身份登记手续，以确保身份核验准确、记录完整以及入境流程顺畅。“国家紧急事务管理局协同相关机构统筹接机工作，并提供必要的接待和抵境后支持服务，帮助返回人员抵达本国后顺利过渡。”该机构没有说明这6人是在何种情况下返回，也没有说明他们是遭遣返还是自愿返回。在唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下，美国加强移民执法，优先执行更严格的规定，加快遣返没有合法身份的人员，并通过“最恶劣中的最恶劣”名单和西非行动观察等行动，针对有犯罪记录者。美国国土安全部在2026年公布了多份拟遣返的尼日利亚公民名单，其中许多人涉及欺诈及其他违法行为，尼日利亚在这些行动中受到广泛关注。与此同时，国家紧急事务管理局表示此次接回行动体现了联邦政府通过相关机构及合作伙伴协同努力，确保尼日利亚公民安全、有序且有尊严地回国的决心。Saheed Oyelakin Saheed是Punch Newspapers记者，拥有两年多报道都会新闻、科技、体育、政治和人物故事的经验。他专注于报道不同领域的清晰、生动新闻，其工作体现了亲自参与新闻编辑部的经验，以及对准确和平衡新闻报道的承诺

The directive is enforced under the Minerals and Mining (Local Content and Local Participation) Regulations, 2020 (L.I. https://www.myjoyonline.com/contract-min.summary_zh: 如今，摧毁这一根基的并不只有采矿公司，还包括该国监管机构矿产委员会发布的一项指令。该指令依据《矿产与采矿（本地含量和本地参与）条例》（2020年）（L.I.）予以执行。矿产委员会仍未回答一个核心问题：在塔克瓦、奥布阿西和凯尼亚西制造一个劳动贫困阶层，如何才能最大限度实现加纳黄金产业的国家利益？
https://www.myjoyonline.com/contract-min.body: For years, Ghana's mining communities have lived the classic resource curse. Gold is mined in Tarkwa, Obuasi and Kenyasi, but human rights abuses, environmental destruction, loss of livelihoods, health hazards and social decay are what residents say they get in return. The one exception that sustained these towns was not corporate social responsibility. It was the payslip of the permanent mineworker. That payslip paid the PAYE that funds District Assemblies. It paid SSNIT. It built the markets, the rental houses, and the shops. That foundation is now being dismantled not by mining companies alone, but by a directive from the state's own regulator, the Minerals Commission. Between October 2025 and January 2026, the Minerals Commission issued letters to the last three major companies still practising owner-mining, Newmont, AngloGold Ashanti and Chinese-owned Zijin Mining, ordering them to transition fully from owner-mining to contract mining by December 2026 or face sanctions including fines and mine shutdowns. The directive is enforced under the Minerals and Mining (Local Content and Local Participation) Regulations, 2020 (L.I. 2431). Surface mining must go to wholly Ghanaian-owned firms; underground mining to firms with at least 50% local ownership. Chief Executive Isaac Tandoh defends it philosophically: “Employment is not the same as ownership. Labour is not the same as control. Our people are working in the mines, agree, but do they own the mines?” But the workers who actually risk their lives underground say they were never consulted. According to the Ghana Mineworkers’ Union (GMWU) of TUC Ghana, which represents about 14,000 workers in large-scale mining, the sector has already undergone a silent casualisation. As of the end of 2024, more than 90% of workers were on fixed-term and casual employment, while permanent employment accounted for less than 10%. By 2026, the union says, that figure has climbed above 95%, meaning nineteen out of every twenty mineworkers are on short-term, casual or contract arrangements. The GMWU's August 20, 2026 petition to Lands and Natural Resources Minister Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah is blunt: the contract model is “dangerous, regressive, and economically unsound”. Its study with finance journalist Adnan Adams Mohammed found that when workers move from owner-mining to contractor, wages fall by at least half for the same job. Internal contractor staff confirm contractor workers typically earn around 50% less in basic pay than direct employees of mine operators. Gbana says the loss is wider: lower PAYE, reduced pension contributions, and diminished retirement benefits. “This is not what we intended for local content regulation. This is a complete reversal of what the intentions were,” GMWU General Secretary Abdul-Moomin Gbana told journalists after presenting the petition. “We are totally opposed to the directive. “Local content must therefore create opportunities for all Ghanaians. It cannot become a vehicle for exploitation to enrich a few contractors at the expense of the workers who risk and sweat day and night in the bowels of the earth to produce the wealth,” the petition states. In that same letter, he warned: “We wish to state therefore, without hesitation, that this path is injurious and inimical to the already fragile and precarious conditions of mineworkers. It will inevitably open the floodgates to further exploitation, abuse, casualisation of labour, and the erosion of hard-won protections that workers have fought for over decades”. The economics explain the human cost. Data compiled by the Minerals Commission itself shows operational contract rates have plummeted by over 17% as local contractors undercut each other to win concessions. The Commission now admits it. Chief Executive Isaac Tandoh said: “We have observed instances where mining service rates have fallen significantly... from $3 per tonne to below $2.50, leaving workers worse off”. Yet its solution is to tighten contractor oversight, not suspend the directive. The union says oversight has failed before. It cites Engineers & Planners, held up by government as a model local contractor, which the GMWU says has refused to meet statutory obligations, including SSNIT contributions and Tier 2 pension payments accrued over multiple years. Other contractors named include E&P, Rabotec, BCM, Electrochem and Rocksure. The GMWU is particularly concerned about labour brokers, especially in some Chinese-owned operations, whom it accuses of commodifying labour and subjecting even mining engineers, geologists and metallurgists to precarious conditions. The GMWU says it first wrote to the Minerals Commission on April 23, 2026, after the directive. A meeting on May 26 produced a roadmap to suspend it and form a Technical Committee. That roadmap has stalled. No public cost-benefit analysis has been released on the impact on PAYE, SSNIT, Tier 2, community spending, and safety. Beginning September 1, the union has threatened industrial action, including wearing red armbands across all mines: “It is about bread and butter, and we can’t sit aloof,” Gbana said. The central question remains unanswered by the Minerals Commission: How does creating a class of working poor in Tarkwa, Obuasi and Kenyasi maximise optimal national benefit from Ghana's gold? Until that question is answered, the GMWU's demand stands: suspend the directive and put workers at the centre of policy
https://www.myjoyonline.com/contract-min.title_zh: 矿业承包指令：矿产委员会推动本地化内容的举措如何导致加纳矿区民众陷入劳动贫困
https://www.myjoyonline.com/contract-min.body_zh: 多年来，加纳矿业社区一直陷于典型的“资源诅咒”。塔尔夸、奥布阿西和凯尼亚西开采黄金，但居民表示，换来的却是侵犯人权、环境破坏、生计丧失、健康危害和社会衰退。维系这些城镇的唯一例外并非企业社会责任，而是常驻矿工的工资单。这份工资单缴纳了为地方议会提供资金的PAYE，支付了SSNIT款项，还建起了市场、出租房和商铺。如今，拆毁这一根基的不仅是矿业公司，还有国家监管机构Minerals Commission下达的指令。2025年10月至2026年1月，Minerals Commission向仍在采用矿主自营模式的最后三家大型公司Newmont、AngloGold Ashanti和总部位于中国的Zijin Mining发出函件，命令它们到2026年12月前全面从矿主自营模式转为承包开采，否则将面临罚款和关闭矿山等制裁。该指令依据《2020年矿产与采矿（本地内容及当地参与）条例》（L.I. 2431）执行。露天开采必须交由加纳全资持有的企业承揽，地下开采则必须交由本地持股比例至少为50%的企业承揽。首席执行官Isaac Tandoh从理念上为该政策辩护：“就业不等于所有权，劳动不等于控制。我们的人确实在矿山工作，没错，但他们拥有这些矿山吗？”但那些真正在井下冒着生命危险的工人说，他们从未被征询意见。据隶属TUC Ghana、代表约14000名大型矿业工人的加纳矿工工会（GMWU），该行业已经经历了一场无声的临时化。截至2024年底，超过90%的工人从事定期和临时工作，正式就业比例不足10%。工会表示，到2026年，这一数字已升至95%以上，意味着每20名矿工中就有19人采用短期、临时或合同用工安排。GMWU于2026年8月20日呈交给土地与自然资源部长Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah的请愿书措辞直白：承包模式“危险、倒退且经济上不合理”。该工会与财经记者Adnan Adams Mohammed开展的一项研究发现，当工人从矿主自营模式转为承包工时，同一工作的工资至少减半。承包商内部员工证实，承包工的基本工资通常比矿山运营商的直接雇员低约50%。Gbana说，损失的范围更广：PAYE减少、养老金缴款下降、退休福利缩减。GMWU总书记Abdul-Moomin Gbana在提交请愿书后对记者说：“这并不是我们实施本地内容管制的初衷，而是对原有意图的彻底背离。我们坚决反对这项指令。请愿书指出：“因此，本地内容必须为所有加纳人创造机会，不能沦为剥削劳动、以牺牲那些日夜冒着风险、挥洒汗水，在地球深处创造财富的工人为代价，让少数承包商致富的工具。”在同一封信中，他警告道：“因此，我们不得不明确指出，这条道路会损害矿工本已脆弱且不稳定的处境，并与他们的利益相悖。它必然会导致进一步剥削、侵害、劳工临时化，以及侵蚀工人数十年来争取来之不易的保障。”经济账解释了背后的社会代价。Minerals Commission自行汇总的数据显示，随着本地承包商为赢得特许权相互压价，实际承包费率暴跌逾17%。委员会如今也承认了这一点。首席执行官Isaac Tandoh说：“我们已经发现一些矿业服务费率大幅下降的情况……从每吨3美元降至2.50美元以下，使工人的处境更加恶化。”然而，该机构的解决方案是加强承包商监管，而非暂停指令。工会表示，这种监管此前已经失败。它援引了政府树为本地承包商典范的Engineers & Planners，称GMWU指出，该公司拒绝履行法定义务，包括拖欠SSNIT缴款和第二级养老金款项，且已累积多年。其他被点名的承包商包括E&P、Rabotec、BCM、Electrochem和Rocksure。GMWU尤其担心劳务中介，尤其是某些中资企业运营项目中的中介，并指控他们将劳动商品化，使矿业工程师、地质学家和冶金师甚至也陷入不稳定的就业处境。GMWU表示，指令下达后，其于2026年4月23日首次致函Minerals Commission。5月26日举行的一次会议制定了暂停指令并成立技术委员会的路线图，但该路线图目前已经停滞。尚未公开发布任何有关该指令对PAYE、SSNIT、第二级养老金、社区支出和安全影响的成本效益分析。工会威胁称，自9月1日起将采取工业行动，包括在所有矿山佩戴红色臂章。Gbana说：“这是关乎生计的问题，我们不能坐视不理。”Minerals Commission仍未回答核心问题：在塔尔夸、奥布阿西和凯尼亚西制造一个劳动贫困群体，如何实现加纳从黄金开采中取得最大国家利益？在这个问题得到解答之前，GMWU的要求依然成立：暂停指令，并将工人置于政策的核心位置……

https://www.thehindu.com/news/internatio.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription Bangladesh's Law Minister Md Asaduzzaman on Sunday (November 8, 2026) described ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina as a "convicted criminal" and said Dhaka has requested India to extradite her, according to local media reports. Responding to questions from journalists after inaugurating a training workshop in Dhaka, Mr. Asaduzzaman said the government was taking all necessary legal steps to bring Ms. Hasina back from India and would follow due process. "To me, she is a criminal. A criminal convicted by our tribunal. To us, this is her identity," he said, according to a report on bdnews24 website. Asked about bringing Ms. Hasina back to Bangladesh, the Law Minister said the government would act in accordance with the law and would not be guided by emotion. "Although the Law Ministry is not directly involved in this matter, the Ministry of Home Affairs is concerned, as it relates to the extradition treaty with India. The matter will be dealt with in accordance with the law, leaving no room for emotions. We have requested her repatriation under the treaty and through due process," Mr. Asaduzzaman was quoted as saying by the state-run BSS news agency. Bdnews24 also quoted Mr. Asaduzzaman as saying: "That is a matter for the Indian government. We have made requests to them under the extradition treaty." "If they hand her over to us, we will hand her over in the due process, as required under the law," he added. India has previously acknowledged receiving Bangladesh's extradition requests for Ms. Hasina but has not announced any decision on handing her over. The Ministry of External Affairs has said the requests are being examined as part of its established processes. Ms. Hasina fled Bangladesh for India on August 5, 2024, following a mass uprising that ended her 15-year rule. An interim government led by Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus subsequently took charge. Bangladesh's International Crimes Tribunal in November 2025 convicted Ms. Hasina of crimes against humanity committed during the July-August 2024 uprising. The tribunal, which tried her in absentia, sentenced her to death on one charge and life imprisonment on another. In February this year, Bangladesh held parliamentary elections and the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) led by Tarique Rahman formed the government. During an audio-only virtual press conference organised in New Delhi on August 5, Ms. Hasina said she intended to return to Bangladesh in December despite the possibility of being imprisoned or killed. The interaction drew a sharp reaction from Dhaka, whose Foreign Ministry said it was "outraged" that Ms. Hasina had been allowed to engage with the media. India distanced itself from the event, saying it was organised by a private media entity and that the government had no involvement whatsoever in it. 据当地媒体报道，孟加拉国法律部长Md Asaduzzaman于2026年11月8日星期日称被推翻的首相Sheikh Hasina是“已被定罪的罪犯”，并表示达卡已请求印度将她引渡回国。

Asaduzzaman先生在达卡主持一场培训研讨会开幕式后回答记者提问时表示，政府正采取一切必要法律措施，将Hasina女士从印度带回，并会依法办理相关程序。据bdnews24网站报道，他说：“在我看来，她是一名罪犯，一名被我国法庭定罪的罪犯。对我们而言，这就是她的身份。”

当被问及将Hasina女士带回孟加拉国一事时，这位法律部长表示，政府将依法采取行动，不会受情绪左右。

据国家通讯社BSS引述，Asaduzzaman先生说：“尽管法律部没有直接参与此事，但内政部与此案有关，因为这涉及我们与印度之间的引渡条约。此事将依法处理，不给情绪留下任何空间。我们已依据该条约并通过正当程序提出将她遣返的要求。”

Bdnews24还引述Asaduzzaman先生的话说：“这是印度政府应处理的事情。我们已依据引渡条约向他们提出要求。”

他补充道：“如果他们将她交给我们，我们就会按照法律要求，通过正当程序将她移交。”

印度此前曾确认收到孟加拉国关于引渡Hasina女士的请求，但尚未宣布是否会将她移交。印度外交部表示，这些请求正作为既定程序的一部分接受审查。

Hasina女士于2024年8月5日因一场推翻其15年执政的群众起义而逃离孟加拉国，前往印度。此后，由诺贝尔奖得主Muhammad Yunus领导的临时政府接管国家事务。

2025年11月，孟加拉国国际刑事法庭裁定Hasina女士犯有在2024年7月至8月起义期间实施的危害人类罪。该法庭在缺席审判她后，就一项罪名判处死刑，并就另一项罪名判处无期徒刑。

今年2月，孟加拉国举行议会选举，由Tarique Rahman领导的孟加拉国民族主义党（BNP）组建政府。

在8月5日于新德里组织的一场仅提供音频接入的虚拟新闻发布会上，Hasina女士表示，尽管可能遭到监禁或杀害，她仍打算在12月返回孟加拉国。这一互动引发达卡方面的强烈反应。孟加拉国外交部称，对于Hasina女士获准与媒体互动一事，它感到“愤慨”。

印度与该活动保持距离，称活动由一家私人媒体机构组织，政府绝对没有参与。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.summary_zh: （北京＝韩联社）汉钟求特派记者报道称，hegseth（赫格塞斯）美国国防部长和Samuel Paparo（塞缪尔·帕帕罗）美军印太司令部司令近期可能访问中国。据《南华早报》（SCMP）等媒体8日报道，Steven Hollins（史蒂文·霍林斯）美中关系全国委员会（NCUSCR）主席6日以视频方式出席在中国海南省三亚举行的“全球海洋合作与海洋治理论坛”，并提到了两人访华的可能性。霍林斯主席表示：“我知道赫格塞斯部长和帕帕罗司令近期可能会访问中国。两人此次访问将有助于将两国军方之间的沟通正规化。”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.body: (베이징=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 = 피트 헤그세스 미국 국방장관과 새뮤얼 퍼파로 미군 인도·태평양사령관이 조만간 중국을 방문할 가능성이 제기됐다. 8일 홍콩 사우스차이나모닝포스트(SCMP) 등에 따르면 스티븐 올린스 미중관계전국위원회(NCUSCR) 회장은 지난 6일 중국 하이난성 싼야에서 열린 '글로벌 해양협력·해양 거버넌스 포럼'에 화상으로 참석해 두 사람의 방중 가능성을 언급했다. 올린스 회장은 "헤그세스 장관과 퍼파로 사령관이 조만간 중국을 방문할 수 있는 것으로 알고 있다"며 "두 사람의 방문이 양국 군 당국 간 소통을 정례화하는 데 도움이 될 것"이라고 말했다. 그는 양국이 군사적 오판으로 인한 충돌을 방지하기 위해 모든 수준에서 군사 교류를 정례화하고, 충돌이 발생하더라도 신속한 소통으로 긴장을 완화할 수 있는 체계를 마련해야 한다고 촉구했다. SCMP는 소식통을 인용해 미중이 최근 몇 달간 헤그세스 장관의 중국 방문 문제를 논의했으며 연내 방문이 성사될 가능성이 있다고 전했다. 지난 9월 워싱턴에서 열린 미중 정상회담 이후 헤그세스 장관과 둥쥔 중국 국방부장의 상호 방문 가능성도 논의된 것으로 알려졌다. 다만 헤그세스 장관은 최근 미국 중간선거에서 공화당이 패배한 이후 탄핵 압박을 받고 있어 거취가 불투명한 상황이다. 공화당 일각에서도 이란 전쟁 수행 등을 문제 삼아 탄핵을 추진하고 민주당도 국방부 운영에 대한 조사를 준비하고 있어서다. 그러나 트럼프 대통령은 여전히 그에 대한 신임을 유지하고 있다. 또 퍼파로 사령관의 방중이 성사된다면 2015년 이후 약 11년 만에 미국의 태평양지역 최고 군사령관이 중국을 방문하게 된다. 중국 난징대 국제관계학원 주펑 원장은 SCMP에 퍼파로 사령관의 방중이 미중 양국 군 당국 간 실무급 소통을 강화하는 계기가 될 수 있다고 평가했다. 미 국방부에 따르면 양국 국방 당국자들은 지난 2∼3일 워싱턴에서 '위기 소통·예방 실무그룹' 연례회의를 열고 군사적 위험을 줄이기 위한 방안을 논의했다. 앞서 지난 8월에는 퍼파로 사령관이 캐나다에서 양즈빈 중국 인민해방군 동부전구 사령원과 만나 군사적 오판을 막기 위한 고위급 소통의 중요성을 논의했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/08 14:24 송고 2026년11월08일 14시24분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.title_zh: 美国国防部长和印太司令部司令将访问中国，美中军事交流扩大备受关注
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.body_zh: （北京＝韩联社）驻华记者韩宗求报道称，美国国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯与美军印太司令部司令塞缪尔·帕帕罗近期可能访华。据《南华早报》（SCMP）等媒体8日报道，中美关系全国委员会（NCUSCR）会长史蒂文·奥林斯于6日以视频方式出席在海南省三亚举行的“全球海洋合作·海洋治理论坛”，并提到上述两人可能访华。奥林斯会长表示：“据了解，赫格塞斯部长和帕帕罗司令近期可能访问中国。两人的访问将有助于推动两国军方当局之间的沟通机制化。”他还敦促两国在所有层级将军事交流机制化，以防止因军事误判而引发冲突，并建立即使发生冲突也能通过迅速沟通缓解紧张的体系。《南华早报》援引消息人士称，中美双方近几个月来讨论了赫格塞斯部长访华问题，并称其年内成行可能性较高。据报道，在华盛顿举行的中美领导人会谈后，双方曾讨论赫格塞斯部长与中国国防部长董军互访的可能性。不过，由于美国近期中期选举中共和党败选后，赫格塞斯部长面临弹劾压力，其行踪目前并不明朗。共和党内部也有人以对伊朗战争的处置等问题为由推动弹劾，民主党亦准备就国防部的运作展开调查。然而，特朗普总统仍对赫格塞斯表示信任。此外，如果帕帕罗司令访华成行，将是美国太平洋地区最高军事指挥官自2015年以来时隔约11年首次访问中国。中国南京大学国际关系学院院长周峰向《南华早报》评价称，帕帕罗司令访华可能成为加强中美两国军方当局务实层级沟通的契机。据美国国防部介绍，两国国防部门官员于2日至3日在华盛顿举行“危机沟通与预防工作组”年度会议，讨论降低军事风险的办法。此前在8月，帕帕罗司令曾在加拿大会见中国人民解放军东部战区司令杨志斌，并就避免军事误判、加强高级别沟通的重要性交换了意见。报道由KakaoTalk账号okjebo提供。版权所有©韩联社，未经许可禁止转载·再分发及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026年11月8日14时24分发布。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 目前，全球对这些材料的供应以及相关采矿计划不足以满足不断增长的需求。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普已将对中国关键矿物的依赖列为主要国家安全风险，并宣布投入数十亿美元，在国内外建设新的矿产和采矿项目。在巴西，美国试图遏制中国的采矿投资，同时重申其在整个拉丁美洲的领先地位。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: OXFORD — Two tumultuous elections have captured headlines this week. In Brazil, incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defeated his far-right challenger Flávio Bolsonaro. And in Serbia, the student-led opposition ousted Aleksandar Vučić after 14 years in power. But the challenge for these new governments is just beginning. Whether they like it or not, both will be swept up in the global scramble for critical minerals and metals. Critical minerals and metals are essential to build modern infrastructure, implement advanced technologies, and pursue decarbonization. They are vital inputs in electricity grids, wind turbines, solar panels, batteries, electric vehicles, and energy storage. And Brazil and Serbia both possess them: Brazil holds the world’s second-largest reserve of rare earths (after China), estimated at 21 million tons (Mt), and Serbia has significant stores of coal and lithium, as well as copper, gold, and other metals. As it stands, global supplies of these materials, and mining plans for them, are insufficient to meet growing demand. For example, BloombergNEF projects a copper-supply shortfall of 44% of projected global demand by 2050. This has further intensified competition between China and the United States for control of these resources. China is in pole position in this race: the International Energy Agency reports that it is now the top refiner of 19 of 20 key strategic minerals, with an average market share of 70 percent. But the US is committed to strengthening its position. Having identified dependence on China for critical minerals as a key national-security risk, U.S. President Donald Trump has announced billions of dollars in investments in new mineral and mining projects at home and abroad. Resource politics has penetrated almost all corners of U.S. foreign policy, including relations with the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Denmark and Greenland, Ukraine, and Venezuela. In Brazil, the US is trying to contain Chinese mining investment, while re-asserting its preeminence across Latin America. In Serbia, the U.S. government has said for years that a greater presence for American firms is necessary to “displace” China, which has invested “billions of dollars” in mines and other related projects. For countries like Brazil and Serbia, the challenge is to attract the investment they need to leverage their resources for their own benefit, without losing popular support. It is a tricky proposition. Both countries have experienced deadly mining accidents in recent years. In 2019, the Brumadinho dam collapsed, releasing a deluge of toxic mud from Brazil’s Córrego do Feijão iron ore mine that killed 270 people. In 2022, a partial collapse of Serbia’s Soko coal mine led to a sudden release of methane, killing eight miners. If either of these countries is to expand mining operations, the public must trust that it can be done safely. But the Sino-American competition, coupled with soaring global demand, could easily drive down standards in the mining sector. By pushing out companies with better projects, agreements shaped by weak anti-corruption enforcement, conflicts of interest, or hostility toward environmental, social, and governance standards — all of which are apparent in the U.S. nowadays — could lead to less competitive, less safe, and more socially and environmentally harmful arrangements. The US and China want their investments in mining and processing to deliver the biggest and fastest returns possible. Governments in resource-rich countries like Brazil and Serbia will have to navigate such external pressures in a way that does not undermine their legitimacy at home. But mining companies must also build legitimacy in the communities where they operate, lest host countries throw them under the bus if public opinion sours. This has been apparent in Guinea, Mali, and Niger, where governments have lately revoked dozens of mining licenses. In Kenya, the government recently ordered the immediate suspension of mining operations by Tata Chemicals Magadi over “regulatory non-compliance.” Among the issues it identified were the lack of a clear mineral-beneficiation and value-addition strategy, outstanding royalty reconciliation and payment obligations, and inadequate export reporting. Tata Chemicals’ performance was also found wanting when it came to implementing community development agreements, employment and skills-transfer plans for Kenyans, local procurement, and environmental compliance. This is not just a list of terms for the firm’s relationship with government. It captures the broader relationships—with local workers and suppliers, with surrounding communities, and with the nation as a whole—on which the company’s resilience and legitimacy depended. Another recent case reinforces the point. First Quantum’s Cobre Panamá — one of the world’s largest copper mines, which cost some $10 billion to develop and contributed about 5 percent of Panama’s GDP in 2022 — was shuttered in late 2023, following nationwide protests over the mine’s environmental impact. The Canadian company’s original contract included a tax holiday until the capital costs of building the mine were recouped, and a royalty of just 2 percent of revenue. In March 2023, the government made a new deal with First Quantum, which included a 25 percent corporate income tax, 12–16 percent royalties, and a yearly minimum payment of $375 million, in addition to social security contributions, municipal taxes, acreage fees, water charges, and environmental obligations. But Panama’s Supreme Court ruled that the legislation on which that agreement rested violated 25 constitutional articles, covering environmental protection, public welfare, health, and the state’s obligations to its citizens. Panama’s government may yet want to reopen the mine (even if just to shut it sustainably), but any new concession will have to be grounded in legislation aligned with constitutional principles. For mining companies seeking to operate in Brazil, Serbia, or anywhere else, resilience requires more than navigating host-country politics and not getting kicked out. will benefit companies that progress from “tolerated” to “trusted” by offering transparency, respect, and responsiveness to local concerns. Ngaire Woods is dean of the Blavatnik School of Government at the University of Oxford and a non-executive director at Rio Tinto. This article was distributed by Project Syndicate
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 采矿业的新地缘政治格局
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 牛津——本周，两场动荡的大选占据 headlines。在巴西，现任总统卢伊兹·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦击败了极右翼挑战者弗拉维奥·博索纳罗。在塞尔维亚，由学生领导的反对派在亚历山大·武契奇执政14年后迫使他下台。但这些新政府面临的挑战才刚刚开始。无论愿不愿意，两国都将被卷入全球争夺关键矿产和金属的竞赛。关键矿产和金属对于建设现代基础设施、实施先进技术以及推进脱碳至关重要。它们是电网、风力涡轮机、太阳能板、电池、电动汽车和储能系统的重要投入品。巴西和塞尔维亚都拥有这些资源：巴西拥有仅次于中国的全球第二大稀土储量，估计达2100万吨（Mt）；塞尔维亚则拥有大量煤炭和锂，以及铜、金和其他金属。目前，全球这些材料的供应及其采矿计划不足以满足不断增长的需求。例如，BloombergNEF预计，到2050年，铜供应缺口将达到预计全球需求的44%。这进一步加剧了中国和美国争夺这些资源控制权的竞争。中国在这场竞赛中处于有利地位：国际能源署报告称，中国现在是20种关键战略矿产中19种的最大精炼国，平均市场份额为70%。但美国决心加强自身地位。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将关键矿产对中国的依赖列为一项关键国家安全风险，并宣布投资数十亿美元在国内及海外建设新的矿产和采矿项目。资源政治已经渗透到美国外交政策的几乎所有角落，包括与刚果民主共和国、丹麦和格陵兰、乌克兰以及委内瑞拉的关系。在巴西，美国试图遏制中国的采矿投资，同时重新确立自己在拉丁美洲的优势。在塞尔维亚，美国政府多年来一直表示，需要让美国企业拥有更广泛的存在，以“取代”中国；中国已在矿山及其他相关项目上投资“数十亿美元”。对于巴西和塞尔维亚这样的国家来说，挑战在于吸引所需投资，利用自身资源为本国谋利，同时不失去公众支持。这是一项微妙的难题。近年来，两国都发生过致命的矿难。2019年，布鲁马迪纽大坝坍塌，巴西科尔雷朱·杜·费热昂铁矿的有毒泥浆洪流决堤，造成270人死亡。2022年，塞尔维亚索科煤矿发生局部坍塌，甲烷突然泄漏，8名矿工死亡。如果这两个国家中的任何一个要扩大采矿业务，公众必须相信采矿能够安全进行。但中美竞争加上全球需求飙升，可能轻易导致采矿行业标准下降。通过排挤拥有更优项目的企业，在反腐败执法不力、利益冲突或敌视环境、社会和治理标准的协议框架下开展业务——这些在美国如今都十分明显——可能导致竞争力更弱、安全性更差，并造成更大社会和环境危害的安排。美国和中国都希望其对采矿和加工的投资获得最大、最快的回报。巴西和塞尔维亚等资源丰富国家的政府将不得不应对这种外部压力，同时不损害自身在国内的合法性。但矿业公司也必须在所在社区建立合法性，否则一旦公众舆论转坏，东道国可能会把公司当成弃子。这一情况在几内亚、马里和尼日尔十分明显，这些国家的政府最近撤销了数十张采矿许可证。在肯尼亚，政府最近以“违反监管规定”为由，命令 Tata Chemicals Magadi 立即暂停采矿业务。其认定的问题包括缺乏明确的矿产选冶和增值战略、未完成的特许权使用费核算与支付义务，以及出口报告不足。在执行社区发展协议、为肯尼亚人制定就业和技能转移计划、本地采购以及环境合规方面，Tata Chemicals 的表现也被认为不尽如人意。这不仅仅是一系列涉及公司与政府关系的条款。它涵盖了更广泛的关系——与当地工人和供应商、周边社区以及整个国家的关系——而公司的韧性和合法性正依赖于这些关系。另一个近期案例进一步印证了这一点。First Quantum 的 Cobre Panamá 铜矿是全球最大的铜矿之一，开发成本约100亿美元，2022年贡献了巴拿马国内生产总值约5%，但在2023年末因该矿的环境影响引发全国性抗议而被关闭。这家加拿大公司的原始合同包括税收假期，直至建矿的资本成本收回；此外还有仅占收入2%的特许权使用费。2023年3月，政府与 First Quantum 达成新协议，规定征收25%的企业所得税、12%至16%的特许权使用费以及每年最低付款3.75亿美元，此外还须缴纳社会保障金、地方税、土地面积费、水资源费并履行环境义务。但巴拿马最高法院裁定，该协议所依据的法律违反了宪法中的25项条款，涉及环境保护、公共福利、健康以及国家对公民所承担的义务。巴拿马政府或许仍希望重新开放这座矿山（即便只是为了以可持续方式关闭它），但任何新的特许协议都必须建立在符合宪法原则的法律基础上。对于希望进入巴西、塞尔维亚或其他任何地方经营的矿业公司而言，仅需应对东道国政治并避免被赶出去，并不足以构成韧性。提供透明度、尊重并回应地方关切，将有助于企业从“被容忍”转变为“受信任”。Ngaire Woods 是牛津大学布拉瓦特尼克政府学院院长，也是力拓的非执行董事。本文由 Project Syndicate 分发

https://www.bbc.com/hausa/articles/cq5yn.summary_zh: 在乍得当地时间2026年3月3日星期二举行的美国国会选举中，原定选举众议院和参议院议员。此前，一些人士在国会选举中取得了出人意料的成果，其中包括一些尼日利亚及其他非洲国家议员在两院赢得席位。
https://www.bbc.com/hausa/articles/cq5yn.body: An wallafa Sa'o'i 2 da suka wuce Lokacin karatu: Minti 3 An gudanar da zaɓen Majalisar Dokokin Amurka ranar Talata, 3 ga watan Nuwamba, 2026, domin zaɓen mambobin majalisar biyu, wato Majalisar Dattawa da Majalisar Wakilai. Sakamakon zaɓen ya nuna cewa jam'iyyar Democrat ta samu kujeru fiye da jam'iyyar Republican, wadda Shugaba Donald Trump yake wakilta. A yayin zaɓen, an samu wasu abubuwa da ba a yi tsammani ba, ciki har da nasarar 'yan Najeriya da sauran Baƙaƙen fata da suka samu kujeru a majalisun dokokin Amurka. Fiye da 'yan takara goma sha biyu ’yan asalin Najeriya sun samu nasarar lashe kujerun wakiltar mazabu daban-daban a Amurka, ciki har da waɗanda ke jihohin Maryland, Texas, Pennsylvania da Georgia, da kuma birnin Washington DC. Will Jawando ya samu nasarar lashe zaɓen shugabancin gundumar Montgomery da ke jihar Maryland, bayan ya kayar da Esther Wells ta jam'iyyar Republican. Ofishin babban jami’in tsaro na gundumar Montgomery ya naɗa Jawando a matsayin sabon shugaban rundunar 'yan sandan yankin. Jawando mamba ne a Majalisar Gundumar Montgomery. Dan asalin Najeriya ne, kasancewar mahaifinsa ɗan Najeriya ne, yayin da mahaifiyarsa Ba'amurkiya ce. A jihar Texas, Junior Ezeonu mai shekaru 27 ya samu nasarar lashe zaɓen kujerar wakilcin mazaɓa ta 101 a Majalisar Wakilan Jihar, bayan ya kayar da ɗan majalisar mai ci, Chris Turner, a zaɓen fitar da gwani. An haifi Ezeonu a Onitsha, jihar Anambra ta Najeriya, amma ya koma jihar Texas da ke Amurka yana ɗan shekara biyu. A shekarar 2021, an zaɓe shi a matsayin mamba a Majalisar Ƙaramar Hukumar Grand Prairie. Daga baya kuma ya zama mutum mafi ƙarancin shekaru da ya taɓa riƙe muƙamin mataimakin magajin garin na wucin gadi a tarihin birnin. Carol Kazeem, 'yar jam'iyyar Democrat, ta sake lashe zaɓen kujerar wakilcin mazaɓa ta 159 a Majalisar Wakilan Jihar Pennsylvania. Kazeem na daga cikin 'yan siyasa baƙaƙen fata na farko da suka samu nasarar lashe kujerun majalisa a Amurka a zaɓen shekarar 2022. A birnin Washington DC, Oye Owolewa ya samu nasarar lashe ɗaya daga cikin kujerun wakilci na bai ɗaya a Majalisar Gundumar Columbia. Owolewa, wanda masani ne a fannin harhaɗa magunguna, iyayensa sun fito daga jihohin Kwara da Osun ne na Najeriya, waɗanda suka yi hijira zuwa Amurka. A baya, ya riƙe muƙamin wakilin je-ka na-yi-ka Gundumar Columbia (Shadow Representative). Kundin tsarin mulkin Amurka ya tanadi cewa Gundumar Columbia za ta kasance jiha mai cin gashin kanta. Sai dai har yanzu ba ta da cikakken ikon kaɗa ƙuri'a a Majalisar Wakilan Amurka. Adeyina, wanda aka haifa a Najeriya kuma mamba ne a jam'iyyar Democrat, ya sake lashe zaɓe domin komawa Majalisar Dokokin Jihar Georgia. An fara zaɓen Adeyina zuwa Majalisar Wakilan Jihar Georgia ne a shekarar 2022, inda yake wakiltar wasu sassan gundumar Gwinnett. Shi ne babban daraktan kwamitin ba da shawarwari ga al'ummar Najeriya mazauna Amurka (Nigerian American Public Advisory Committee), wata ƙungiya da ke wayar da kan jama'a kan muhimmancin zaɓe, tare da taimaka wa baƙin haure da ke zaune a Amurka wajen yin rajistar zaɓe. Shi ma Gabe Okoye na jam'iyyar Democrat ya sake lashe zaɓe, inda zai koma Majalisar Dokokin Jihar Georgia domin ci gaba da wakiltar mazaɓa ta 102. https://www.bbc.com/hausa/articles/cq5yn.body_zh: 美国国会中期选举再过2天：周二，即2026年11月3日，将举行美国国会选举，选举众议院参议院和众议院议员。结果显示，民主党获得的席位比共和党多，共和党由总统唐纳德·特朗普代表。选举结果还出现了一些出人意料的情况，包括尼日利亚裔人士和其他亚裔人士在美国国会中取得进展。超过12名尼日利亚出生的候选人成功赢得美国不同选区的代表席位，其中包括马里兰州、得克萨斯州、宾夕法尼亚州、佐治亚州以及华盛顿特区。Will Jawando在击败共和党的Esther Wells后，成功赢得马里兰州蒙哥马利县县长选举，蒙哥马利县治安官办公室任命Jawando为新的县治安官。Jawando是蒙哥马利县议会成员。他是尼日利亚裔，父亲是尼日利亚人，母亲是美国人。在得克萨斯州，27岁的Junior Ezeonu在初选中击败现任议员Chris Turner后，成功赢得得克萨斯州众议院第101选区代表席位。Ezeonu出生于尼日利亚阿南布拉州奥尼察，但两年前移居美国得克萨斯州。2021年，他当选为大草原市法律市议会成员。后来，他又成为该市历史上最年轻的市政议员副手候选人。民主党人Carol Kazeem再次赢得宾夕法尼亚州众议院第159选区代表席位。Kazeem属于首批赢得美国议会议席的非裔美国政治人士，这些人士在2022年选举中取得突破。在华盛顿特区，Oye Owolewa赢得哥伦比亚特区议会仅有的一个代表席位。Owolewa以反毒工作闻名，父母来自尼日利亚夸拉州和奥孙州，后来移民美国。此后，他担任哥伦比亚特区影子代表。美国的政府体制规定，哥伦比亚特区应享有州级地位，但目前仍未在美国众议院获得完整的投票权。出生于尼日利亚的民主党人Adeyina再次当选，重新返回佐治亚州众议院。2022年，Adeyina首次竞选佐治亚州众议院议员，代表格温内特县的其他乡村地区。他是旅美尼日利亚人公共咨询委员会（Nigerian American Public Advisory Committee）的主席，该组织向公众宣传选举的重要性，并协助居住在美国的大批非洲人登记投票。民主党人Gabe Okoye也再次赢得选举，将返回佐治亚州众议院，继续代表第102选区。2024年美国选举 尼日利亚 唐纳德·特朗普 美国政治 突发 特朗普 连任 竞选活动 02:04 视频、Tinubu可能面临的州份 2027年选举、2分04秒 01:11 视频、PSG是世界上哪支最强的足球队？、1分11秒 02:18 视频、是什么引发了Kwankwaso与ADC之间的冲突？、2分18秒 04:04 视频、‘我与南方同僚建立了牢固关系’、4分04秒 01:40 视频、Ilhan Omar：谁在众议院与特朗普针锋相对？、1分40秒 01:28 视频、尼日利亚2027年可能出现的5位女性总统人选、1分28秒 04:46 视频、‘Hollywood演员比女性承担更多责任’、4分46秒 01:45 视频、在尼日利亚导致儿童早婚和失去受教育机会的因素、1分45秒 02:41 视频、仍在为尼日利亚推动足球的北方人、2分41秒 03:50 视频、如何确认你的号码是否在NCC关闭之列、3分50秒 01:39 视频、是什么让Tinubu的选举委员会陷入困境？、1分39秒 01:39 视频、尼日利亚最贫困的州份、1分39秒 03:04 视频、尼日利亚公民在2027年前面临的困境、3分04秒 02:04 视频、这位百岁老人正在书写历史、2分04秒 特朗普连任竞选结束

https://x.com/morris_monye/status/211974.snippet:
A Direct Challenge to the APC and President Bola Tinubu on Nigeria’s $145 Billion Debt Profile (as at June 2026 from the DMO). 

Where is the Return on Investment?

According to the World Bank Group's International Debt Report 2026 released on November 6, 2026, Nigeria’s total external debt has surged to $145.02 billion. Within this astronomical portfolio, the ruling APC administration maintains a staggering $5.67 billion in bilateral debt owed to China, cementing Beijing as our largest government-to-government creditor.

As these liabilities compound, the administration continues to aggressively pursue more loans, including the latest $7.7 billion external borrowing request presented to the National Assembly to finance the budget deficit.

Debt in itself can be a tool for development, but only when it is strictly channelled into transparent, high-impact capital investments that generate economic returns. When debt rises without visible equivalents in infrastructure, it transitions from fiscal management to generational liquidation.

Therefore, the patriotic citizens of this country are asking a fundamental question: What has the APC-led administration achieved in tangible capital projects and critical investments with these billions of dollars?

To bring clarity to this national conversation and shift the focus from political rhetoric to verifiable governance, we hereby challenge the supporters of President Tinubu and the APC to step forward and name five (5) major capital projects or capital investments that have been fully initiated, completed, and officially commissioned under the presidency of Bola Ahmed Tinubu.

We do not want to hear about ongoing projects inherited from previous administrations, nor are we interested in policy declarations, macroeconomic promises, or legislative approvals. We demand an account of concrete, commissioned infrastructure that justifies the heavy debt burden being placed upon the shoulders of the Nigerian people.

True leadership is measured by the legacies it builds, not the liabilities it accumulates. Nigeria must survive, and that survival depends entirely on demanding absolute accountability from those entrusted with our national treasury.

https://x.com/morris_monye/status/211974.title_zh: 对全 progressives 党及博拉·蒂努布总统关于尼日利亚1450亿美元债务规模的一次直接质疑（截至2026年6月，数据来自债务管理办公室）。
https://x.com/morris_monye/status/211974.snippet_zh:
就尼日利亚1450亿美元债务规模直接质问全进步大会党（APC）和总统博拉·蒂努布（截至2026年6月，据债务管理办公室数据）

投资回报在哪里？

根据世界银行集团于2026年11月6日发布的《2026年国际债务报告》，尼日利亚外债总额已飙升至1450.2亿美元。在这份规模惊人的债务组合中，执政的APC政府仍背负着56.7亿美元欠中国的双边债务，使北京成为我国最大的政府间债权国。

在这些债务不断累积的同时，政府仍积极寻求更多贷款，包括 recently 向国民议会提交的77亿美元外部借款申请，用于填补预算赤字。

债务本身可以成为推动发展的工具，但前提是资金必须严格用于透明、影响重大的资本投资，并能创造经济回报。如果债务增加却看不到相应的基础设施成果，债务管理就会转变为对子孙后代的清算。

因此，这个国家富有爱国心的公民提出了一个根本问题：APC领导的政府利用这数十亿美元，在有形资本项目和关键投资方面取得了哪些成果？

为厘清这场全国性讨论，把焦点从政治口号转向可核实的治理表现，我们在此向总统蒂努布和APC的支持者提出挑战：站出来列出在博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统任内已经全面启动、完成并正式投用的五个重大资本项目或资本投资。

我们不想听从前几届政府遗留的在建项目，也不关心政策声明、宏观经济承诺或议会批准。我们要求说明已经正式投用的具体基础设施，因为正是这些项目使尼日利亚人民背负了沉重的债务负担。

真正的领导力，要看它留下了什么遗产，而不是它累积了多少负债。尼日利亚必须生存下去，而要生存下去，就完全取决于我们是否要求那些受托掌管国家财政的人绝对负责任。

https://x.com/kwankwasiyya_ax/status/211.snippet:
PRESS STATEMENT

APC'S ENDLESS LIES AND DECEIT
HOW MANY TIMES WILL APC APPROVE IBOM DEEP SEA PORT?

President Tinubu, while campaigning in Uyo, has promised and granted approval for the construction of the Ibom Deep Sea Port.

What a hocus-pocus, what hogwash, and what barefaced lies and shenanigans of a rudderless party! How many times will the APC approve the Ibom Deep Sea Port?

President Buhari approved it in December 2020. The Federal Executive Council gave approval for the implementation of the first phase of the $4.6 billion Ibom Deep Sea Port (IDSP) during its meeting on December 16, 2020.

That approval named Bollore/Power China as the preferred bidder and was meant to allow construction to commence.

In a brazen display of ignorance of statecraft and the elevation of grand deceit as a campaign strategy, President Tinubu, as APC presidential candidate, first promised the port during his 2023 campaign.

At the APC campaign rally at the Godswill Akpabio International Stadium in Uyo on 30 January 2023, he told supporters: "We will do mechanised farming. We will export food from Akwa Ibom. We will build your seaport."

Unfortunately, as is characteristic of the APC, they never fulfilled the promise. Over three years down the line, President Tinubu on Friday, 6 November 2026, had to promise again to construct the long-awaited Ibom Deep Sea Port project in Akwa Ibom State.

Obviously, this is another round of cheap promises that will not be kept or honoured. Just as before, so it will be now — empty promises. All talk and no action.

As Nigerians are still waiting for the APC and President Tinubu to give us uninterrupted electricity supply, so Akwa Ibomites are waiting endlessly for the promised deep sea port that has become a campaign tool of deceit.

Nigerians must shine their eyes and dump the APC into the abyss of socio-political irrelevance and make a new Nigeria possible.

Indeed, a New Nigeria is POssible with NDC.

Signed:
Osa Director, Esq.
For Inquiries: @DirectorOsa 
National Publicity Secretary
Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC)

https://x.com/kwankwasiyya_ax/status/211.snippet_zh:
新闻声明

全党一致性（APC）无休止的谎言与欺骗

全党一致性（APC）还要多少次才批准伊博姆深海港？

蒂努布总统在乌约竞选期间承诺并已批准建设伊博姆深海港。

真是一套障眼法，全是鬼话连篇，更是一个毫无方向的政党恬不知耻的谎言和把戏！全党一致性（APC）还要批准伊博姆深海港多少次？

布哈里总统已于2020年12月批准该港口。联邦执行委员会在2020年12月16日召开会议时，批准实施耗资46亿美元的伊博姆深海港（IDSP）第一阶段。

该批准将Bollore/Power China列为优先投标方，旨在推动港口开工。

全党一致性（APC）总统候选人蒂努布总统既缺乏治国常识，又把弥天大谎当作竞选策略，于2023年竞选期间首次承诺建设该港口。

2023年1月30日，在乌约的Godswill Akpabio国际体育场举行的全党一致性（APC）竞选集会上，他对支持者说：“我们将发展机械化农业。我们将从阿夸伊博姆出口食品。我们将建设你们的海港。”

遗憾的是，全党一致性（APC）一如既往，从来没有兑现承诺。三年多过去了，蒂努布总统在2026年11月6日星期五又不得不承诺在阿夸伊博姆州建设备受期待的伊博姆深海港项目。

显然，这又是另一轮根本无法兑现或履行的廉价承诺。过去如此，如今依然如此——全是空头承诺。光说不做。

尼日利亚民众仍在等待全党一致性（APC）和蒂努布总统为我们提供不间断的电力供应，阿夸伊博姆居民也仍在无休止地等待那个已成为欺骗性竞选工具的深海港承诺。

尼日利亚人必须擦亮双眼，将全党一致性（APC）丢进社会政治无足轻重的深渊，并让一个新的尼日利亚成为可能。

事实上，新尼日利亚在尼日利亚民主党（NDC）领导下一定能够实现。

https://x.com/dramoakohene/status/211930.snippet:
On the third day of our visit to Nanning, I was honoured to be hosted by the Vice Mayor of Nanning City, Mr. Hou Jin, following our successful high-level engagement with His Excellency Wei Tao, Governor of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

Our engagement focused on initiating discussions towards establishing a Sister City Partnership between cities in Ghana and Nanning, with practical areas of collaboration in:

1. Urban planning and city development.
2. Development control and effective land-use management.
3. Urban transportation and mobility.
4. Education and institutional partnerships.
5. Healthcare delivery and medical cooperation.
6. Modern, AI-driven strategies for revenue mobilisation and efficient local governance.

We are particularly encouraged by the invitation extended to students from our respective cities to pursue academic programmes in our universities. We also explored opportunities for bilateral scholarship arrangements, university partnerships and academic exchanges.

We acknowledged the strong diplomatic and economic relations between Ghana and China, under the leadership of His Excellency President John Dramani Mahama and His Excellency President Xi Jinping of the People’s Republic of China. These high-level engagements provide an important foundation for translating bilateral relations into practical opportunities for our cities, institutions, businesses and people.

Our visit reinforces our commitment to building international partnerships that promote knowledge exchange, innovation, investment and sustainable urban development.

From diplomatic relations to practical partnerships, we are working to create opportunities that deliver tangible benefits to our people.

https://x.com/dramoakohene/status/211930.title_zh: 我们访问南宁的第三天，我很荣幸受到南宁市副市长的邀请……先生
https://x.com/dramoakohene/status/211930.snippet_zh:
我们访问南宁的第三天，我很荣幸受到南宁市副市长侯进先生的接待。此前，我们已与广西壮族自治区主席韦涛阁下成功举行高级别会晤。

我们的磋商重点是启动关于加纳各城市与南宁建立友好城市合作关系的讨论，并探讨以下务实合作领域：

1. 城市规划与城市发展。
2. 开发管控与高效土地利用管理。
3. 城市交通与人员流动。
4. 教育与机构合作。
5. 医疗服务提供与医疗合作。
6. 以人工智能为驱动手段，提高财政收入动员能力和地方治理效率的现代化战略。

我们尤其受到一项邀请的鼓舞：加纳和南宁两市分别邀请对方城市的学生到各自大学就读学术课程。我们还探讨了落实双边奖学金安排、建立大学伙伴关系和开展学术交流的机会。

我们确认，在加纳总统约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马阁下和中华人民共和国主席习近平阁下的领导下，加纳与中国之间保持着牢固的外交和经济关系。这些高级别交往为将双边关系转化为惠及两国城市、机构、企业和民众的务实机遇奠定了重要基础。

此次访问强化了我们致力于建立国际伙伴关系的决心，以促进知识交流、创新、投资和可持续城市发展。

从外交关系到务实伙伴关系，我们正努力创造机遇，为两国人民带来切实利益。
